items.title: USS Billings (LCS 15) Returns to Naval Station Mayport Following Deployment to U.S. Southern Command
items.author: Courtesy
items.summary: The Freedom-class littoral combat ship USS Billings (LCS 15) returned to Naval Station Mayport Oct. 10, 2026, following a 6-month deployment to U.S. Fourth Fleet area of operations in support of U.S. Southern Command’s (USSOUTHCOM) mission.
items.body:
NAVAL STATION MAYPORT, Fla. — The Freedom-class littoral combat ship USS Billings (LCS 15) returned to Naval Station Mayport Oct. 10, 2026, following a 6-month deployment to U.S. Fourth Fleet area of operations in support of U.S. Southern Command’s (USSOUTHCOM) mission.

During the deployment, Billings conducted sustained maritime security operations to support regional counter-illicit trafficking efforts. The crew worked alongside an embarked U.S. Coast Guard Law Enforcement Detachment and a Helicopter Maritime Strike Squadron 48 detachment, supporting multiple successful interdictions that resulted in the seizure of more than 2,500 kilograms of illicit narcotics and the apprehension of suspected traffickers.

“The crew of USS Billings exemplified operational agility and dedication throughout this deployment," said Rear Adm. Carlos Sardiello, commander, U.S. Naval Forces Southern Command/U.S. 4th Fleet. "Whether executing high-stakes interdictions, transporting vital drinking water in support of disaster relief efforts, or contributing to coalition efforts, these Sailors helped impose total systemic friction on narco-terrorist networks, directly supporting the defense of the homeland and the security of the Western Hemisphere.”

Billings also strengthened maritime interoperability with Caribbean partners, including the Dominican Republic Navy and Jamaica Defence Force, to enhance information sharing and address shared security challenges. Additionally, the ship demonstrated its versatility by supporting humanitarian-assistance efforts following an earthquake in Venezuela in June, transporting more than 77,000 pounds of drinking water.

Billings departed Naval Station Mayport on March 27, 2026.

USS Billings is the first U.S. Navy ship to bear the name, honoring the city of Billings, Montana, and the enduring service, sacrifice, and patriotism of south-central Montana and the broader Big Sky region. Sailing under the motto "Big Sky Over Troubled Waters," the ship connects Montana’s proud heritage with the crew's dedication to defending freedom.

Commander, Naval Surface Force Atlantic is responsible for manning, training, and equipping assigned surface forces and shore activities, ensuring a capable and combat-ready force to support U.S. national interests. The SURFLANT force consists of more than 66 warships and 34 shore commands.

items.titleZh: 美国海军比林斯号（LCS 15）结束美国南方司令部部署返回梅波特海军基地
zhParas: 佛罗里达州梅波特海军基地——自由级濒海战斗舰比林斯号（LCS 15）在完成为期6个月、支援美国南方司令部（USSOUTHCOM）任务的美国第四舰队作战区域部署后，于2026年10月10日返回梅波特海军基地。
部署期间，比林斯号持续开展海上安全行动，以支持地区反非法贩运行动。舰员与随舰部署的美国海岸警卫队执法分队以及第48直升机海上打击中队分遣队协同行动，支持了多次成功拦截，缴获超过2,500公斤非法毒品，并逮捕了疑似贩运人员。
在整个部署期间，比林斯号舰员展现了作战灵活性和奉献精神，”美国海军南方司令部/美国第四舰队司令卡洛斯·萨尔迪耶洛海军少将表示。“无论是执行高风险拦截、为救灾行动运送重要饮用水，还是为联盟行动作出贡献，这些水兵都帮助对毒品恐怖主义网络施加了全面系统性阻力，直接支持了本土防御和西半球安全。
比林斯号还加强了与加勒比伙伴的海上互操作性，包括多米尼加共和国海军和牙买加国防军，以加强信息共享并应对共同安全挑战。此外，该舰还通过支援6月委内瑞拉地震后的人道主义援助行动，运送超过77,000磅饮用水，展示了其多用途能力。
比林斯号于2026年3月27日驶离梅波特海军基地。
比林斯号是美国海军第一艘以此名称命名的舰艇，旨在纪念蒙大拿州比林斯市，以及蒙大拿州中南部和更广泛的大天空地区持久的服役、牺牲和爱国精神。该舰以“浊浪之上的大天空”为格言航行，将蒙大拿引以为傲的传统与舰员捍卫自由的奉献精神联系在一起。
美海军大西洋水面部队司令负责为所属水面部队和岸上机构提供人员配备、训练和装备，确保拥有一支有能力且具备战备状态的力量，以支持美国利益。SURFLANT部队由超过66艘军舰和34个岸上司令部组成。
如需了解有关SURFLANT的更多信息，请访问Facebook.com/SURFLANT或www.surflant.usff.navy.mil。

items.title: Hoosier National Guard Soldiers ready for southwest border mission
items.author: CPT Robert Dunn
items.summary: CAMP ATTERBURY, Ind. – Approximately 125 Indiana National Guard Soldiers from the Plymouth-based 381st Military Police Company were honored during a departure ceremony at Camp Atterbury on Saturday, Oct. 10, 2026, as they prepare to deploy to the southwest U.S. border. The Hoosier Guardsmen will deploy to southern Texas in support of Operation Ardent Vanguard under Joint Task Force-Southern Border. In coordination with the Department of Homeland Security and U.S. Customs and Border Protection (C
items.body:
CAMP ATTERBURY - Approximately 125 Indiana National Guard Soldiers said goodbye to family, friends and loved ones during a departure ceremony at Camp Atterbury on Saturday.

The Hoosier Guardsmen from the 381st Military Police company in Plymouth will head for southern Texas with Joint Task-Force Southern Border in support of Operation Ardent Vanguard, in efforts to secure the U.S. border from unlawful mass migration, narcotics trafficking, human smuggling and trafficking, and other criminal activities.

"Our mission there is to support Customs and Border Protection. Essentially, we’re an extra set of eyes and ears on the southern border," said Capt. Jakob Young, commander of the 381st. “If a soldier sees something, they will communicate that via radio to CBP, stand by, and wait for them to arrive.”

The Guardsmen will assist the Department of Homeland Security and the U.S. Customs and Border Protection within narrowly defined authorities to provide unique military capabilities to protect the territorial integrity of the U.S. southern border.

"Our men and women in uniform are trained and ready to support the needs of our state and nation," said Indiana National Guard Maj. Gen. Justin Mann, commanding general of 81st Troop Command. “Those of us here at home have the responsibility to look after the families as their loved ones are deployed in uniform.”

While the mobilization will require leaving friends and family for almost a year, it provides an opportunity for the unit to draw closer together as a team. “Since we’re National Guardsmen, we normally only meet together once a month for training,” said Sgt. Richard Thoma, a team leader with the 381st. “It’s a chance to get to know my fellow soldiers better.”

This mobilization is unique in another aspect as well. Many of the Soldiers are volunteers from other Indiana National Guard units with a variety of military occupational specialties. Because they will receive specialized training from CBP prior to the mission, volunteers do not require a specific MOS to be added to the roster. The company includes medics, supply specialists, mechanics and others, in addition to military police.

“I think a lot of people are excited, especially soldiers coming from outside of the 381st,” said Sgt. Rosy Starrett, a team leader with the unit. “The volunteer spirit that comes from the soldiers coming from other units boosts morale. Knowing that people want to go has everyone looking forward to the mission.”

To prepare for the mission, the unit spent nearly a month training at Camp Atterbury. They will receive additional training at Fort Bliss and at the mission site.

“We have been able to get back to the basics. The individual soldier tasks we all learn at basic training. Getting back to the basics has been our priority,” said Young about the company’s preparation. “We’re prepared, we’re trained, and we’re ready to go execute the mission.”

The unit will replace the 38th Military Police Company from Monticello, Indiana, which is scheduled to return to Indiana in a few weeks.

The Indiana National Guard stands ready to help protect the border and nation. For more information about Operation Ardent Vanguard or Joint Task-Force Southern Border visit https://www.dvidshub.net/unit/OpAV or https://www.northcom.mil/BorderSecurity/#joint-task-forcesouthern-border . Email at mailto:JTF-SBMediaDesk@army.mil.
items.summaryZh: 印第安纳州阿特伯里营地——约125名来自驻普利茅斯的第381宪兵连的印第安纳国民警卫队士兵于2026年10月10日星期六在阿特伯里营地举行的出发仪式上受到表彰，他们正准备部署到美国西南边境。这些印第安纳州国民警卫队士兵将部署到得克萨斯州南部，在南部边境联合特遣部队下支援“炽热先锋”行动。此次部署正与美国国土安全部及美国海关与边境保护局（CBP）协调进行。
items.titleZh: 印第安纳国民警卫队士兵准备执行西南边境任务
zhParas: 阿特伯里营地——周六，约125名印第安纳国民警卫队士兵在阿特伯里营地举行的出发仪式上，与家人、朋友和亲人告别。
来自普利茅斯第381宪兵连的印第安纳州国民警卫队队员将随南部边境联合特遣部队前往得克萨斯州南部，支援“热忱先锋行动”，努力保卫美国边境，防范非法大规模移民、毒品贩运、人口走私和贩运以及其他犯罪活动。
我们在那里的任务是支援海关与边境保护局（CBP）。本质上，我们就是南部边境额外的一双眼睛和耳朵，”第381宪兵连指挥官雅各布·扬上尉说。“如果士兵看到什么，他们会通过无线电将情况通报给CBP，然后待命，等待他们到来。
国民警卫队员将在严格界定的权限范围内协助国土安全部和美国海关与边境保护局，提供独特的军事能力，以保护美国南部边境的领土完整。
我们身着军装的男女官兵训练有素，随时准备支援我们州和国家的需要，”印第安纳国民警卫队第81部队司令部司令贾斯汀·曼少将说。“我们这些留在国内的人有责任照顾那些亲人身着军装部署在外的家庭。
尽管此次动员将要求他们离开朋友和家人近一年，但这也为该部队提供了一个更加紧密团结为一个团队的机会。“由于我们是国民警卫队员，我们通常每月只集中一次进行训练，”第381宪兵连的小组长理查德·托马中士说。“这是更好地了解战友的机会。
这次动员在另一个方面也很独特。许多士兵是来自印第安纳州国民警卫队其他部队的志愿者，拥有各种不同的军事职业专业。由于他们将在任务前接受美国海关与边境保护局（CBP）的专门培训，志愿者加入名册不需要特定的军事职业专业（MOS）。该连除宪兵外，还包括卫生兵、补给专家、机械师及其他人员。
我认为很多人都很兴奋，尤其是来自第381宪兵连以外的士兵，”该部队的组长、中士罗西·斯塔雷特说。“来自其他部队的士兵所展现的志愿精神提振了士气。知道人们想去，让每个人都期待这次任务。
为准备这次任务，该部队在阿特伯里营进行了近一个月的训练。他们将在布利斯堡和任务现场接受额外训练。
我们得以回归基础。这些单兵任务都是我们在基础训练中都会学到的。回归基础一直是我们的首要任务，”扬在谈到该连的准备工作时说。“我们已做好准备，已接受训练，随时准备出发执行任务。
该部队将接替来自印第安纳州蒙蒂塞洛的第38宪兵连；该连计划于几周后返回印第安纳州。

印第安纳州国民警卫队随时准备帮助保护边境和国家。欲了解更多关于“热忱先锋行动”或南部边境联合特遣部队的信息，请访问 https://www.dvidshub.net/unit/OpAV 或 https://www.northcom.mil/BorderSecurity/#joint-task-forcesouthern-border 。电子邮件：mailto:JTF-SBMediaDesk@army.mil。

items.title: NMRTC Patuxent River and NAS Pax River ‘SAR Dogs’ Partner for Combat Casualty Readiness Exercise
items.author: Maria Scott
items.summary: Navy Medicine Readiness and Training Command Patuxent River executed the Annual Proficiency Expeditionary eXercise (APEX) at Naval Air Station Patuxent River. NMRTC Patuxent River partnered with Naval Air Station Patuxent River Search and Rescue (SAR Dogs) to test joint Tactical Combat Casualty Care and dynamic evacuation procedures. The exercise served as the culmination of dedicated preparation and consistent "Warrior Wednesdays" readiness training. The APEX challenged clinic personnel across
items.body:
What began as a quiet foot patrol along a tree-lined trail quickly shifted into tactical friction as simulated gunfire erupted, forcing Navy Medicine personnel to treat and evacuate casualties under simulated combat conditions. Only after securing and triaging each patient did ground personnel transmit 9-line requests to call in Search and Rescue (SAR) helicopters for tactical evacuation. The dynamic trauma lane scenario served as the cornerstone of the Annual Proficiency Expeditionary eXercise (APEX), testing joint medical readiness and Tactical Combat Casualty Care (TCCC) integration.

Hosted by Navy Medicine Readiness and Training Command (NMRTC) Patuxent River under the leadership of Capt. Ken Radford, the APEX brought together clinic personnel and the Naval Air Station Patuxent River Search and Rescue unit (SAR Dogs) in a close operational partnership. Designed to elevate joint combat readiness, the evolution required pausing routine patient care operations for the day across NMRTC Patuxent River and its outlying components—Navy Medicine Readiness and Training Unit (NMRTU) Dahlgren, NMRTC Detachment Indian Head, and NMRTC Detachment Joint Base Andrews. This rare operational posture enabled physicians, physician assistants, nurses, independent duty corpsmen, and hospital corpsmen to dedicate uninterrupted hours to practicing life-saving skills under realistic battlefield conditions. The coordination offered Military Treatment Facility (MTF) personnel vital, rarely experienced exposure to Tactical Evacuation Care (TACEVAC) protocols and live rotary-wing patient handoffs.

The exercise featured five training areas, with five participant groups rotating through four static skill stations and a dynamic trauma lane. Operating under simulated gunfire and armed cover from a security element, teams located and treated four distinct casualties: two mannequins with significant physical trauma, a live role-player with physical trauma, and another live role-player presenting with acute mental health needs. At the static stations, personnel practiced core Tier 3 TCCC skills, including cricothyroidotomies, intravenous and intraosseous vascular access, needle decompressions, and suturing.

“Designing APEX was about bridging advanced technical skill with the demands of a stressful tactical environment that mimics combat,” said Hospital Corpsman 1st Class Tyler Kelly, a Surface Force Independent Duty Corpsman who coordinated the static station curriculum and dynamic trauma lane scenarios. “We focused the static stations on advanced-level Tactical Combat Casualty Care skills, giving providers the opportunity to mentor teams through complex procedures. In the trauma lane, we demonstrate that these situations are chaotic and difficult; we are building their confidence to trust in their training even in a stressful situation. Just as importantly, we integrated an evacuation platform to address the often-overlooked transition from Tactical Field Care to Tactical Evacuation Care. The SAR team at Pax was critical in demonstrating how teams on the ground need to move patients safely and communicate effectively. By blending advanced instruction with tactical scenarios, we ensure our Sailors do not just know the medicine—they know how to execute it under fire and sustain that care through evacuation.”

Building on a smaller-scale joint event held with the SAR Dogs in March, NMRTC Patuxent River leadership connected with Lt. Noah Becker to expand and plan the much larger scope of the APEX. The initial collaboration kicked off months of detailed work to align exercise mechanics with real-world operational tactics. On the day of the exercise, Becker led the safety brief before directing execution on the ground and across the flight timeline, ensuring communications between medical triage elements and incoming aircraft mirrored tactical operational tempo. Ground crew transmitted standard 9-line MEDEVAC requests to call in aircraft support, prompting multiple dynamic helicopter landings throughout the day. Once on the ground, the aircrew deployed SAR Medical Technicians (SMTs) to assess patient packaging, take turnover from ground corpsmen, and prepare for tactical evacuation.

“The APEX event is the culmination of months of hard work and training for both the Station SAR unit and the Clinic staff,” said Cmdr. Deidre Coulson-Tucker, NAS Patuxent River Air Operations Officer and NAS Patuxent River Station SAR Officer in Charge. “This exercise allows for our SAR Medical Technicians to show the other clinic staff the breadth of their expertise and embodies the SAR motto ‘So Others May Live.’”

The success of APEX reflects a broader, deliberate strategy across the command to deliver and sustain a whole, ready Naval medical force. Operating under a dual-hatted structure, the command manages routine primary care and beneficiary health services as Naval Health Clinic Patuxent River under the Defense Health Agency, while simultaneously maintaining warfighter readiness, overseas suitability, and operational deployability as NMRTC Patuxent River under Navy Medicine. Because the vast majority of the command’s daily focus is dedicated to direct patient care as a Military Treatment Facility, high-yield training opportunities for expeditionary readiness cannot be left to chance. Instead, readiness training must be deliberately prepared, executed, and integrated into the command's operational schedule.

“The APEX combat casualty readiness event is our signature culminating training event,” said Capt. Ken Radford, commanding officer of NMRTC Patuxent River. “Our Pax River officers and corpsmen used skills we’ve developed over the prior year to perform TCCC in stressful combat-related scenarios to ensure they are a ready medical force to care for those in harm’s way. A training event on this scale is not possible without incredible planning and execution. HM1 Alcius and HM1 Kelly took ownership of this training event and it would not have been possible without their dedication and support.”

To bridge clinical care with combat readiness, Capt. Ken Radford directed early Wednesday afternoon clinic closures across all sites, establishing dedicated time for all-hands readiness training. Focused on Tier 3 TCCC skills, the initiative grew from a January pilot in Medical Homeport led by Cmdr. MaryPat Tobola. Hospital Corpsman 1st Class Erlande Alcius and the Staff Education and Training department helped guide instruction from the start, expanding "Warrior Wednesdays" command-wide in April to establish the steady operational rhythm that culminated in APEX.

“Stepping out of the clinic and into the field proved just how far our teams have come since we launched 'Warrior Wednesdays,'” said Hospital Corpsman 1st Class Erlande Alcius, leading petty officer for the Staff Education and Training department at NMRTC Patuxent River. “Building TCCC into our regular operational rhythm gave everyone a shared muscle memory. The APEX was the ultimate test of that baseline—showing that when stress and chaos are introduced, our providers and corpsmen fall back on their training without skipping a beat. None of this would have been possible without our incredible command instructors and preceptors, whose encouragement and instruction at the static stations helped ensure our personnel will be better prepared before stepping into the field.”

The APEX also served as a practical learning experience for future leaders. Observing the evolution were cadets from the Air Force Junior ROTC program at Chopticon High School, accompanied by their instructor, retired Master Sgt. Kim Hoh. Watching corpsmen and SAR aircrew navigate tactical movement, triage, and live-actor treatment offered the cadets a firsthand look at joint expeditionary medicine and military operational readiness in action. “It was a great experience seeing how medical personnel received hands-on trauma training they might not experience every day,” said Chopticon Air Force JROTC Cadet Capt. Peyton Moore. “For me, it encouraged me to continue down the medical path.”

The successful execution of the APEX was made possible through extensive coordination across Naval Air Station Patuxent River tenant commands and base installation partners. Command leadership expressed gratitude for key support from NAS Patuxent River Commanding Officer Capt. Robert Chandler, whose authorization ensured the necessary installation space and operational assets were available for the readiness evolution. Special appreciation was extended to the NAS Patuxent River Morale, Welfare, and Recreation staff, in particular Mr. Mardy Millen, for facilitating the use of the West Basin Marina for the entire event. Leadership also recognized the vital support provided by base partners, including the installation Security Department's Masters-at-Arms for supplying the rubber training rifles used throughout the tactical scenarios.

items.titleZh: 帕塔克森特河海军医学战备与训练司令部与帕塔克森特河海军航空站‘SAR Dogs’搜救队合作开展战斗伤员战备演习
zhParas: 一场沿林荫小径进行的安静徒步巡逻，随着模拟枪声骤起，迅速转为战术摩擦，迫使海军医务人员在模拟战斗条件下救治和后送伤员。地面人员只有在确保安全并对每名伤员完成检伤分类后，才发送9行请求，呼叫搜救（SAR）直升机实施战术后送。这一动态创伤训练道想定是年度熟练远征演习（APEX）的核心，检验了联合医疗战备和战术战伤救治（TCCC）的整合。

由海军医学战备与训练司令部（NMRTC）帕塔克森特河主办，在肯·拉德福德上校领导下，APEX将诊所人员与海军航空站帕塔克森特河搜救队（SAR Dogs）聚集在一起，建立紧密的行动伙伴关系。为提升联合战斗战备，此次演练要求NMRTC帕塔克森特河及其外围组成部分——海军医学战备与训练部队（NMRTU）达尔格伦、NMRTC印度头分队和NMRTC安德鲁斯联合基地分队——暂停当天日常患者护理工作。这一罕见行动姿态使医生、医师助理、护士、独立值班医务兵和医院医务兵能够投入不受干扰的数小时，在逼真战场条件下练习救命技能。此次协调为军事治疗设施（MTF）人员提供了至关重要且难得经历的战术后送救治（TACEVAC）规程接触以及旋翼机实机患者交接机会。
演习设有五个训练区域，五个参训小组轮流完成四个静态技能站和一个动态创伤训练道。在模拟枪声和安保分队武装掩护下，各队定位并救治四类不同伤员：两个有明显身体创伤的假人、一名有身体创伤的真人扮演者，以及另一名表现为急性心理健康需求的真人扮演者。在静态站，人员练习三级TCCC核心技能，包括环甲膜切开术、静脉和骨髓腔内血管通路、针刺减压和缝合。

设计APEX的关键在于将高级技术技能与模拟战斗的高压战术环境需求相结合，”负责协调静态站课程和动态创伤训练道想定的水面部队独立值班医务兵、一等医院医务兵泰勒·凯利说。“我们将静态站重点放在高级战术战伤救治技能上，让施救人员有机会指导团队完成复杂操作。在创伤训练道，我们展示这些情况混乱且困难；我们正在建立他们的信心，使他们即使在高压情况下也能信任自己的训练。同样重要的是，我们整合了一个后送平台，以解决从战术现场救治到战术后送救治这一常被忽视的过渡。帕塔克森特河的SAR团队在展示地面团队如何安全转移患者并有效沟通方面至关重要。通过将高级教学与战术想定相结合，我们确保我们的水兵不仅懂医学，而且知道如何在火力下执行医学救治，并在整个后送过程中维持这种救治。

在3月与SAR Dogs举行的一次较小规模联合活动基础上，NMRTC帕塔克森特河领导层与诺亚·贝克尔上尉联系，以扩大并规划规模大得多的APEX。最初的合作启动了数月细致工作，使演习机制与真实世界行动战术保持一致。演习当天，贝克尔在指导地面和整个飞行时间线执行之前主持了安全简报，确保医疗检伤分类分队与进场飞机之间的通信与战术行动节奏一致。地面人员发送标准9行医疗后送请求以呼叫飞机支援，促使全天多次动态直升机着陆。着陆后，机组人员派出搜救医疗技师（SMT），评估伤员固定情况，从地面医务兵处接管移交，并为战术后送做准备。
APEX活动是站内SAR部队和诊所工作人员数月辛勤工作和训练的成果，”海军航空站帕塔克森特河航空作战官兼海军航空站帕塔克森特河站SAR负责人、中校迪德丽·科尔森-塔克说。“这次演习让我们搜救医疗技师向其他诊所人员展示其专业技能的广度，并体现了SAR的座右铭‘为了他人能活下来’。

APEX的成功反映了该司令部一项更广泛、深思熟虑的战略：打造并维持一支完整、具备战备状态的海军医疗力量。该司令部采用双重职责架构，作为国防卫生局下属的帕塔克森特河海军健康诊所，负责日常初级保健和受益人健康服务；同时作为海军医学下属的帕塔克森特河海军医学战备与训练司令部，维持作战人员战备、海外适应性和作战部署能力。由于该司令部日常工作的绝大多数精力都用于作为军事治疗设施提供直接患者护理，远征战备方面高效益的训练机会不能听任偶然。相反，战备训练必须有意识地筹划、实施，并纳入司令部的运行日程。
APEX战斗伤员战备活动是我们标志性的收官训练活动，”帕塔克森特河海军医学战备与训练司令部指挥官肯·拉德福德上校说。“我们帕克斯河的军官和医务兵运用过去一年培养的技能，在高压战斗相关情景中实施战术战伤救治，以确保他们是一支战备医疗力量，能够救治身处险境者。如此规模的训练活动，离不开出色的筹划与执行。HM1阿尔修斯和HM1凯利主导了这次训练活动，若没有他们的奉献与支持，这次活动不可能实现。
为将临床医疗与战斗战备衔接起来，肯·拉德福德上校指示周三下午所有站点诊所提前关闭，为全员战备训练留出专门时间。该举措聚焦三级战术战伤救治技能，源于1月由玛丽帕特·托博拉中校在医疗母港主导的试点。海军一等医务兵埃兰德·阿尔修斯和人员教育与训练部从一开始就协助指导教学，并于4月将“勇士星期三”推广至全司令部，建立起稳定的运行节奏，最终促成APEX。

走出诊所、进入野外，证明了自我们启动‘勇士星期三’以来，各团队取得了多大进步，”帕塔克森特河海军医学战备与训练司令部人员教育与训练部主管军士、海军一等医务兵埃兰德·阿尔修斯说。“将TCCC纳入我们的日常运行节奏，让每个人都形成了共同的肌肉记忆。APEX是对这一基准的终极检验——表明当引入压力和混乱时，我们的医护人员和医务兵会依靠训练，毫不慌乱。若没有我们出色的司令部教官和带教人员，这一切都不可能实现；他们在静态训练站的鼓励和指导，帮助确保我们的人员在进入野外前准备得更充分。

APEX也为未来领导者提供了一次实践学习经历。观察此次演练的有乔普蒂康高中空军初级预备军官训练团的学员，由他们的教官、退役军士长金·霍陪同。观看医务兵和搜救机组人员完成战术移动、检伤分类和真人模拟伤员救治，让学员们亲身了解了联合远征医学和军事作战战备的实际运作。“看到医疗人员接受他们可能并非每天都能经历的实操创伤训练，这是一次很棒的经历，”乔普蒂康高中空军初级预备军官训练团学员上尉佩顿·摩尔说。“对我来说，这鼓励我继续走医学道路。

APEX的成功实施，得益于帕塔克森特河海军航空站各驻站司令部与基地设施伙伴之间的广泛协调。司令部领导感谢帕塔克森特河海军航空站指挥官罗伯特·钱德勒上校的关键支持，他的授权确保此次战备演练获得必要的设施空间和作战资产。特别感谢帕塔克森特河海军航空站士气、福利与娱乐部门工作人员，尤其是马迪·米伦先生，为整个活动使用西盆地码头提供了便利。领导层还表彰了基地伙伴提供的重要支持，包括基地安全部门的海军宪兵提供贯穿各战术想定使用的橡皮训练步枪。
items.zhFull:
一场沿林荫小径进行的安静徒步巡逻，随着模拟枪声骤起，迅速转为战术摩擦，迫使海军医务人员在模拟战斗条件下救治和后送伤员。地面人员只有在确保安全并对每名伤员完成检伤分类后，才发送9行请求，呼叫搜救（SAR）直升机实施战术后送。这一动态创伤训练道想定是年度熟练远征演习（APEX）的核心，检验了联合医疗战备和战术战伤救治（TCCC）的整合。

由海军医学战备与训练司令部（NMRTC）帕塔克森特河主办，在肯·拉德福德上校领导下，APEX将诊所人员与海军航空站帕塔克森特河搜救队（SAR Dogs）聚集在一起，建立紧密的行动伙伴关系。为提升联合战斗战备，此次演练要求NMRTC帕塔克森特河及其外围组成部分——海军医学战备与训练部队（NMRTU）达尔格伦、NMRTC印度头分队和NMRTC安德鲁斯联合基地分队——暂停当天日常患者护理工作。这一罕见行动姿态使医生、医师助理、护士、独立值班医务兵和医院医务兵能够投入不受干扰的数小时，在逼真战场条件下练习救命技能。此次协调为军事治疗设施（MTF）人员提供了至关重要且难得经历的战术后送救治（TACEVAC）规程接触以及旋翼机实机患者交接机会。

演习设有五个训练区域，五个参训小组轮流完成四个静态技能站和一个动态创伤训练道。在模拟枪声和安保分队武装掩护下，各队定位并救治四类不同伤员：两个有明显身体创伤的假人、一名有身体创伤的真人扮演者，以及另一名表现为急性心理健康需求的真人扮演者。在静态站，人员练习三级TCCC核心技能，包括环甲膜切开术、静脉和骨髓腔内血管通路、针刺减压和缝合。

设计APEX的关键在于将高级技术技能与模拟战斗的高压战术环境需求相结合，”负责协调静态站课程和动态创伤训练道想定的水面部队独立值班医务兵、一等医院医务兵泰勒·凯利说。“我们将静态站重点放在高级战术战伤救治技能上，让施救人员有机会指导团队完成复杂操作。在创伤训练道，我们展示这些情况混乱且困难；我们正在建立他们的信心，使他们即使在高压情况下也能信任自己的训练。同样重要的是，我们整合了一个后送平台，以解决从战术现场救治到战术后送救治这一常被忽视的过渡。帕塔克森特河的SAR团队在展示地面团队如何安全转移患者并有效沟通方面至关重要。通过将高级教学与战术想定相结合，我们确保我们的水兵不仅懂医学，而且知道如何在火力下执行医学救治，并在整个后送过程中维持这种救治。

在3月与SAR Dogs举行的一次较小规模联合活动基础上，NMRTC帕塔克森特河领导层与诺亚·贝克尔上尉联系，以扩大并规划规模大得多的APEX。最初的合作启动了数月细致工作，使演习机制与真实世界行动战术保持一致。演习当天，贝克尔在指导地面和整个飞行时间线执行之前主持了安全简报，确保医疗检伤分类分队与进场飞机之间的通信与战术行动节奏一致。地面人员发送标准9行医疗后送请求以呼叫飞机支援，促使全天多次动态直升机着陆。着陆后，机组人员派出搜救医疗技师（SMT），评估伤员固定情况，从地面医务兵处接管移交，并为战术后送做准备。

APEX活动是站内SAR部队和诊所工作人员数月辛勤工作和训练的成果，”海军航空站帕塔克森特河航空作战官兼海军航空站帕塔克森特河站SAR负责人、中校迪德丽·科尔森-塔克说。“这次演习让我们搜救医疗技师向其他诊所人员展示其专业技能的广度，并体现了SAR的座右铭‘为了他人能活下来’。

APEX的成功反映了该司令部一项更广泛、深思熟虑的战略：打造并维持一支完整、具备战备状态的海军医疗力量。该司令部采用双重职责架构，作为国防卫生局下属的帕塔克森特河海军健康诊所，负责日常初级保健和受益人健康服务；同时作为海军医学下属的帕塔克森特河海军医学战备与训练司令部，维持作战人员战备、海外适应性和作战部署能力。由于该司令部日常工作的绝大多数精力都用于作为军事治疗设施提供直接患者护理，远征战备方面高效益的训练机会不能听任偶然。相反，战备训练必须有意识地筹划、实施，并纳入司令部的运行日程。

APEX战斗伤员战备活动是我们标志性的收官训练活动，”帕塔克森特河海军医学战备与训练司令部指挥官肯·拉德福德上校说。“我们帕克斯河的军官和医务兵运用过去一年培养的技能，在高压战斗相关情景中实施战术战伤救治，以确保他们是一支战备医疗力量，能够救治身处险境者。如此规模的训练活动，离不开出色的筹划与执行。HM1阿尔修斯和HM1凯利主导了这次训练活动，若没有他们的奉献与支持，这次活动不可能实现。

为将临床医疗与战斗战备衔接起来，肯·拉德福德上校指示周三下午所有站点诊所提前关闭，为全员战备训练留出专门时间。该举措聚焦三级战术战伤救治技能，源于1月由玛丽帕特·托博拉中校在医疗母港主导的试点。海军一等医务兵埃兰德·阿尔修斯和人员教育与训练部从一开始就协助指导教学，并于4月将“勇士星期三”推广至全司令部，建立起稳定的运行节奏，最终促成APEX。

走出诊所、进入野外，证明了自我们启动‘勇士星期三’以来，各团队取得了多大进步，”帕塔克森特河海军医学战备与训练司令部人员教育与训练部主管军士、海军一等医务兵埃兰德·阿尔修斯说。“将TCCC纳入我们的日常运行节奏，让每个人都形成了共同的肌肉记忆。APEX是对这一基准的终极检验——表明当引入压力和混乱时，我们的医护人员和医务兵会依靠训练，毫不慌乱。若没有我们出色的司令部教官和带教人员，这一切都不可能实现；他们在静态训练站的鼓励和指导，帮助确保我们的人员在进入野外前准备得更充分。

items.author: Joseph Jones

items.body:
JOINT BASE LEWIS-McCHORD, Washington — What began as a routine commute to work on October 5 quickly became anything but routine for Sgt. 1st Class Jeff Hytower.

Hytower, a practical nursing specialist assigned to Madigan Army Medical Center, was driving to Joint Base Lewis-McChord when he encountered the aftermath of a serious vehicle crash on Interstate 5 near DuPont, Washington.

Seeing that help might be needed, Hytower turned around, activated his hazard lights and found a safe location to stop.

“I just jumped up, it was just instinct,” Hytower said. “That’s when training kicks in.”

As he approached an overturned SUV, Hytower quickly realized the emergency extended far beyond injuries from a vehicle collision. He saw a woman, presumably from the accident, wielding a knife and attacking her two children.

Hytower moved in rapidly to intervene.

“Once I saw the knife… I was just trying to isolate that knife from anyone trying to cause harm,” Hytower said.

Fortunately, Hytower was not alone. Other service members independently stopped to help, quickly forming an ad-hoc team on the shoulder of the interstate.

Sgt. Ricardo Nunez, assigned to the 7th Infantry Division, assisted Hytower in disarming and restraining the woman. Washington National Guard combat medic Sgt. Alexis McKay also responded, providing medical assistance and comfort to one of the injured children until law enforcement arrived.

Once the immediate threat was controlled, Hytower turned his attention to reassuring the two children. As a parent, seeing their fear affected him personally.

“None of us stopped that morning expecting anything like this to happen,” Hytower said. “We just saw people who needed help and did what we would want others to do for us and our families. I also think it shows the importance of teamwork. Everyone there played a part, whether it was providing medical care, keeping the kids calm, calling for help, or making sure the situation stayed safe. We weren’t looking for recognition; we were just trying to do the right thing.”

For Hytower, his decisive actions reflected the high-stakes readiness he practices and teaches daily at Madigan.

As a practical nursing specialist, Hytower helps train service members in patient care using realistic medical simulation. Madigan’s advanced simulation capabilities allow medical personnel to practice responding to complex patient scenarios using high-fidelity mannequins that replicate breathing, heart sounds, coughing and other critical clinical conditions.

Hytower’s response also reflects Madigan’s broader commitment to medical readiness and hands-on training. Through a range of clinical education, trauma-response and military medical training programs, Madigan prepares service members to assess rapidly changing situations, respond under pressure and provide lifesaving care when it matters most.

As an instructor within that training environment, Hytower helps reinforce the same skills, judgment and readiness that carry from the classroom and clinical setting into unexpected real-world emergencies.

The heroic, collaborative response of the joint service members drew high praise from local military leadership.

"The rapid, decisive actions of Sgt. 1st Class Hytower, Sgt. Nunez, and Sgt. McKay represent the very best of our profession," said Command Sgt. Maj. Gary D. Petty, the senior enlisted adviser for Madigan Army Medical Center.

"When confronted with a chaotic and dangerous situation, these soldiers didn’t hesitate," Petty said. "They relied on their training, placed themselves between danger and the vulnerable, and saved lives. I am incredibly proud of their courage, their bias for action, and their absolute commitment to protecting others."

Several service members helped detain the suspect until Washington State Patrol personnel arrived and assumed responsibility for the investigation.

For Hytower, the interstate rescue serves as a stark reminder of why rigorous military training matters long before a crisis occurs.

“I think the biggest thing was just being able to stay calm and assess what was happening,” Hytower said. “With both my Soldier and medical training, you’re taught to quickly figure out what needs to be done and prioritize what’s most important. At first, our focus was making sure everyone involved in the accident was okay and getting them the help they needed. When the situation suddenly changed, we were able to react quickly and make sure everyone was safe. A lot of that comes from the training we’ve received and being able to fall back on it without really having to think about it."
items.titleZh: 从模拟到街头：马迪根训练如何让一名士兵在5号州际公路上挽救生命
items.summaryZh: 华盛顿州刘易斯-麦科德联合基地——2026年10月5日，对三级军士长杰夫·海托尔而言，原本例行的上班通勤很快就变得毫不寻常。海托尔是派驻马迪根陆军医疗中心的一名实用护理专科人员，当时正驾车前往刘易斯-麦科德联合基地，却在华盛顿州杜邦附近的5号州际公路上遇到一起严重车辆事故的现场。意识到可能需要帮助，海托尔掉头，打开危险警示灯，并找到一处安全位置。
zhParas: 华盛顿州刘易斯-麦科德联合基地——10月5日，对三级军士长杰夫·海托尔而言，原本例行的上班通勤很快就变得毫不寻常。
海托尔是派驻马迪根陆军医疗中心的实用护理专科人员，当时正驾车前往刘易斯-麦科德联合基地，却在华盛顿州杜邦附近的5号州际公路上遇到一起严重车祸后的现场。
看到可能需要帮助，海托尔掉转车头，打开危险警示灯，并找到一处安全地点停车。
我一下子就跳了起来，那纯粹是本能，”海托尔说，“就在那时，训练开始起作用了。
当他走近一辆侧翻的SUV时，海托尔很快意识到，这起紧急情况远不止车辆碰撞造成的伤害。他看到一名女子——据推测是事故相关人员——正挥舞着刀袭击她的两个孩子。
海托尔迅速上前干预。
一看到那把刀……我只是想把那把刀和任何想伤害他人的人隔开，”海托尔说。
幸运的是，海托尔并非孤身一人。其他军人也各自停下车来帮忙，很快在州际公路路肩上临时组成了一支小组。
隶属于第7步兵师的中士里卡多·努涅斯协助海托尔解除了该女子的武装并将其制服。华盛顿国民警卫队战斗医护兵中士亚历克西斯·麦凯也赶到了现场，为其中一名受伤儿童提供医疗救助和安抚，直到执法人员赶到。
直接威胁得到控制后，海托尔将注意力转向安抚那两个孩子。身为一名家长，看到他们的恐惧让他深受触动。
那天早上我们停下来时，谁都没料到会发生这样的事，”海托尔说。“我们只是看到有人需要帮助，就做了我们希望别人能为我们和我们的家人做的事。我还认为，这体现了团队合作的重要性。在场的每个人都出了一份力，无论是提供医疗救护、安抚孩子们、呼救，还是确保现场保持安全。我们并不是为了得到认可；我们只是想做正确的事。
对海托尔而言，他的果断行动体现了他在马迪根每天实践并教授的高风险战备能力。
作为一名实用护理专科人员，海托尔利用逼真的医疗模拟帮助训练军人在患者护理方面的技能。马迪根先进的模拟能力使医务人员能够使用高仿真人体模型练习应对复杂的患者情景，这些模型可模拟呼吸、心音、咳嗽及其他关键临床状况。
海托尔的应对也体现了马迪根对医疗战备和实操训练的更广泛承诺。通过一系列临床教育、创伤应对和军事医疗培训项目，马迪根让军人做好准备，以评估迅速变化的情况、在压力下作出反应，并在关键时刻提供救生护理。
作为该培训环境中的教官，海托尔帮助强化同样的技能、判断力和战备素养，使它们从课堂和临床环境延续到突发的现实紧急情况中。
这些联合部队军人英勇而协作的应对，赢得了当地军方领导层的高度赞扬。
一等军士海托尔、中士努涅斯和中士麦凯迅速而果断的行动，代表了我们这一职业的最高水准，”马迪根陆军医疗中心高级士兵顾问、指挥军士长加里·D·佩蒂说。
当面对混乱而危险的局面时，这些士兵没有犹豫，”佩蒂说。“他们依靠自己的训练，把自己置于危险与弱势者之间，并挽救了生命。我为他们的勇气、他们勇于行动的作风以及他们对保护他人的绝对承诺感到无比自豪。
几名军人协助拘留了嫌疑人，直到华盛顿州巡警人员赶到并接管调查工作。
对海托尔而言，这次州际公路上的救援鲜明地提醒他，为什么严格的军事训练在危机发生之前很久就至关重要。
我认为最重要的一点就是能够保持冷静，并评估当时正在发生什么，”海托尔说。“凭借我的军人训练和医疗训练，你会被教导要迅速弄清需要做什么，并优先处理最重要的事情。起初，我们的重点是确保事故中的每个人都平安无事，并让他们得到所需的帮助。当情况突然变化时，我们能够迅速反应，确保所有人都安全。这在很大程度上来自我们接受的训练，以及能够不加思索地依靠它。

海托尔是派驻马迪根陆军医疗中心的实用护理专科人员，当时正驾车前往刘易斯-麦科德联合基地，却在华盛顿州杜邦附近的5号州际公路上遇到一起严重车祸后的现场。

看到可能需要帮助，海托尔掉转车头，打开危险警示灯，并找到一处安全地点停车。

我一下子就跳了起来，那纯粹是本能，”海托尔说，“就在那时，训练开始起作用了。

海托尔迅速上前干预。

items.title: Forge the Fight: 33rd RGS and 392nd CTS Deliver High-Fidelity Cyber Training
items.author: April Crew-Kelly
items.summary: Forge the Fight: 33rd RGS and 392nd CTS Deliver High-Fidelity Cyber Training By: Space Training and Readiness Command Public Affairs In a successful demonstration of operational cyber readiness, the 33rd Range and Aggressor Squadron executed Magenta Stars in partnership with the 392nd Combat Training Squadron late last month. The exercise put the 69th Cyberspace Squadron’s operators through rigorous, high-fidelity threat scenarios testing their ability to safeguard operational space networks.
items.body:
In a successful demonstration of operational cyber readiness, the 33rd Range and Aggressor Squadron executed Magenta Stars in partnership with the 392nd Combat Training Squadron late last month. The exercise put the 69th Cyberspace Squadron’s operators through rigorous, high-fidelity threat scenarios testing their ability to safeguard operational space networks.

Space Delta 11’s 33rd RGS designed the exercise to support the Space Force Generation readiness validation cycle for the 69th CYS. Over three days of simulated adversarial intrusions, two defensive cyber crews met the challenge detecting, tracking, and neutralizing persistent adversarial presence across simulated operational space networks.

“We asked our mission partners for unmet training requirements, and the 69th CYS responded,” said Maj. Eric A. Merris, 33rd RGS deputy commander. “The 392nd Combat Training Squadron and 33rd RGS combined efforts to dynamically plan and execute a high-impact exercise on an exceptionally condensed timeline. It was impressive how fast the teams adapted to meet rapidly evolving operational demands.”

The 69th CYS conducts defensive cyber operations in support of Space Delta 9’s orbital warfare mission. To help defenders protect critical space-domain mission terrain, the 33rd RGS engineering team deployed a simulated environment: a high-fidelity live cyber range designed to replicate space mission architectures.

The exercise relied on coordination across multiple specialty teams. The 392nd CTS provided the space and equipment for the event, while the 33rd RGS delivered the range environment and aggressor support.

The aggressors employed realistic tactics, techniques and procedures based on active, real-world advanced persistent threats. Working through each phase of the cyber kill chain, the aggressors conducted sustained attacks to test and evaluate the blue team’s defensive posture. The 69th CYS Guardians responded by characterizing malicious network activity, maintaining situational awareness and mitigating threats.

By combining higher-fidelity range virtualization with realistic threat emulation, Magenta Stars reinforced the link between space mission assurance and operationally relevant training that develops combat credibility. The exercise’s goal was to prepare Guardians to remain vigilant, resilient and ready to defend the nation’s space assets in cyberspace, according to the exercise organizers.

“This exercise provided an excellent opportunity for our operators to flex their detection and remediation skills,” said 1st Lt. Benjamin Pederson, 69th CYS. “It also allowed our operators to receive an in-depth walkthrough at the end of execution to collaborate with the aggressors on techniques for improving our threat detection.”
items.titleZh: 为战而铸：第33靶场与假想敌中队和第392战斗训练中队开展高保真网络训练
items.summaryZh: 为战而铸：第33靶场与假想敌中队和第392战斗训练中队开展高保真网络训练 作者：太空训练与战备司令部公共事务处 在上月末一次成功的作战网络战备演示中，第33靶场与假想敌中队与第392战斗训练中队合作实施了“Magenta Stars”演习。此次演习让第69网络空间中队的操作人员经历严格、高保真的威胁场景，检验他们保护作战太空网络的能力。
zhParas: 在上月末一次成功的作战网络战备演示中，第33靶场与假想敌中队与第392战斗训练中队合作实施了“Magenta Stars”演习。此次演习让第69网络空间中队的操作人员经历严格、高保真的威胁场景，检验他们保护作战太空网络的能力。
太空三角洲11的第33靶场与假想敌中队设计此次演习，以支持第69网络空间中队的太空军生成战备验证周期。在为期三天的模拟对手入侵中，两支防御性网络小组迎接挑战，在模拟作战太空网络中检测、跟踪并消除持续存在的对手。
我们向任务伙伴询问了未满足的训练需求，第69网络空间中队作出了回应，”第33靶场与假想敌中队副指挥官埃里克·A·梅里斯少校说。“第392战斗训练中队和第33靶场与假想敌中队合力，在极其压缩的时间表内动态规划并执行了一次高影响力演习。各团队适应速度之快、以满足快速演变的作战需求，令人印象深刻。
第69网络空间中队开展防御性网络行动，以支持太空三角洲9的轨道战任务。为帮助防御者保护关键的太空域任务地形，第33靶场与假想敌中队工程团队部署了一个模拟环境：一个旨在复现太空任务体系架构的高保真实时网络靶场。
此次演习依赖多个专业团队之间的协调。第392战斗训练中队为活动提供了场地和设备，而第33靶场与假想敌中队提供了靶场环境和假想敌支持。
假想敌采用了基于现实世界中活跃的高级持续性威胁的逼真战术、技术和程序。他们贯穿网络杀伤链的每个阶段，实施持续攻击，以测试和评估蓝队的防御态势。第69网络空间中队的‘卫士’通过描述恶意网络活动特征、保持态势感知并缓解威胁来应对。
通过将更高保真度的靶场虚拟化与逼真的威胁模拟相结合，Magenta Stars演习强化了太空任务保障与能够培养作战可信度的实战相关训练之间的联系。据演习组织者称，此次演习的目标是让守护者保持警惕、具备韧性，并随时准备在网络空间中保卫国家的太空资产。

items.title: Lockheed Martin unveils PAC-3 Edge interceptor designed to counter hypersonic threats
items.author: Reuters
items.summary: Lockheed Martin said PAC-3 Edge incorporates a new seeker, upgraded flight controls and a multi-pulse rocket motor supplied by Northrop Grumman.
items.body:
Lockheed Martin on Friday unveiled PAC-3 Edge, a missile interceptor designed to defend against hypersonic and advanced missile threats, as the U.S. military looks to strengthen its capabilities to counter emerging aerial threats.

Growing demand for air and missile defense systems amid conflicts in Ukraine and the Middle East has strained U.S. weapons stockpiles, prompting the U.S. Army to award Lockheed Martin a contract worth up to $58.6 billion in July to ramp up production of PAC-3 interceptors.

Lockheed Martin said PAC-3 Edge incorporates a new seeker, upgraded flight controls and a multi-pulse rocket motor supplied by Northrop Grumman, enhancing the interceptor’s ability to counter advanced threats, including hypersonic missiles, at longer ranges and higher altitudes.

“The cost of this would be about that of the existing PAC-3 MSE,” Tim Cahill, president of missiles and fire control at Lockheed Martin, told Reuters. “At full production, the annual rate would be about 2,000 units a year, comparable with PAC-3 MSE.”

In January, Lockheed Martin signed a seven-year framework agreement with the Pentagon to expand production of its PAC-3 missile interceptors, aiming to increase annual manufacturing capacity to 2,000 units from about 600.
items.titleZh: 洛克希德·马丁公司推出PAC-3 Edge拦截弹，旨在对抗高超声速威胁
items.summaryZh: 洛克希德·马丁公司表示，PAC-3 Edge采用了新型导引头、升级的飞行控制系统以及由诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司提供的多脉冲火箭发动机。
zhParas: 洛克希德·马丁公司周五发布了PAC-3 Edge，这是一种导弹拦截弹，旨在防御高超声速和先进导弹威胁，正值美军寻求加强应对新兴空中威胁的能力之际。
乌克兰和中东冲突背景下，对防空和导弹防御系统的需求日益增长，使美国武器库存承压，促使美国陆军在7月授予洛克希德·马丁公司一份价值高达586亿美元的合同，以扩大PAC-3拦截弹的生产。
洛克希德·马丁公司表示，PAC-3 Edge采用新型导引头、升级的飞行控制系统以及由诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司提供的多脉冲火箭发动机，从而增强该拦截弹在更远射程和更高高度上对抗包括高超声速导弹在内的先进威胁的能力。
其成本将大致与现有PAC-3 MSE相当，”洛克希德·马丁公司导弹与火控部门总裁蒂姆·卡希尔对路透社表示。“全面生产时，年产量约为每年2000枚，与PAC-3 MSE相当。
今年1月，洛克希德·马丁公司与五角大楼签署了一项为期七年的框架协议，以扩大其PAC-3导弹拦截弹的生产，目标是将年制造能力从约600枚提高到2000枚。

items.body: U.S. Army Soldiers assigned to the 2nd Battalion, 159th Attack Reconnaissance Battalion, 12th Combat Aviation Brigade, conducted an integration exercise and combined arms live-fire exercise with Soldiers from the 5th Battalion, 4th Air Defense Artillery Regiment during the Skyfall proof-of-concept series at Grafenwoehr Training Area, Germany, Oct. 6, 2026. items.title: Air Defenders, Aviators in Europe Combine Forces During Operation Skyfall II
items.author: SGT Zedekiah Kitchens
items.summary: On Oct. 6, 2026, U.S. Army soldiers assigned to the 5th Battalion, 4th Air Defense Artillery Regiment, 52nd Air Defense Artillery Brigade, worked with soldiers from the 2nd Battalion, 159th Aviation Regiment, 12th Combat Aviation Brigade, at the Grafenwoehr Training Area to showcase connectivity and interoperability capabilities first assessed by both units in the spring. In March 2026, the first Operation Skyfall demonstrated that the AH-64 Apache helicopter could track and engage counter-unman
items.body:
GRAFENWOEHR, Germany — On Oct. 6, 2026, U.S. Army soldiers assigned to the 5th Battalion, 4th Air Defense Artillery Regiment, 52nd Air Defense Artillery Brigade, worked with soldiers from the 2nd Battalion, 159th Aviation Regiment, 12th Combat Aviation Brigade, at the Grafenwoehr Training Area to showcase connectivity and interoperability capabilities first assessed by both units in the spring.

In March 2026, the first Operation Skyfall demonstrated that the AH-64 Apache helicopter could track and engage counter-unmanned aircraft system targets using data fed by ground-based air defense sensors. Operation Skyfall II built on those capabilities, providing aviation crews with more opportunities to detect, engage and destroy drones.

The first step in countering an airborne threat is knowing its location. The AN/MPQ-64 Sentinel radar is a mobile, ground-based system that provides continuous, low-altitude target alerting, tracking and queuing data. Additionally, the Sentinel can sense threats farther away and provide earlier warnings, enhancing the survivability of the Apaches while providing them with the necessary data to engage a target.

“We’re sending the data of where the track is in time and space, so the Apache pilot knows exactly where the track is,” said Lt. Col. John Vermeil, commander of the 5th Battalion, 4th Air Defense Artillery Regiment, 52nd Air Defense Artillery Brigade. “Not only that, but also the tactical operations center knows where the track is, and they’re able to provide a vector to see if they can engage that track.”

Using the Outlaw, an unmanned aircraft system used as a low-cost training target drone, soldiers participating in Operation Skyfall II demonstrated the entire process. Ground-based air defenders tracked the Outlaw with their sensors and relayed that data to the Apaches via the tactical operations center, allowing the aviators to conduct air-to-air combat operations to destroy the threat.

The Apache crews successfully engaged three Outlaw drones, destroying each one individually.

Official tactics, techniques and procedures for detecting and engaging counter-unmanned aircraft systems are still being refined. However, Operation Skyfall II demonstrated how ground-based air defense units and airborne aviation assets can generate more defensive fires options for senior commanders, sustaining integrated defensive fires in contested conditions across the European and African theaters.

“What’s important about Skyfall is the integration with the air defenders and the protection warfighting function for NATO,” said U.S. Army Maj. Tyler Jamison, operations officer of the 2nd Battalion, 159th Aviation Regiment, 12th Combat Aviation Brigade. Jamison added that working with the air defense battalion “has helped us operationalize what it means to destroy a drone.”

On order, the 52nd Air Defense Artillery Brigade executes joint and combined integrated air and missile defense operations as the tactical air and missile defense integrator in support of U.S. Army Europe and Africa. The brigade deters adversary aggression and as required, neutralizes air and missile threats to critical assets in the U.S. European Command and U.S. Africa Command areas of responsibility.
items.titleZh: 欧洲防空兵与航空兵在“天空坠落II”行动中联合力量
items.summaryZh: 德国格拉芬沃尔——2026年10月6日，隶属于第52防空炮兵旅第4防空炮兵团第5营的美国陆军士兵，与第12战斗航空旅第159航空团第2营的士兵在格拉芬沃尔训练区合作，展示两支部队于春季首次评估的连通性与互操作性能力。2026年3月，首次“天空坠落”行动表明，AH-64“阿帕奇”直升机能够跟踪并打击反无人机……
zhParas: 德国格拉芬沃尔——2026年10月6日，隶属于第52防空炮兵旅第4防空炮兵团第5营的美国陆军士兵，与第12战斗航空旅第159航空团第2营的士兵在格拉芬沃尔训练区合作，展示两支部队于春季首次评估的连通性与互操作性能力。
2026年3月，首次“天空坠落”行动表明，AH-64“阿帕奇”直升机可利用地面防空传感器提供的数据跟踪并打击反无人飞机系统目标。“天空坠落II”行动在此基础上进一步发展这些能力，为航空机组人员提供更多探测、打击和摧毁无人机的机会。
应对空中威胁的第一步是掌握其位置。AN/MPQ-64“哨兵”雷达是一种机动式地面系统，可提供连续的低空目标预警、跟踪和提示数据。此外，“哨兵”能够感知更远处的威胁并提供更早预警，从而提升“阿帕奇”直升机的生存能力，同时为其提供打击目标所需的数据。
我们发送航迹在时间和空间中的位置数据，这样‘阿帕奇’飞行员就能准确知道航迹在哪里，”第52防空炮兵旅第4防空炮兵团第5营指挥官约翰·弗米尔中校说。“不仅如此，战术作战中心也知道航迹在哪里，他们能够提供一个矢量，以判断是否可以打击该航迹。
参与“天空坠落II”行动的士兵使用“Outlaw”（一种用作低成本训练靶机的无人飞机系统）演示了整个流程。地面防空人员用传感器跟踪“Outlaw”，并通过战术作战中心将该数据中继给“阿帕奇”直升机，使飞行员能够实施空对空作战，摧毁威胁。
阿帕奇”机组人员成功打击了三架“Outlaw”无人机，并逐一将其摧毁。
探测与交战反无人机系统的官方战术、技术与程序仍在完善中。然而，“Skyfall II”行动表明，陆基防空部队和空中航空资产能够为高级指挥官生成更多防御火力选项，从而在欧洲和非洲战区受争夺条件下维持一体化防御火力。
Skyfall行动重要的是与防空兵以及北约防护作战职能实现一体化，”美国陆军少校、第12战斗航空旅第159航空团第2营作战军官泰勒·贾米森说。贾米森补充说，与防空营合作“帮助我们使‘摧毁一架无人机’这一概念具备可操作性。

items.title: Faster front-line delivery with new Testing and Evaluation programme
items.summary: MOD and QinetiQ launch Project Safari, a joint programme opening up access to UK test and evaluation facilities for SMEs.
items.body:
MOD and QinetiQ revolutionising access to Test and Evaluation facilities for SMEs, delivering new tech into service faster

SAFARI will remove barriers to UK sites, helping new capabilities move from development to deployment quicker

Supports SDR commitment to support SMEs with additional £2.5 billion every year by 2028

Technologies such as hypersonic missiles, directed energy weapons and autonomous systems will be assessed, refined and delivered quicker than ever before, following a joint Ministry of Defence (MOD) and QinetiQ programme transforming how defence capabilities are tested and evaluated at the pace of modern warfare.

Project Safari will revolutionise access to the UK’s sovereign Test and Evaluation (T&E) facilities for Small and Medium Enterprises, creating an agile environment to prove and deliver new technologies into service faster.

For too long, companies – especially those that are SMEs or new to working in defence – have faced barriers that have prevented them getting their ideas and technology tested in real life scenarios, such as outdated bureaucracy to gain multiple levels of approvals.

This programme will remove barriers to UK sites, providing a single front-door for SMEs to access facilities and improving the approval processes for trial activity. That smoother route for innovative firms into the sector will help support jobs and investment in their local economies, powering growth in every postcode.

Minister for Defence Readiness and Industry, Luke Pollard MP, said:

We know that limited access to test and evaluation facilities have been holding back smaller businesses and new entrants from working with defence. By working hand-in-hand with QinetiQ, we are unlocking British innovation by developing, testing and delivering military capabilities for the UK and our allies at speed.

We know that limited access to test and evaluation facilities have been holding back smaller businesses and new entrants from working with defence.

By working hand-in-hand with QinetiQ, we are unlocking British innovation by developing, testing and delivering military capabilities for the UK and our allies at speed.

Group CEO QinetiQ, Steve Wadey, said:

Turning ideas into trusted frontline capability faster than our adversaries is what delivers military advantage and we’ve got to go faster to stay ahead. Project Safari will transform how the UK approves new technologies, creating a world-leading test and evaluation enterprise that helps government, industry and regulators work together to accelerate the delivery of military capability at the pace demanded by modern warfare.

Project Safari will bring together government, industry, regulators and technology innovators to support the UK’s warfighting readiness and streamline how companies access specialist facilities and expertise, modernise the infrastructure so it’s fit for a fast-moving digital environment and reduce unnecessary barriers to accelerate decision making.

During a visit to MOD Hebrides, the UK’s largest weapons test range, Minister for Defence Readiness and Industry, Luke Pollard MP, signed an agreement with QinetiQ for the first design stage of a multimillion-pound investment to develop the site to enable the testing of hypersonic missiles and other advanced technologies.

The minister was joined by QinetiQ CEO, Steve Wadey to host a roundtable with SME representatives, including Greenjets and Cambridge Aerospace, to listen to the experiences of SMEs accessing T&E services and the barriers they can face.

Luke Pollard MP also met one of the UK companies competing in Project Brakestop, MGI Engineering. An Oxfordshire-based SME, they are developing low-cost long-range weapons for Ukraine.

Project Safari is a practical demonstration of the ambitions set out in the Strategic Defence Review, which committed defence to increasing its spend with SMEs by £2.5 billion a year by summer 2028.

The announcement builds on the work of the Defence Investment Plan, backed by £298 billion of funding in UK defence over the next four years. The plan will drive sustained investment across British industry – including SMEs – ensuring the UK’s defence sector remains a cornerstone of the country’s economic renewal.
items.titleZh: 新测试与评估项目加速前线交付
items.summaryZh: 英国国防部（MOD）与QinetiQ启动Safari项目，该联合计划旨在向中小企业开放英国测试与评估设施的准入。
zhParas: 英国国防部（MOD）与QinetiQ为中小企业彻底革新测试与评估设施的准入方式，加快新技术投入使用。
SAFARI将消除进入英国场地的障碍，帮助新能力更快从开发走向部署。
支持《战略防务审查》（SDR）的承诺，即到2028年每年额外投入25亿英镑支持中小企业。
在国防部（MOD）与QinetiQ联合项目推动下，高超声速导弹、定向能武器和自主系统等技术将比以往任何时候都更快地得到评估、改进和交付，并按现代战争节奏变革国防能力的测试与评估方式。
Safari”项目将彻底变革中小企业进入英国自主测试与评估（T&E）设施的途径，营造敏捷环境，以更快验证并交付新技术，使其投入使用。
长期以来，企业——尤其是中小企业或刚进入国防领域的企业——一直面临障碍，无法在真实场景中测试其想法和技术，例如为获得多级批准而遭遇的过时官僚程序。
该计划将消除英国试验场地的准入壁垒，为中小企业使用设施提供单一门户，并改进试验活动的审批流程。这条让创新企业进入该行业的更顺畅路径，将有助于支持当地经济中的就业和投资，为每个地区的增长提供动力。
国防战备与工业事务大臣、议员卢克·波拉德表示：
我们知道，获取测试与评估设施的渠道有限，一直阻碍着较小企业和新进入者与国防领域合作。通过与QinetiQ携手合作，我们正在快速为英国及我们的盟友开发、测试并交付军事能力，从而释放英国的创新潜力。
我们知道，获取测试与评估设施的渠道有限，一直阻碍着较小企业和新进入者与国防领域合作。
通过与QinetiQ携手合作，我们正在快速为英国及我们的盟友开发、测试并交付军事能力，从而释放英国的创新潜力。
QinetiQ集团首席执行官史蒂夫·韦迪表示：
比对手更快地将想法转化为可信的前线能力，才能带来军事优势，我们必须加快速度才能保持领先。Safari项目将改变英国批准新技术的方式，打造世界领先的试验与评估体系，帮助政府、产业界和监管机构携手合作，以现代战争所要求的速度加快军事能力的交付。
Safari项目将汇聚政府、产业界、监管机构和技术创新者，支持英国的作战战备，简化企业获取专业设施和专业知识的方式，推动基础设施现代化，使其适应快速发展的数字环境，并减少不必要的障碍以加快决策。
在访问英国最大的武器试验靶场——MOD Hebrides期间，国防战备与产业大臣、议员卢克·波拉德与QinetiQ签署协议，启动一项数百万英镑投资的首个设计阶段，以开发该场地，使其能够测试高超声速导弹及其他先进技术。
QinetiQ首席执行官史蒂夫·韦迪与大臣共同主持了一场与中小企业代表的圆桌会议，参加者包括Greenjets和Cambridge Aerospace，以听取中小企业在获取试验与评估服务方面的经验以及它们可能面临的障碍。
议员卢克·波拉德还会见了参与Brakestop项目的英国公司之一MGI Engineering。这家总部位于牛津郡的中小企业正在为乌克兰研发低成本远程武器。
Safari项目切实体现了《战略防务评估》中提出的雄心，该评估承诺国防领域到2028年夏季将每年与中小企业的支出增加25亿英镑。
这一公告以国防投资计划的工作为基础，该计划由未来四年内英国国防领域2980亿英镑资金支持。该计划将推动对英国工业——包括中小企业——的持续投资，确保英国国防部门仍是国家经济复兴的基石。

items.title: 439th Airlift Wing reinforces its commitment to the Warrior Ethos through Warfighter fitness
items.author: Timothy R Jensen
items.summary: The 439th Airlift Wing reinforced its commitment to maintaining a fit, resilient and ready force during the reopening of the fitness center at Westover Air Reserve Base, Massachusetts, Oct. 5, 2026.
items.body:
The 439th Airlift Wing reinforced its commitment to maintaining a fit, resilient and ready force during the reopening of the fitness center at Westover Air Reserve Base, Massachusetts, Oct. 5, 2026.

The reopening ceremony, hosted by the 439th Force Support Squadron, highlighted the connection between individual well-being and the wing's ability to maintain a fit, ready and mission-capable force.

The reopening came five days after Secretary of War Pete Hegseth joined approximately 600 enlisted service members and officers for early-morning physical fitness training on the Pentagon parade field while wearing matching t-shirts with the words, “This is War,” written across the front. The event reinforced the department's sustained emphasis on fitness, discipline and high standards for current and future operational success.

Later that day, Hegseth again connected physical standards with readiness, accountability and lethality during a State of the Force address. His remarks continued an emphasis he made explicit during a Sept. 30, 2025, address to senior military leaders at Marine Corps Base Quantico, Virginia.

“It all starts with physical fitness and appearance,” Hegseth said. “If the Secretary of War can do regular, hard physical training, so can every member of our joint force.”

The standards Hegseth announced in 2025 also directed reserve-component members to take personal responsibility for maintaining an appropriate fitness regimen regardless of duty status. For Reserve Citizen Airmen, access to fitness resources helps translate that responsibility into sustained readiness.

“Physical fitness is foundational to readiness,” said Ryan Leveille, 439th FSS services flight chief. “This is a place for our Airmen and families to gather, exercise and participate in sports. It supports confidence, resilience and opportunities for families to spend time together through fitness.”

Recent improvements included sanding and refinishing the basketball court and adding the 439th AW emblem at center court. New markings were also installed for the Air Force High Aerobic Multi-shuttle Run, a 20-meter progressive shuttle run used to assess cardiorespiratory fitness. The court's 3-point line was repainted from its previous National Basketball Association configuration to NCAA standards to support intramural basketball and other organized activities. The squadron plans to expand its intramural sports program, providing additional opportunities for competition, teamwork and physical development.

Maj. Cameron Goswick, 439th FSS commander, said the squadron contributes to readiness through a broad range of programs that sustain Airmen throughout their careers. In addition to fitness and recreation, the squadron provides child care, education and training, food services and personnel support.

Together, those services help Airmen remain physically prepared, professionally developed and supported to meet mission requirements. They also give Airmen and families resources that strengthen resilience through the demands of military service.

“We have built a top level foundation, and together, we are ensuring our Airmen have the motivation, facilities, and backing to perform at their absolute peak,” said Lucas Rosa, 439th AW fitness center exercise physiologist.

Physical conditioning contributes directly to mission execution across the Patriot Wing. Airmen rely on strength and endurance to load and secure cargo aboard the C-5M Super Galaxy, maintain aircraft during extended shifts and demanding conditions, and carry out the operational and support functions required to deliver global mobility.

Fitness is not limited to combat tasks, Goswick said. It enables Airmen to perform safely and reliably across the mission. Readiness among the wing's operations, maintenance, mission support and medical professionals allows the Patriot Wing to fly, fix and fight when the nation calls.

For Citizen Airmen, readiness must be sustained alongside civilian careers and family responsibilities. The fitness center support the AFRC advantage by helping preserve an efficient, experienced, accessible and lethal force prepared to respond when the nation calls.

By pairing accessible fitness resources with organized recreation and clear standards, the Patriot Wing is investing in its people and the operational capability they provide. The reopened fitness center gives Airmen and families a place to train together while strengthening the Patriot Wing's ability to execute its global mobility mission anytime, anywhere.

Fitness is not limited to combat, said Goswick. "It enables Airmen to perform effectively, safely and reliably across the mission."
items.titleZh: 第439空运联队通过作战人员体能强化对战士精神的承诺
items.summaryZh: 2026年10月5日，在马萨诸塞州韦斯托弗空军预备役基地健身中心重新开放之际，第439空运联队重申其致力于保持一支体能良好、坚韧且具备战备状态的部队。
zhParas: 2026年10月5日，第439空运联队在马萨诸塞州韦斯托弗空军预备役基地健身中心重新开放之际，重申其致力于保持一支体能良好、坚韧且具备战备状态的部队。
由第439部队支援中队主办的重新开放仪式，强调了个人福祉与该联队保持一支体能良好、随时待命且具备任务能力部队的能力之间的联系。
此次重新开放是在战争部长皮特·赫格塞思与约600名士兵和军官一起在五角大楼阅兵场参加清晨体能训练五天之后进行的；当时他们穿着胸前印有“这就是战争”字样的同款T恤。该活动强化了该部门对当前和未来作战成功所持续强调的体能、纪律和高标准。
当天晚些时候，赫格塞思在一次“部队状况”讲话中再次将体能标准与战备、问责和杀伤力联系起来。他的言论延续了他在2025年9月30日于弗吉尼亚州匡蒂科海军陆战队基地向高级军事领导人发表讲话时明确强调的重点。
一切都从体能和外表开始，”赫格塞思说。“如果战争部长能够进行定期、艰苦的体能训练，那么我们联合部队的每一名成员也能做到。
赫格塞思在2025年宣布的标准还要求预备役部队成员，无论执勤状态如何，都要对保持适当的体能训练方案承担个人责任。对于预备役公民空军人员而言，获得健身资源有助于将这一责任转化为持续的战备状态。
体能是战备的基础，”第439部队支援中队服务小队主管瑞安·勒维尔说。“这里是我们的空军人员和家属聚集、锻炼和参加体育运动的地方。它有助于增强信心、韧性，并为家庭提供通过健身共度时光的机会。
近期的改进包括对篮球场进行打磨和翻新，并在球场中央添加第439空运联队徽标。还设置了用于空军高强度有氧多程折返跑的新标线，这是一项用于评估心肺适能的20米渐进式折返跑。球场的三分线从原先的美国职业篮球联赛（NBA）规格重新漆成美国大学体育协会（NCAA）标准，以支持单位内部篮球赛和其他有组织的活动。该中队计划扩大其单位内部体育项目，为竞争、团队合作和身体发展提供更多机会。
第439部队支援中队指挥官卡梅伦·戈斯威克少校表示，该中队通过一系列广泛项目为战备作出贡献，这些项目在空军人员的整个职业生涯中为其提供支持。除体能和娱乐外，该中队还提供儿童照护、教育和训练、餐饮服务以及人事支持。
这些服务共同帮助空军人员保持身体上的准备、职业上的发展并获得支持，以满足任务要求。它们还为空军人员及其家属提供资源，帮助他们在军旅生活的各种要求中增强韧性。
我们已经打下了一流的基础，并且正共同确保我们的空军人员拥有动力、设施和支持，以发挥出绝对巅峰水平，”第439空运联队健身中心运动生理学家卢卡斯·罗萨说。
体能训练直接促进整个爱国者联队的任务执行。空军人员依靠力量和耐力，在C-5M“超级银河”运输机上装载和固定货物，在长时间值班和严苛条件下维护飞机，并履行实现全球机动所需的作战和保障职能。
戈斯威克说，体能并不局限于作战任务。它使空军人员能够在整个任务中安全可靠地执行任务。该联队作战、维修、任务保障和医疗专业人员的战备状态，使爱国者联队在国家召唤时能够飞行、维修和战斗。
对公民空军人员而言，必须在兼顾平民职业和家庭责任的同时保持战备。健身中心通过帮助保持一支高效、经验丰富、可随时调用且具备杀伤力、准备在国家召唤时作出响应的部队，为空军预备役司令部（AFRC）优势提供支持。
通过将便利的健身资源与有组织的休闲活动和明确标准相结合，爱国者联队正在投资于其人员以及他们所提供的作战能力。重新开放的健身中心为空军人员及家属提供了一个共同锻炼的场所，同时增强了爱国者联队随时随地执行全球机动任务的能力。
戈斯威克说，体能训练并不局限于作战。“它使空军人员能够在整个任务中有效、安全、可靠地履行职责。

items.author: SN Ian Byler
items.summary: U.S. Coast Guard Legend-class cutter USCGC Munro (WMSL 755) sails beneath the Golden Gate Bridge during San Francisco Fleet Week, Oct. 9, 2026. San Francisco Fleet Week, now in its 45th iteration, is a time-honored celebration that allows citizens of the Bay Area to witness today’s maritime services firsthand. During the event, Sailors, Marines, and Coast Guardsmen showcase their capabilities and equipment, participate in various community service events, and enjoy the hospitality of the Bay Are
items.body:
Coast Guard Legend-class cutter USCGC Munro (WMSL 755) sails beneath the Golden Gate Bridge during San Francisco Fleet Week, Oct.

San Francisco Fleet Week, now in its 45th iteration, is a time-honored celebration that allows citizens of the Bay Area to witness today’s maritime services firsthand.

During the event, Sailors, Marines, and Coast Guardsmen showcase their capabilities and equipment, participate in various community service events, and enjoy the hospitality of the Bay Area (U.

Navy Photo by Mass Communication Specialist Seaman Alex Byler)
items.titleZh: 旧金山舰队周举办舰艇巡游
items.summaryZh: 2026年10月9日，海岸警卫队传奇级巡逻舰“门罗”号（USCGC Munro，WMSL 755）在旧金山舰队周期间从金门大桥下驶过。旧金山舰队周如今已是第45届，是一项历史悠久的庆祝活动，让湾区民众能够亲身领略当今海上部队的风采。活动期间，水兵、海军陆战队员和海岸警卫队队员展示各自的能力与装备，参与各类社区服务活动，并享受湾区的热情款待。

items.title: U.S. Pacific Command Hosts FSM President for Regional Security Discussions
items.author: SSG Angel Heraldez
items.summary: Lt. Gen. George B. Rowell, deputy commander of U.S. Pacific Command, hosted President of the Federated States of Micronesia, His Excellency Wesley W. Simina at Camp H.M Smith on October 9, 2026, for discussions on shared regional-security priorities and the enduring U.S.-FSM partnership.
items.body:
Story by Staff Sgt. Angel Heraldez

U.S. Pacific Command

CAMP H.M. SMITH, HAWAII, US

Lt. Gen. George B. Rowell, deputy commander of U.S. Pacific Command, hosted President of the Federated States of Micronesia, His Excellency Wesley W. Simina at Camp H.M Smith on October 9, 2026, for discussions on shared regional-security priorities and the enduring U.S.-FSM partnership.

During the visit, US PACOM and FSM senior officials exchanged views on recent regional developments, maritime security, cybersecurity, and evolving long-range threats affecting the Federated States of Micronesia and the broader Indo-Pacific.

They also discussed ongoing efforts to strengthen deterrence, enhance regional awareness, and support collective defense against external threats.

The visit reaffirmed the U.S. commitment to the Federated States of Micronesia under the Compact of Free Association and the importance of continued close coordination to advance a free and open Indo-Pacific.

U.S. Pacific Command is committed to enhancing stability in the Indo-Pacific region by promoting security cooperation, encouraging peaceful development, responding to contingencies, deterring aggression and, when necessary, prevailing in conflict.

美国太平洋司令部副司令乔治·B·罗威尔中将，于2026年10月9日在H.M.史密斯营接待了密克罗尼西亚联邦总统韦斯利·W·西米纳阁下，就共同的地区安全优先事项以及持久的美国-密克罗尼西亚联邦伙伴关系进行了讨论。
访问期间，美国太平洋司令部和密克罗尼西亚联邦高级官员就近期地区事态发展、海上安全、网络安全以及影响密克罗尼西亚联邦和更广泛印太地区的不断演变的远程威胁交换了意见。
他们还讨论了为加强威慑、增强地区态势感知以及支持针对外部威胁的集体防御而正在进行的努力。
此次访问重申了美国根据《自由联系条约》对密克罗尼西亚联邦的承诺，以及继续密切协调以推进自由开放的印太地区的重要性。
美国太平洋司令部致力于通过促进安全合作、鼓励和平发展、应对突发事件、威慑侵略，并在必要时在冲突中取胜，来增强印太地区的稳定。

items.title: XVIII Airborne Corps Deception on Kuwaiti Border (15 OCT 1990)
items.author: Courtesy
items.summary: Between Oct. 15 and Nov. 28, 1990, the XVIII Airborne Corps conducted a defensive deception operation as part of Operation DESERT SHIELD in Saudi Arabia. This was an informative precursor to a larger offensive deception operation coalition forces unleashed during the ground campaign of Operation DESERT STORM three months later.
items.body:
Between Oct. 15 and Nov. 28, 1990, the XVIII Airborne Corps conducted a defensive deception operation as part of Operation DESERT SHIELD in Saudi Arabia. This was an informative precursor to a larger offensive deception operation coalition forces unleashed during the ground campaign of Operation DESERT STORM three months later.

Within days of Iraq’s invasion of Kuwait on Aug. 2, 1990, the U.S. launched Operation DESERT SHIELD to defend Saudi Arabia from further Iraqi expansion. By Aug. 9, Lt. Gen. Gary Luck’s XVIII Airborne Corps assault command post touched down at Dhahran Airport. The Corps’ presence in the Persian Gulf grew over the following two months, as did the number of Iraqi divisions in Kuwait. Saddam Hussein’s intentions to invade Saudia Arabia were unknown, but intelligence analysts concluded he had the capability to do so. The U.S. needed time to deploy enough air and ground forces to deter any attempts to seize Saudi oil fields, ports, and airfields.

Even before the deployment of the XVIII Airborne Corps, its Deception Element began planning for the unit’s deception operations. In 1990, deception was considered something of a “lost art” in the U.S. Army. Attempts to revitalize the capability began with the 1988 publication of FM 90-2 "Battlefield Deception" (BAT-D) and the implementation of associated training. FM 90-2 and the 1989 FM 100-15 "Corps Operations" called for twelve-member BAT-D cells working with the corps G-3 planners and similar cells in the divisional MI battalions to execute deception plans.

Maj. Gary P. Melton, a West Point graduate who had received his commission as an infantry officer in 1975, led the XVIII Airborne Corps Deception Element. On Aug. 27, 1990, he led an initial planning and administrative group to Saudi Arabia. Once there, they continued “the corps planning cycle we began back at Fort Bragg and put the first deception equipment package on the ground.” The remaining six members of Melton’s team followed over the next two months, along with additional communication emulators and camouflage decoys on loan from the deception equipment office at Fort Belvoir.

As planning for the offensive campaign continued, the G-3 planners considered ways to deter further Iraqi expansion. In lockstep, Major Melton’s Deception Element provided courses of action that dovetailed with the G-3’s operational plans. Hussein’s forces seemed to be positioned to invade along the coastal roads into Saudi Arabia with the Trans-Arabian Pipeline (TAPLine) Road as their first strategic objective. Thus, the deception plan, according to Major Melton, was

to portray our corps establishing a defense in a sector along the TAPLine Road [near al-Jubayl in Saudi Arabia’s Eastern Province]. We tried to portray the sparse Pan-Arab forces as the only covering force forward of TAPLine Road, when, in fact, a large U.S. covering force was there. . . If believed, this deception would have confused Iraqi command and control when they ran into a formidable U.S. covering force before they expected.

Initially, Melton’s team conducted the deception, but later in the six-week operation, the 101st Airborne, 24th Infantry, and 1st Cavalry divisions began complementary operations. The deception operation utilized a wide variety of elements to enhance its credibility. This included planting decoy tracked and wheeled vehicles and forward arming and refueling points; posting unit signage; transmitting real, high frequency, radioteletype traffic in deception mode; running vehicle convoys; moving troops in and around local towns; and conducting psychological operations.

Whether this early deception effort succeeded was unclear because the Iraqis did not attack into Saudi Arabia. Yet, it was educational for Melton’s team, who confirmed the deception equipment, including signal emulators, worked in the desert environment. The operation also led Melton to recommend consolidating division and corps deception cells to ensure sufficient resources to enhance the deception’s credibility. Ultimately, the team’s operations helped inform the successful deception operations the coalition undertook as part of the DESERT STORM ground offensive that kicked off the following February.

items.titleZh: 第18空降军在科威特边境的欺骗行动（1990年10月15日）
items.summaryZh: 1990年10月15日至11月28日期间，第18空降军作为“沙漠盾牌”行动的一部分，在沙特阿拉伯实施了一次防御性欺骗行动。这是三个月后联军在“沙漠风暴”行动地面战役中发动更大规模进攻性欺骗行动的一次具有启示意义的前奏。
zhParas: 1990年10月15日至11月28日期间，第18空降军作为“沙漠盾牌”行动的一部分，在沙特阿拉伯实施了一次防御性欺骗行动。这是三个月后联军在“沙漠风暴”行动地面战役中发动更大规模进攻性欺骗行动的一次具有启示意义的前奏。

1990年8月2日伊拉克入侵科威特后的数天内，美国发起了“沙漠盾牌”行动，以保卫沙特阿拉伯免遭伊拉克进一步扩张。到8月9日，加里·勒克中将的第18空降军突击指挥所抵达达兰机场。此后两个月，该军在波斯湾地区的存在不断扩大，伊拉克在科威特的师数量也在增加。萨达姆·侯赛因入侵沙特阿拉伯的意图尚不清楚，但情报分析人员认为他具备这样做的能力。美国需要时间部署足够的空中和地面部队，以威慑任何夺取沙特油田、港口和机场的企图。
甚至在部署第18空降军之前，其欺骗分队就已开始规划该部队的欺骗行动。1990年，欺骗在美国陆军中多少被视为一种“失传的艺术”。重振这一能力的努力始于1988年出版的FM 90-2《战场欺骗》（BAT-D）以及相关训练的实施。FM 90-2和1989年的FM 100-15《军作战》要求由十二人组成的战场欺骗小组与军G-3计划人员以及各师军事情报营中类似小组协同，执行欺骗计划。
加里·P·梅尔顿少校是一名西点军校毕业生，1975年获步兵军官委任，领导第18空降军欺骗分队。1990年8月27日，他率领一个初始规划与行政小组前往沙特阿拉伯。抵达后，他们继续“我们在布拉格堡启动的军规划周期，并将首个欺骗装备包部署到位”。梅尔顿团队的其余六名成员在随后两个月内相继抵达，随行的还有从贝尔沃堡欺骗装备办公室借用的额外通信模拟器和伪装诱饵。
随着进攻战役规划持续进行，G-3计划人员考虑了威慑伊拉克进一步扩张的方法。梅尔顿少校的欺骗分队与之步调一致，提供了与G-3作战计划相衔接的行动方案。侯赛因的部队似乎已部署到位，可沿沿海公路入侵沙特阿拉伯，并将跨阿拉伯输油管道（TAPLine）公路作为其首个战略目标。因此，据梅尔顿少校称，欺骗计划是
将我们的军描绘为正在沿TAPLine公路[沙特阿拉伯东部省朱拜勒附近]一带建立防御。我们试图把兵力稀少的泛阿拉伯部队描绘成TAPLine公路前方唯一的掩护部队，而事实上，一支庞大的美军掩护部队就在那里。……如果这一欺骗被采信，它本会在伊拉克指挥与控制部门于预料之前遭遇一支强大的美军掩护部队时，使其陷入混乱。
起初，梅尔顿的团队实施了欺骗行动，但在这场为期六周的行动后期，第101空降师、第24步兵师和第1骑兵师开始实施配合行动。欺骗行动利用多种要素来提高其可信度。这包括布设履带式和轮式诱饵车辆以及前沿装弹与加油点；张贴部队标识牌；以欺骗模式发送真实的高频无线电传通信；组织车辆车队行驶；在附近城镇内及周边调动部队；以及开展心理战。
这次早期欺骗行动是否成功尚不清楚，因为伊拉克军队并未进攻沙特阿拉伯。然而，这对梅尔顿的团队具有教育意义，他们确认了包括信号模拟器在内的欺骗装备在沙漠环境中能够奏效。该行动还促使梅尔顿建议整合师和军的欺骗小组，以确保有足够资源来提高欺骗的可信度。最终，该团队的行动有助于为联军在次年2月发起的“沙漠风暴”地面攻势中所实施的成功欺骗行动提供借鉴。

items.summaryZh: 美国海军陆战队中校克里·E·弗里德瓦尔德（左），新兵训练团第2新兵训练营指挥官，于2026年10月9日在加利福尼亚州圣迭戈海军陆战队新兵训练基地举行的毕业典礼上，向第2新兵训练营福克斯连的准下士坦纳·赖特（中右）颁发荣誉毕业生奖牌。此次典礼标志着为期13周的转变结束，其中包括操练、射击、基本战斗技能和海军陆战队传统习俗训练。

items.title: Assessing German Adaptation in World War II (16 OCT 1942)
items.author: Courtesy
items.summary: On Oct. 16, 1942, the Army's Military Intelligence Service (MIS) published its fifth special study—"The Development of German Defensive Tactics in Cyrenaica—1941." The study concluded that German desert defense was not designed as an immovable barrier; instead, it was an integrated system organized in depth to absorb and wear down an enemy assault before launching a decisive armored counterattack.
items.body:
On Oct. 16, 1942, the Army's Military Intelligence Service (MIS) published its fifth special study—"The Development of German Defensive Tactics in Cyrenaica—1941." The study concluded that German desert defense was not designed as an immovable barrier; instead, it was an integrated system organized in depth to absorb and wear down an enemy assault before launching a decisive armored counterattack.

The MIS developed its assessment through the systematic evaluation of captured German military documents. Rather than depending on wartime estimates or enemy propaganda, American intelligence analysts translated and evaluated captured German unit war diaries, operational orders, after-action battle reports, and defensive sketches. The study largely reviewed the defensive tactics developed by the Afrika Korps’ three divisional commanders: Maj. Gen. Johann von Ravenstein of the 21st Panzer Division; Maj. Gen. Walter Neumann‑Silkow of the 15th Panzer Division, and Maj. Gen. Max Summermann of the 90th Light Motorized Division. The study also looked at how the battalion and company officers executed the trio’s tactical concepts on the ground through captured documentation on tactical trials, successes, and failures in the field.

The study concentrated on the defensive lessons German forces learned through hard experience. German officers initially relied on rigid, linear defense lines that were thinly spread and vulnerable to artillery and armor breakthroughs. Early in the campaign, one German major criticized this lack of defensive preparation, writing that “our people know next to nothing about the construction of defenses” and pointing out that “positional infantry warfare is 60 percent with the spade, 30 percent with the field glasses, and only 10 percent with the gun.”

In response, the Germans abandoned continuous front lines in favor of self-contained, mutually supporting strongpoints known as Stützpunkte. These fortified centers featured all-around defense, deep minefields of antipersonnel and antitank mines, antitank ditches, and dummy positions designed to deceive Allied reconnaissance. At the tactical level, the Germans mastered the “trefoil” formation, arranging squads and platoons into triangular clusters that provided overlapping fields of fire. Furthermore, commanders established strict fire discipline; heavy weapons and antitank guns were hidden and ordered to hold their fire until enemy forces reached close ranges to ensure surprise and maximize lethal effect.

The study pointed to the paramount importance of the German 88-mm dual-purpose gun in holding these positions. Standard 37-mm and 50-mm antitank guns often proved ineffective against heavily armored British tanks, leaving the high-velocity 88-mm antiaircraft gun as the core antitank weapon. The report noted the “terrific antitank performance of the twelve 88-mm guns” during fighting on the Egyptian frontier, asserting that “the 88-mm gun, the 5th Tank Regiment, and the solid defenses of Halfaya and Point 208 won the battle for the Axis.” During critical moments, such as the defense of Capuzzo, single 88-mm guns manned by makeshift crews halted entire armor columns. As the study concluded, “without the 88-mm gun, however, none of the positions could have repulsed the British drive,” making it “the most outstanding single element in German defenses.”

"The Development of German Defensive Tactics in Cyrenaica" provided an in-depth examination of how Field Marshal Erwin Rommel’s Afrika Korps, originally trained almost exclusively in rapid offensive warfare, adapted to static desert defense in early 1941. Facing unique desert logistics and terrain, German commanders had to rapidly invent and refine new defensive practices. Consequently, in addition to laying out German defensive tactics, this study showed American military leaders that the German Army was highly adaptable, rapidly transforming its tactical doctrine to master defensive position warfare in the desert.

items.titleZh: 评估二战中德军的适应能力（1942年10月16日）
items.summaryZh: 1942年10月16日，美国陆军军事情报局（MIS）发布了其第五份专题研究报告——《1941年昔兰尼加德军防御战术的发展》。该研究得出结论，德军沙漠防御并非设计为不可移动的屏障；相反，它是一种纵深编成的综合体系，旨在先吸收并消耗敌军进攻，随后发动决定性的装甲反击。
zhParas: 1942年10月16日，美国陆军军事情报局（MIS）发布了其第五份专题研究报告——《1941年昔兰尼加德军防御战术的发展》。该研究得出结论，德军沙漠防御并非设计为不可移动的屏障；相反，它是一种纵深编成的综合体系，旨在先吸收并消耗敌军进攻，随后发动决定性的装甲反击。

军事情报局通过对缴获的德军军事文件进行系统评估，形成了这一判断。美国情报分析人员并未依赖战时估计或敌方宣传，而是翻译并评估了缴获的德军部队战争日志、作战命令、战后战斗报告和防御草图。该研究主要审视了非洲军三位师级指挥官所制定的防御战术：第21装甲师的约翰·冯·拉文施泰因少将、第15装甲师的沃尔特·诺伊曼-西尔科少将，以及第90轻装摩托化师的马克斯·祖默曼少将。该研究还通过缴获的关于战术试验、成功与失败的文件，考察了营连军官如何在战场上执行这三人的战术构想。
该研究重点阐述了德军通过艰苦实战获得的防御经验教训。德军军官起初依赖僵化的线式防御阵地，兵力分散且易被炮兵和装甲部队突破。战役初期，一名德军少校批评了这种防御准备不足，写道：“我们的人对构筑防御工事几乎一无所知”，并指出：“阵地步兵作战60%靠铁锹，30%靠望远镜，只有10%靠枪炮。

作为回应，德军放弃了连续前线，转而采用被称为“支撑点”（Stützpunkte）的独立且相互支援的据点。这些设防中心具备环形防御，布设有由反步兵地雷和反坦克地雷组成的纵深雷场、反坦克壕，以及旨在欺骗盟军侦察的假阵地。在战术层面，德军掌握了“三叶草”队形，将班和排编成三角形集群，以提供相互重叠的火力范围。此外，指挥官还确立了严格的射击纪律；重武器和反坦克炮被隐蔽起来，并奉命在敌军接近至近距离前不得开火，以确保突然性并最大程度发挥杀伤效果。

该研究指出，德军88毫米两用炮在守住这些阵地方面至关重要。制式37毫米和50毫米反坦克炮往往难以对付重装甲英军坦克，因此高初速的88毫米高射炮成为反坦克核心武器。报告提到，在埃及边境作战期间，“12门88毫米炮表现出惊人的反坦克性能”，并断言“88毫米炮、第5坦克团以及哈勒法亚和208高地的坚固防御为轴心国赢得了这场战斗。”在诸如卡普佐防御战等关键时刻，由临时拼凑的炮组操作的单门88毫米炮阻止了整支装甲纵队。正如该研究总结的那样，“然而，如果没有88毫米炮，任何阵地都无法击退英军的推进”，这使其成为“德军防御中最突出的单一要素”。
《昔兰尼加德军防御战术的发展》深入考察了埃尔温·隆美尔元帅的非洲军如何在1941年初适应静态沙漠防御。该部队最初几乎只接受快速进攻战训练。面对独特的沙漠后勤和地形，德军指挥官不得不迅速发明并完善新的防御方法。因此，除了阐述德军防御战术外，该研究还向美国军方领导人表明，德国陆军具有高度适应性，能够迅速转变其战术理论，以掌握沙漠中的防御阵地战。

items.title: 346th AEW conducts change of command as 31st Air Task Force takes over mission
items.author: 2nd Lt. Daniel White
items.summary: U.S. Air Force Col. Brad M. Dvorak assumed command of the 346th Air Expeditionary Wing from Col. William J. Watkins during a change of command ceremony at Jose Aponte De La Torre Airport in Ceiba, Puerto Rico, Oct. 7.
items.body:
CEIBA, Puerto Rico — U.S. Air Force Col. Brad M. Dvorak assumed command of the 346th Air Expeditionary Wing from Col. William J. Watkins during a change of command ceremony at Jose Aponte De La Torre Airport in Ceiba, Puerto Rico, Oct. 7.

Brig. Gen. Henry R. Jeffress III , Air Forces Southern deputy commander, presided over the ceremony.

“This team, under Col Watkins, did phenomenal work in generating steady state operations for the 346th,” said Jeffress. “They stood down two operating locations while standing up additional locations, moving personnel and aircraft with losing a single sortie, and demonstrating a level of readiness that directly protected our southern approaches and met the combatant commander’s highest-priority requirements.”

Watkins, a master academic instructor and weapons systems officer with over 2,100 flying hours, relinquished command after serving for almost seven months. Under his leadership, the 346th AEW enabled approximately 350 narco-terrorist interdictions, the movement of 1,870 tons of cargo, and the seizure of 207 metric tons of illicit drugs. The 346th AEW is responsible for approximately 1,000 personnel, running four operating locations, and supporting several joint flying units.

“Disciplined. Ready. Unbreakable. That’s who we were, and that’s who we are,” said Watkins. “But I speak for everyone here when I say we will rest well knowing the 31st Air Task Force is on guard at our southern front.”

After forming and training the 31st Air Task Force , Dvorak and his command chief, CMSgt Matthew Greiner, assume command of the 346th AEW during a critical period. The wing will continue generating combat air power in the Caribbean and supporting the emergent efforts of Joint Task Force Western Hemisphere , Department of War-directed operations, and the President’s priorities to disrupt illicit drug trafficking, deter malign actors, and protect the homeland.

“Today, we inherit something special. We inherit a wing that was born from the Air Force’s effort to create trained, cohesive teams that can move quickly and execute from day one,” said Dvorak. “We inherit the reputation established by those who came before us, and we inherit a responsibility to those who will come after us.”

Activated in July 2025 as the last of the Air Force’s ATFs, the 31st ATF pioneered a rapidly employable wing operations center , enabling expeditionary communication, distributed command and control, and the ability to detect, track, and defeat potential aerial threats. It was redesignated an air expeditionary wing to execute a world-wide deployment exercise, providing command and control, base operating support, and refueling capabilities to enable over 500 joint, combined sorties. Additionally, the 31st ATF pioneered tactical readiness in combat medicine and base defense, training assigned medics to special operations forces standards and building out a multi-layered counter-small unmanned aerial systems capability .

“These benchmarks have proven an agile unit of action concept, positioning the 31st ATF, now the 346th AEW, to sustain highly lethal, mobile, and survivable air power in contested environments,” said Dvorak. “During our time here, we look forward to building on mission accomplishments and lessons learned from previous evolutions and modeling the AEW 2.0 concept amid dynamic operational requirements.”

Prior to becoming the 31st ATF commander, Dvorak was the military assistant to the then-Assistant Secretary of Defense for Readiness at the Pentagon. He graduated from Arizona State University in 2004, where he commissioned through the ROTC program. He has served in a variety of operational and staff assignments at the squadron, joint, Office of the Secretary of War, and Headquarters Air Force levels. He is a senior air battle manager who has served as an instructor, evaluator, and weapons officer, with combat experience in the Middle East and Central Asia.

“To the new Airmen joining the 346th Air Expeditionary Wing—from the 31st Air Task Force, 31st Combat Air Base Squadron, and across the Air Force—I am honored to continue to serve with you,” said Dvorak. “Our environment is changing. Our mission is evolving. The Caribbean and the defense of our homeland demand vigilance, agility, and the ability to operate with our joint and interagency partners across a dynamic region.”

The 346th AEW directly contributes to defending the U.S. homeland by supporting the application of sustained pressure against malign actors and designated terrorist organizations. The wing’s mission reinforces the U.S. commitment to a comprehensive, whole-of-government, and multinational approach, working alongside trusted allies and partners to promote a secure, stable, and prosperous Western Hemisphere.
items.titleZh: 第346空中远征联队举行指挥权交接，第31空中特遣部队接管任务
items.summaryZh: 波多黎各塞瓦——10月7日，美国空军上校布拉德·M·德沃拉克在波多黎各塞瓦何塞·阿蓬特·德拉托雷机场举行的指挥权交接仪式上，从威廉·J·沃特金斯上校手中接任第346空中远征联队指挥权。
zhParas: 波多黎各塞瓦——10月7日，美国空军上校布拉德·M·德沃拉克在波多黎各塞瓦何塞·阿蓬特·德拉托雷机场举行的指挥权交接仪式上，从威廉·J·沃特金斯上校手中接任第346空中远征联队指挥权。
美国南方空军副司令亨利·R·杰弗里斯三世准将主持了仪式。
杰弗里斯说：“在沃特金斯上校领导下，这支团队为第346联队开展常态化行动做了出色工作。他们关闭了两个作战地点，同时启用了更多地点，调动了人员和飞机，且未损失一个架次，并展现出直接保护我国南部通道、满足作战司令部司令最高优先级需求的战备水平。
沃特金斯是一名高级学术教官和武器系统官，飞行时数超过2100小时，在任职近七个月后移交指挥权。在他的领导下，第346空中远征联队促成了约350次毒品恐怖分子拦截行动，运输了1870吨货物，并查获207公吨非法毒品。第346空中远征联队负责约1000名人员，运营四个作战地点，并支持若干联合飞行部队。
纪律严明。准备就绪。坚不可摧。这就是我们过去的样子，也是我们现在的样子，”沃特金斯说。“但我代表这里所有人说，知道第31空中特遣部队正守卫在我们的南部前线，我们会安心休息。
在组建并训练第31空中特遣部队后，德沃拉克及其指挥军士长、首席军士长马修·格雷纳在关键时期接掌第346空中远征联队。该联队将继续在加勒比地区生成作战空中力量，并支持西半球联合特遣部队的新近行动、战争部指导的行动，以及总统关于打击非法毒品贩运、威慑恶意行为体和保护国土的优先事项。
今天，我们继承了一份特别的东西。我们继承的是一支诞生于空军努力打造训练有素、团结一致、能够迅速机动并从第一天起就能执行任务的团队的联队，”德沃拉克说。“我们继承前人所树立的声誉，也继承对后来者的责任。

第31空中特遣部队于2025年7月启用，是空军最后一支空中特遣部队。它率先建立了一个可快速投用的联队作战中心，实现远征通信、分布式指挥与控制，以及探测、跟踪并击败潜在空中威胁的能力。该部队被改称为空中远征联队，以执行一次全球部署演习，提供指挥与控制、基地运行支持和加油能力，保障超过500个联合、联军架次。此外，第31空中特遣部队在战斗医学和基地防御方面率先推动战术战备，将所属医务兵按特种作战部队标准训练，并构建了多层次反小型无人机系统能力。
这些基准证明了一种敏捷行动单元概念，使第31空中特遣部队——即现在的第346空中远征联队——能够在对抗环境中维持高致命性、可机动和可生存的空中力量，”德沃拉克说。“在我们驻留此地期间，我们期待在任务成就和以往迭代的经验教训基础上继续发展，并在动态作战需求中示范空中远征联队2.0概念。
在成为第31空中特遣部队指挥官之前，德沃拉克曾在五角大楼担任时任负责战备的助理国防部长的军事助理。他于2004年毕业于亚利桑那州立大学，并通过该校的后备军官训练团项目获得任命。他曾在 Squadron、联合、战争部长办公室以及空军总部各级担任多种作战和参谋职务。他是一名资深空战管理员，曾担任教官、评估员和武器官，拥有在中东和中亚的作战经验。
对于加入第346空中远征联队的新空军人员——来自第31空中特遣部队、第31战斗空军基地中队以及整个空军——我很荣幸继续与你们并肩服役，”德沃拉克说。“我们的环境正在变化。我们的任务正在演变。加勒比地区以及保卫我国本土，要求我们保持警惕、灵活敏捷，并具备与联合及跨机构伙伴在一个充满活力的地区开展行动的能力。
第346空中远征联队通过支持对恶意行为体和被认定的恐怖组织持续施压，直接为保卫美国本土作出贡献。该联队的任务强化了美国对全面、全政府及多国协作方式的承诺，与可信赖的盟友和伙伴一道，促进西半球的安全、稳定与繁荣。

这些基准证明了一种敏捷行动单元概念，使第31空中特遣部队——即现在的第346空中远征联队——能够在对抗环境中维持高致命性、可机动和可生存的空中力量，”德沃拉克说。“在我们驻留此地期间，我们期待在任务成就和以往迭代的经验教训基础上继续发展，并在动态作战需求中示范空中远征联队2.0概念。

在成为第31空中特遣部队指挥官之前，德沃拉克曾在五角大楼担任时任负责战备的助理国防部长的军事助理。他于2004年毕业于亚利桑那州立大学，并通过该校的后备军官训练团项目获得任命。他曾在 Squadron、联合、战争部长办公室以及空军总部各级担任多种作战和参谋职务。他是一名资深空战管理员，曾担任教官、评估员和武器官，拥有在中东和中亚的作战经验。

对于加入第346空中远征联队的新空军人员——来自第31空中特遣部队、第31战斗空军基地中队以及整个空军——我很荣幸继续与你们并肩服役，”德沃拉克说。“我们的环境正在变化。我们的任务正在演变。加勒比地区以及保卫我国本土，要求我们保持警惕、灵活敏捷，并具备与联合及跨机构伙伴在一个充满活力的地区开展行动的能力。

第346空中远征联队通过支持对恶意行为体和被认定的恐怖组织持续施压，直接为保卫美国本土作出贡献。该联队的任务强化了美国对全面、全政府及多国协作方式的承诺，与可信赖的盟友和伙伴一道，促进西半球的安全、稳定与繁荣。

items.author: Michelle McCaskill
