items.title: Official poster depicts the US Army’s newest threat: The Iranian soldier
items.author: Michael Peck
items.summary: The U.S. Army recently published a quick-recognition guide to help soldiers identify members of the Iranian army.
items.body:
If America engages in a ground war with Iran, the U.S. Army wants to ensure that its soldiers can recognize the enemy.

A new U.S. Army poster depicts a soldier of the Iranian army. The graphics show a bearded soldier wearing sunglasses and a beret, with captions describing the various weapons he might carry and the uniforms he might wear.

That the U.S. Army has a quick-recognition guide for Iranian soldiers doesn’t mean America will invade Iran. The Army’s Training and Transformation Command has a library of graphical recognition posters for the armies of various nations, including China’s People’s Liberation Army.

The U.S.’s ongoing conflict with Iran has lasted nearly eight months. For now, both sides have waged war with aircraft, missiles and drones. But the possibility of American boots on the ground has always been present, such as seizing vital Iranian oil facilities on Kharg Island.

The new guide, published Sept. 24, isn’t focused on the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, the praetorian guard of the Iranian regime that grabs most of the headlines. The IRGC controls many of the weapons that have been fired at American forces and Iran’s neighbors, including ballistic missiles, drones and fast-attack boats.

Instead, the U.S. Army guide displays a soldier of the Islamic Republic of Iran Army, also known as Artesh. It is a mainly conscript force of 350,000 personnel that is essentially the regular armed forces of the nation of Iran, including armored, infantry, special forces, air defense, aircraft and naval units, according to the research organization the Institute for the Study of War.

In contrast, the IRGC protects an Iranian regime that doesn’t fully trust the regular armed forces, which date back to the days of the Shah. As in many authoritarian nations, such as Saddam Hussein’s Iraq, there is a deliberate rivalry between the regular and politicized armed forces, with the regime’s pet army getting the best equipment.

There have been numerous reports of low morale and harsh conditions for Artesh soldiers, including lack of food and medical care. One draftee said in a 2022 essay for the Atlantic Council, a Washington, D.C.-based think tank, that most soldiers do menial work, rather than combat training.

The Artesh soldier in the U.S. Army poster — wearing the green beret of the Iranian special forces — doesn’t appear much different than the infantry in many other armies, with a mix of Soviet, Western and Iranian gear. He is shown carrying an AKM, Masaf-2 or Heckler & Koch G3A6 rifle. He can also be armed with an MG3 machine gun or an RPG-7, plus grenades, body armor, rucksack, canteen and gas mask, among other gear.

The image shows five different camouflage uniforms, including khaki and woodland, as well as three camouflage patterns for the special forces. Also shown are the insignia of officer and enlisted ranks.

Michael Peck is a correspondent for Defense News and a columnist for the Center for European Policy Analysis. He holds an M.A. in political science from Rutgers University. Find him at theuncommondefense.com. His email is mikedefense1@gmail.com.
items.titleZh: 官方海报展示美国陆军的最新威胁：伊朗士兵
items.summaryZh: 美国陆军最近发布了一份快速识别指南，以帮助士兵识别伊朗军队成员。
zhParas: 如果美国与伊朗爆发地面战争，美国陆军希望确保其士兵能够识别敌人。
美国陆军的一张新海报描绘了一名伊朗军队士兵。图中显示了一名留着胡须、戴着太阳镜和贝雷帽的士兵，并配有说明文字，描述他可能携带的各种武器以及可能穿着的制服。
美国陆军为伊朗士兵制作快速识别指南，并不意味着美国将入侵伊朗。陆军训练与转型司令部拥有一个针对各国军队的图形识别海报库，其中包括中国人民解放军。
美国与伊朗持续进行的冲突已持续近八个月。目前，双方使用飞机、导弹和无人机作战。但美军地面部队介入的可能性始终存在，例如夺取伊朗在哈尔克岛上的重要石油设施。
这份于9月24日发布的新指南并未聚焦伊斯兰革命卫队——伊朗政权的禁卫军，也是占据大多数新闻头条的部队。伊斯兰革命卫队控制着许多曾向美军和伊朗邻国发射的武器，包括弹道导弹、无人机和快速攻击艇。
相反，美国陆军的指南展示的是伊朗伊斯兰共和国陆军（又称Artesh）的一名士兵。根据研究机构战争研究所的说法，这支部队主要以义务兵为主，拥有35万人，实质上是伊朗国家的正规武装力量，包括装甲、步兵、特种部队、防空、航空和海军部队。
相比之下，伊斯兰革命卫队保卫的是一个并不完全信任正规武装力量的伊朗政权，而正规武装力量的历史可追溯至沙阿（伊朗国王）时代。正如许多威权国家（如萨达姆·侯赛因统治下的伊拉克）一样，正规军与政治化武装力量之间存在刻意制造的竞争，而政权偏爱的军队获得最好的装备。
有许多关于阿尔特什（伊朗正规军）士兵士气低落和条件恶劣的报道，包括缺乏食物和医疗服务。一名应征入伍者在2022年为总部位于华盛顿特区的智库大西洋理事会撰写的一篇文章中说，大多数士兵从事杂役，而不是接受作战训练。
美国陆军海报中的阿尔特什士兵——头戴伊朗特种部队的绿色贝雷帽——与其他许多军队的步兵看起来没有太大不同，装备混合了苏联、西方和伊朗制式。图中显示他携带一支AKM、Masaf-2或黑克勒-科赫G3A6步枪。他也可能配备MG3机枪或RPG-7，以及手榴弹、防弹衣、背包、水壶和防毒面具等其他装备。
图中展示了五种不同的迷彩服，包括卡其色和丛林迷彩，以及特种部队的三种迷彩图案。图中还展示了军官和士兵军衔的徽章。
迈克尔·佩克是《防务新闻》的记者，也是欧洲政策分析中心的专栏作家。他拥有罗格斯大学政治学硕士学位。可在 theuncommondefense.com 找到他。他的电子邮箱是 mikedefense1@gmail.com。

如果美国与伊朗爆发地面战争，美国陆军希望确保其士兵能够识别敌人。

美国陆军的一张新海报描绘了一名伊朗军队士兵。图中显示了一名留着胡须、戴着太阳镜和贝雷帽的士兵，并配有说明文字，描述他可能携带的各种武器以及可能穿着的制服。

美国陆军为伊朗士兵制作快速识别指南，并不意味着美国将入侵伊朗。陆军训练与转型司令部拥有一个针对各国军队的图形识别海报库，其中包括中国人民解放军。

美国与伊朗持续进行的冲突已持续近八个月。目前，双方使用飞机、导弹和无人机作战。但美军地面部队介入的可能性始终存在，例如夺取伊朗在哈尔克岛上的重要石油设施。

这份于9月24日发布的新指南并未聚焦伊斯兰革命卫队——伊朗政权的禁卫军，也是占据大多数新闻头条的部队。伊斯兰革命卫队控制着许多曾向美军和伊朗邻国发射的武器，包括弹道导弹、无人机和快速攻击艇。

相反，美国陆军的指南展示的是伊朗伊斯兰共和国陆军（又称Artesh）的一名士兵。根据研究机构战争研究所的说法，这支部队主要以义务兵为主，拥有35万人，实质上是伊朗国家的正规武装力量，包括装甲、步兵、特种部队、防空、航空和海军部队。

相比之下，伊斯兰革命卫队保卫的是一个并不完全信任正规武装力量的伊朗政权，而正规武装力量的历史可追溯至沙阿（伊朗国王）时代。正如许多威权国家（如萨达姆·侯赛因统治下的伊拉克）一样，正规军与政治化武装力量之间存在刻意制造的竞争，而政权偏爱的军队获得最好的装备。

有许多关于阿尔特什（伊朗正规军）士兵士气低落和条件恶劣的报道，包括缺乏食物和医疗服务。一名应征入伍者在2022年为总部位于华盛顿特区的智库大西洋理事会撰写的一篇文章中说，大多数士兵从事杂役，而不是接受作战训练。

美国陆军海报中的阿尔特什士兵——头戴伊朗特种部队的绿色贝雷帽——与其他许多军队的步兵看起来没有太大不同，装备混合了苏联、西方和伊朗制式。图中显示他携带一支AKM、Masaf-2或黑克勒-科赫G3A6步枪。他也可能配备MG3机枪或RPG-7，以及手榴弹、防弹衣、背包、水壶和防毒面具等其他装备。

图中展示了五种不同的迷彩服，包括卡其色和丛林迷彩，以及特种部队的三种迷彩图案。图中还展示了军官和士兵军衔的徽章。

迈克尔·佩克是《防务新闻》的记者，也是欧洲政策分析中心的专栏作家。他拥有罗格斯大学政治学硕士学位。可在 theuncommondefense.com 找到他。他的电子邮箱是 mikedefense1@gmail.com。

items.title: Estonia’s KrattWorks crafting Shahed-like dummy drone for target practice
items.author: Jaroslaw Adamowski
items.summary: The Estonian company, which has announced a Shahed-like target drone, will show its products at this year's AUSA conference in Washington.
items.body:
WARSAW, Poland — Estonian unmanned aerial system producer KrattWorks is developing a new aerial target drone that will mimic the operations of jet-powered Shahed-type drones, enabling militaries to practice shooting down one of the main aerial threats used by Russia in its ongoing invasion of Ukraine.

As part of its international expansion plans, the company is promoting its unmanned solutions at this year’s AUSA conference in Washington as it seeks to strengthen its presence in the United States.

The company is pushing the project as numerous anti-drone system producers in Ukraine and other European countries are striving to make their interceptors cheaper than the targets they are meant to strike, and also suitable for mass production using readily available components.

Ranno Pajuri, business development manager at KrattWorks, told Defense News the new dummy drone is expected to be presented by the end of 2027.

“We need to obtain a working prototype that is reliable enough. The good thing is that we have software which can be adapted to different hardware quite easily,” he said. “But if the drone becomes so much different from what we have today and so much faster, then there are many variables to consider before it is stabilized and ready for a demonstration.”

The Ukrainian Army, to which the Estonian company has supplied one-way attack drones as well as other products such as its Ghost Dragon ISR drone, is one of the potential users of the new solution. KrattWorks has delivered its UAVs to customers in Europe, and the company is currently making efforts to boost its foothold in the United States as well as various markets in Asia and Africa. KrattWorks says its Ghost Dragon ISR systems have also been deployed in Estonia, Georgia and Moldova, among others.

“We produce our drones in Estonia. We have enough extra capacity to ramp up the production if the demand will grow. Aerial target drones are usually made within quite a short lead time,” Pajuri said. “But we are open to some level of transfer of production if this is necessary and the demand is large enough in the country to which we are selling our products.”

KrattWorks says its product portfolio includes the DART fixed-wing aerial target, which is intended for use against air-defense missiles, heavy machine guns and anti-aircraft cannons, and the DART-R, an aerial target decoy fitted with a radar reflector that can reach a maximum speed of 200 km/h (124 mph), according to data from the company. KrattWorks also makes the PARM aerial target quadcopter.

The manufacturer said it “builds ISR drones with wide frequency band-hopping radios and GNSS-free flight modes to help first responders and servicemen to gain fast situational awareness in situations where every second counts.”

The business cooperates closely with the Ukrainian Armed Forces and studies the UAV attacks that take place in Ukraine and the evolving tactics used there to improve its products. KrattWorks makes efforts to ensure that its aerial target drones mimic the latest operational trends and act in a realistic manner, the company representative said.

In its September 2026 report on Russia’s use of UAVs against Ukraine, the Institute for Science and International Security, a Washington-based think tank, said the Russian military used an estimated 5,166 Shahed-type drones, including decoys, against Ukrainian targets in August alone.

Meanwhile, the Office of the President of Ukraine said on Sept. 28 that the country’s military had reached an overall drone shoot-down rate of 70%, including both piston-powered and jet-powered Shaheds.

“But for jet-powered ‘Shaheds,’ unfortunately, the rate is much lower than it needs to be – 57%,” the office said in a statement. “New interceptors are being actively tested. Some combat teams are already using them, but of course, some details still need to be refined to ensure sufficient effectiveness and deployment at scale. We are pushing the developers to move faster.”

Jaroslaw Adamowski is the Poland correspondent for Defense News.
items.titleZh: 爱沙尼亚KrattWorks研制类似沙赫德的靶机用于打靶训练
items.summaryZh: 这家爱沙尼亚公司已宣布一款类似沙赫德的靶机，将在今年于华盛顿举行的美国陆军协会（AUSA）年会上展示其产品。
zhParas: 波兰华沙——爱沙尼亚无人机系统生产商KrattWorks正在研发一种新型空中靶机，该靶机将模拟喷气动力沙赫德型无人机的作战方式，使军队能够演练击落俄罗斯在持续入侵乌克兰过程中使用的主要空中威胁之一。
作为其国际扩张计划的一部分，该公司正在华盛顿举行的今年AUSA会议上推介其无人解决方案，以寻求加强在美国的影响力。
该公司正在推进该项目，因为乌克兰和其他欧洲国家的众多反无人机系统生产商正努力使其拦截器比它们所要打击的目标更便宜，并且适合使用易于获取的部件进行大规模生产。
KrattWorks业务发展经理Ranno Pajuri告诉《防务新闻》，这款新型假目标无人机预计将在2027年底前展示。
我们需要获得一个足够可靠、能正常工作的原型。好消息是我们有软件，可以相当容易地适配不同硬件，”他说。“但如果这款无人机与我们如今拥有的产品差异太大，而且速度快得多，那么在它稳定并准备好演示之前，需要考虑许多变量。
乌克兰陆军是这一新解决方案的潜在用户之一；这家爱沙尼亚公司曾向其供应单向攻击无人机，以及其Ghost Dragon ISR无人机等其他产品。KrattWorks已向欧洲客户交付其无人机，目前正努力扩大其在美国以及亚洲和非洲多个市场的立足点。KrattWorks表示，其Ghost Dragon ISR系统也已部署在爱沙尼亚、格鲁吉亚和摩尔多瓦等地。
我们在爱沙尼亚生产我们的无人机。如果需求增长，我们有足够的额外产能来扩大生产。空中靶标无人机通常可以在相当短的交货周期内制造出来，”帕尤里说。“但如果必要，并且我们销售产品的国家需求足够大，我们也愿意接受某种程度的生产转移。
KrattWorks表示，其产品组合包括DART固定翼空中靶标，旨在用于对抗防空导弹、重机枪和高射炮，以及DART-R，这是一种配备雷达反射器的空中靶标诱饵，根据该公司数据，其最高速度可达200公里/小时（124英里/小时）。KrattWorks还生产PARM空中靶标四旋翼无人机。
该制造商表示，它“制造配备宽频跳频无线电和无GNSS飞行模式的ISR无人机，以帮助一线应急人员和军人在分秒必争的情况下快速获得态势感知。
该公司与乌克兰武装部队密切合作，研究在乌克兰发生的无人机袭击以及当地不断演变的战术，以改进其产品。公司代表说，KrattWorks努力确保其空中靶标无人机模拟最新作战趋势，并以逼真的方式行动。
总部位于华盛顿的智库科学与国际安全研究所在其2026年9月关于俄罗斯对乌克兰使用无人机的报告中表示，仅8月份，俄罗斯军方就估计使用了5,166架沙赫德型无人机（包括诱饵）打击乌克兰目标。
与此同时，乌克兰总统办公室9月28日表示，该国军队的无人机总体击落率已达到70%，其中包括活塞动力和喷气动力的沙赫德无人机。
但对于喷气动力的‘沙赫德’无人机，遗憾的是，拦截率远低于所需水平——57%，”该办公室在一份声明中表示。“新型拦截弹正在积极测试中。一些作战小组已经在使用它们，但当然，仍有一些细节需要完善，以确保足够的有效性和规模化部署。我们正在敦促研发人员加快进度。
雅罗斯瓦夫·阿达莫夫斯基是《防务新闻》驻波兰记者。

items.body: U.S. Marines with 1st Marine Division Band and U.S. Navy Sailors with Navy Band Southwest perform during the 2026 Honor Our Fallen Concert at Marines’ Memorial Theatre in San Francisco as part of San Francisco Fleet Week, Oct. 8, 2026. San Francisco Fleet Week, now in its 45th iteration, is a time-honored celebration that allows citizens of the Bay Area to witness today’s maritime services firsthand. items.titleZh: 旧金山舰队周26：缅怀阵亡将士音乐会（B-Roll）
items.summaryZh: 2026年10月8日，作为旧金山舰队周活动的一部分，美国海军陆战队第1陆战师军乐队队员和美国海军西南乐队的水兵在旧金山海军陆战队纪念剧院举行的2026年“缅怀阵亡将士”音乐会上演出。旧金山舰队周如今已举办至第45届，是一项历史悠久的庆祝活动，让湾区民众得以亲身领略当今海上军种的风采。

items.title: Century-old houses getting new life at Fort Bragg
items.author: Karen Jowers
items.summary: 230 homes built before 1940 are being renovated at Fort Bragg.
items.body:
Homes that are nearly a century old are getting a new life at Fort Bragg, North Carolina, preserving their historic character while providing updated features and addressing safety concerns.

Officials at Fort Bragg and Corvias, the privatized housing company that operates the installation’s housing, recently marked the renovation of the first of 21 historic homes that are ready for military families. They were built between 1928 and 1939, and feature elements including stucco walls, copper gutters, hardwood floors and basements.

Fort Bragg has 230 homes that were built before 1940, and all are designated as historic. But these aren’t even the oldest of Army housing. There are 867 houses built before 1919, located on 19 other Army installations in 13 states and the District of Columbia, according to the Army.

At Fort Bragg, about 2,300 of the base’s 6,104 homes were built before 1960, officials said.

The Army manages the largest inventory of historic housing in the federal government, with more than 30,000 historic homes that are more than 50 years old. These homes are subject to the requirements of the National Historic Preservation Act, according to the Advisory Council on Historic Preservation.

That federal agency’s mission is to promote the preservation of America’s historic places and has worked with the Army and the other services as they prepare plans to renovate these houses, making sure they preserve the historic character while meeting the needs of families.

“These residences are an important part of Fort Bragg’s history, but their greatest value is continuing to serve soldiers and families who live in these homes,” said Col. Luke Wittmer, the installation’s garrison commander, in an announcement. “This renovation preserves history while ensuring we continue to meet the needs of today’s families.”

Historic homes have long been a challenge to preserve and maintain for military families, with a variety of issues such as lead paint and asbestos, which are both hazardous and costly to remediate.

Most of the military’s historic homes were included in the inventory of military housing that was turned over to private companies to operate and maintain, starting in the early 2000s.

According to the Army, historic homes currently take an average of 18 days to prepare between occupants, compared to 15 days for a standard home. The average cost is $4,342, compared to $3,681 for a standard home.

Fort Bragg was designated a permanent Army post in 1922, and construction of the first permanent party officers’ family quarters along Alexander and Hunt streets began in 1927, officials said. Construction of noncommissioned officer family housing began in 1928.

Karen has covered military families, quality of life and consumer issues for Military Times for more than 30 years, and is co-author of a chapter on media coverage of military families in the book "A Battle Plan for Supporting Military Families." She previously worked for newspapers in Guam, Norfolk, Jacksonville, Fla., and Athens, Ga.
items.titleZh: 布拉格堡百年住宅焕发新生
items.summaryZh: 在布拉格堡，230套建于1940年前的住宅正在进行翻新。
zhParas: 在北卡罗来纳州布拉格堡，已有近百年历史的住宅正焕发新生，既保留了其历史风貌，又提供了更新设施并解决了安全隐患。
布拉格堡的官员和运营该基地住房的私有化住房公司Corvias最近庆祝了首批翻修完工，这是21栋可供军人家庭入住的历史住宅中的第一栋。这些住宅建于1928年至1939年间，具有灰泥墙、铜制排水槽、硬木地板和地下室等特色。
布拉格堡有230套建于1940年之前的住房，且全部被指定为历史建筑。但这些甚至还不是陆军最古老的住房。据陆军称，还有867套建于1919年之前的住房，分布在13个州和哥伦比亚特区的另外19处陆军设施上。
官员表示，在布拉格堡，该基地6104套住房中约有2300套建于1960年之前。
美国陆军管理着联邦政府中规模最大的历史性住房存量，拥有超过3万套房龄超过50年的历史住宅。据历史保护咨询委员会称，这些住宅须遵守《国家历史保护法》的要求。
该联邦机构的使命是促进对美国历史场所的保护，并已与陆军及其他军种合作；在他们制定这些房屋的翻新计划时，确保既保留其历史风貌，又满足军人家庭的需求。
这些住宅是布拉格堡历史的重要组成部分，但它们最大的价值在于继续为居住在这些住宅中的士兵和家属服务，”该基地驻军司令卢克·维特默上校在一份公告中表示。“此次翻修保护了历史，同时确保我们继续满足当今家庭的需求。
对军人家庭而言，历史住宅长期以来一直难以保护和维护，存在含铅油漆和石棉等各种问题，而这些问题的治理既危险又成本高昂。
大多数军方历史性住房都被列入了军事住房清单，而这些住房从21世纪初开始被移交给私营公司运营和维护。
据陆军称，历史住宅目前在不同住户之间进行准备平均需要18天，而标准住宅为15天。平均费用为4342美元，而标准住宅为3681美元。
官员们表示，布拉格堡于1922年被指定为永久性陆军驻地，沿亚历山大街和亨特街的首批常驻军官家属宿舍于1927年动工。士官家属住房的建设于1928年开始。
凯伦为《军事时报》报道军人家庭、生活质量及消费者议题已有30多年，并合著了《支持军人家庭的作战计划》一书中关于媒体如何报道军人家庭的一章。她此前曾在关岛、诺福克、佛罗里达州杰克逊维尔和佐治亚州雅典的报社工作。

items.title: Long-Range Anti-Ship Missile Will Integrate onto B-52
items.author: Todd South
items.summary: The Air Force’s B-52 bomber may soon be able to carry up to 20 stealthy long-range anti-ship missiles to strike moving targets at sea, a key capability in a potential fight with China. The post Long-Range Anti-Ship Missile Will Integrate onto B-52 appeared first on Air & Space Forces Magazine .
items.body:
The Air Force’s B-52 bomber may soon be able to carry up to 20 stealthy long-range anti-ship missiles to strike moving targets at sea, a key capability in a potential fight with China.

An Oct. 7 notice from Naval Air Systems Command states that the command plans to award a contract to Lockheed Martin to integrate its Long-Range Anti-Ship Missile on the B-52.

The anticipated award “is for efforts associated with LRASM integration on the B-52 aircraft platform, to include missile software updates, associated testing, test asset repair, and failure review boards,” the notice states.

The B-52 can already carry up to 20 Joint Air-to-Surface Standoff Missiles, on which the LRASM is based. The two missiles share similar dimensions.

Naval News first reported on the possibility of integrating the LRASM onto the B-52 in 2019, though the idea languished for several years. But the ability to put LRASMs on the B-52 would have massive implications in a large-scale conflict, retired Air Force Col. Mark Gunzinger, a former B-52 pilot, told Air & Space Forces Magazine.

“A handful of B-52s will be able to deliver more weapons on maritime targets and do so over much longer ranges than the Navy’s carrier-based aircraft per day,” said Gunzinger, now as the director of future concepts and capability assessments for the Mitchell Institute of Aerospace Studies.

Spokespeople for NAVAIR and Air Force Life Cycle Management Center did not immediately responded to a request for comment. Lockheed spokesperson Scott Swofford declined to provide any further details about the effort, deferring to the Pentagon, but did tout LRASM’s capabilities.

“As a precise, stealthy and survivable cruise missile, LRASM provides multiservice, multiplatform, and multimission capabilities for offensive anti-surface warfare,” Swofford said. “By leveraging Lockheed Martin’s expertise in successful cruise missile productions, LRASM brings low-risk and long-term, flexible capabilities to the warfighters’ anti-surface warfare environment that no other inventory weapon provides.”

A Necessary Tool

The Oct. 7 notice continues a push to integrate LRASM onto the bomber fleet—the Air Force revealed in June that a B-2A Spirit employed a LRASM to strike a decommissioned amphibious transport vessel during a Pacific exercise, the first time the U.S. military has acknowledged the B-2’s use of that missile.

Such a pairing is important, Gunzinger said.

“The Air Force’s bomber force will be our military’s predominant maritime strike force, considering the number of anti-ship cruise missiles they can carry per sortie and deliver over intercontinental ranges, if necessary,” Gunzinger said. “And LRASMs will give our bomber force the ability to strike moving targets at sea with unprecedented accuracy.”

The move will expand commanders’ options to strike maritime targets while launching from airbases in lower threat density areas, he said, without putting aircraft carriers at risk.

- 2009: DARPA and the U.S. Navy initiate the program to develop advanced anti-ship strike capabilities.

- 2012: DARPA cancels the supersonic LRASM-B variant to focus exclusively on the subsonic, stealthy LRASM-A based on the JASSM-ER.

- 2013: Lockheed Martin completes the first successful air-launch flight test of the missile from a USAF B-1B bomber.

- 2015: The Pentagon officially designates the stealthy anti-ship missile as the AGM-158C.

- 2017: Lockheed Martin receives the first low-rate initial production contract

- 2018: The U.S. Air Force achieves Early Operational Capability with the AGM-158C on the B-1B Lancer.

- 2019: The U.S. Navy achieves Early Operational Capability integrating the missile onto F/A-18E/F Super Hornets.

- 2024: The U.S. Navy completes four-missile salvo testing and begins flight testing the round on the F-35C

- 2025: Initial flight testing expands to the F-35B short-takeoff/vertical-landing variant.

- 2026: Lockheed Martin expands factory capacity and contract modifications to boost annual production.

Sources: Lockheed Martin, Air & Space Forces Magazine, USNI

LRASM and JASSM

Lockheed produces both the the AGM-158 JASSM and the AGM-158C LRASM. There is also the AGM-158-JASSM Extended Range variant, which can hit targets out to 500 miles.

Currently, the B-1B Lancer, B-2A Spirit, B-52H Stratofortress, F-15 variants, F-16 variants, and C-130 Hercules can carry the JASSM.

The Air Force is also integrating the JASSM onto the F-35A Lightning II and the B-21 Raider.

The LRASM’s range hovers close to the baseline JASSM variant, just beyond 200 miles.

Air & Space Forces Magazine recently reported on JASSM and LRASM production progress based on Pentagon acquisition reports released in July.

The reports noted that, as of April, the Navy and Air Force were expanding their production plans for the shared munition. Lockheed had delivered a total of 5,348 JASSMs to both services. The company’s current production capacity is 600 JASSMs a year, with short-term plans to boost that to 860 missiles annually.

That’s key, as a recent Center for a New American Security report estimates that the Air Force has ripped through a quarter of its JASSM inventory during Operation Epic Fury.

Lockheed announced a new AGM-158 JASSM-FLEX variant in September at the AFA Air, Space & Cyber conference. The new variant lets users swap out the nose and launch options for various payloads and other configuration needs, which might include an LRASM option.

“The AGM-158 FLEX airframe concept was driven by a strategic need to keep pace with rapidly evolving threats, insert emerging technologies quickly, manage obsolescence, and provide, at scale, a cost-effective missile family that can be repurposed for a wide range of missions while delivering timely, relevant capability to the warfighter,” a Lockheed Martin spokesperson told Air & Space Forces Magazine via email.

The Air Force spent $200 million in fiscal 2025 for a second-source engine for the LRASM and JASSM-ER. Lockheed plans to spend between $8 and $9 million through 2030 to boost production on existing lines.
items.titleZh: 远程反舰导弹将整合到B-52上
items.summaryZh: 美国空军的B-52轰炸机可能很快就能携带多达20枚隐形远程反舰导弹，用于打击海上移动目标，这在与中国的潜在冲突中是一项关键能力。这篇题为《远程反舰导弹将整合到B-52上》的文章最初出现在《空军与太空军杂志》上。
zhParas: 美国空军的B-52轰炸机可能很快就能携带多达20枚隐形远程反舰导弹，用于打击海上移动目标，这在与中国的潜在冲突中是一项关键能力。
美国海军航空系统司令部10月7日发布的一份通知称，该司令部计划向洛克希德·马丁公司授予一份合同，将其远程反舰导弹集成到B-52轰炸机上。
通知称，预计授予的合同“用于与远程反舰导弹（LRASM）集成到B-52飞机平台相关的各项工作，包括导弹软件更新、相关测试、测试资产维修和故障审查委员会”。
B-52已经可以携带多达20枚联合空对地防区外导弹，而LRASM正是以该导弹为基础研制。这两种导弹的尺寸相近。
《海军新闻》于2019年首次报道了将LRASM集成到B-52上的可能性，但这一想法搁置了数年。不过，退役美国空军上校、前B-52飞行员马克·冈辛格告诉《空军与太空军杂志》，能将LRASM挂载到B-52上的能力将在大规模冲突中产生巨大影响。
少数几架B-52每天将能够向海上目标投送比海军舰载机更多的武器，而且投送距离要远得多，”现任米切尔航空航天研究所未来概念与能力评估主任的冈辛格说。
NAVAIR和空军生命周期管理中心的发言人均未立即回应置评请求。洛克希德公司发言人斯科特·斯沃福德拒绝提供有关这一工作的更多细节，表示应由五角大楼回应，但他对LRASM的能力大加赞赏。
作为一种精确、隐身且生存力强的巡航导弹，LRASM为进攻性反水面战提供了多军种、多平台和多任务能力，”斯沃福德说。“凭借洛克希德·马丁公司在成功巡航导弹生产方面的专长，LRASM为作战人员的反水面战环境带来了其他任何现役武器都无法提供的低风险、长期且灵活的能力。
必要的工具
10月7日的通告延续了将LRASM整合至轰炸机机队的努力——美国空军6月披露，一架B-2A“幽灵”在太平洋演习期间使用LRASM打击了一艘退役的两栖运输舰，这是美军首次承认B-2使用了该型导弹。
冈辛格表示，这种搭配非常重要。
考虑到空军轰炸机部队每架次可携带并在必要时可跨越洲际距离投送的反舰巡航导弹数量，空军轰炸机部队将成为我军最主要的海上打击力量，”冈辛格说。“而LRASM将使我们的轰炸机部队能够以前所未有的精度打击海上移动目标。
他说，此举将扩大指挥官打击海上目标的选择，同时可从威胁密度较低地区的空军基地发起行动，而无需让航母面临风险。
2009年：美国国防高级研究计划局与美国海军启动该项目，以发展先进反舰打击能力。
2012年：美国国防高级研究计划局取消超音速LRASM-B改型，转而完全专注于基于JASSM-ER的亚音速隐身LRASM-A。
2013年：洛克希德·马丁公司完成该导弹从美国空军B-1B轰炸机上首次成功的空射飞行试验。
2015年：五角大楼正式将这种隐身反舰导弹命名为AGM-158C。
- 2017年：洛克希德·马丁公司获得首份低速初始生产合同
- 2018年：美国空军在B-1B“枪骑兵”轰炸机上实现AGM-158C的早期作战能力。
- 2019年：美国海军将导弹集成到F/A-18E/F“超级大黄蜂”战斗机上，实现早期作战能力。
- 2024年：美国海军完成四枚导弹齐射测试，并开始在F-35C上对该导弹进行飞行测试
- 2025年：初始飞行测试扩展至F-35B短距起飞/垂直降落型。
- 2026年：洛克希德·马丁扩大工厂产能并修改合同，以提高年产量。
来源：洛克希德·马丁、《空天力量》杂志、美国海军学会
LRASM和JASSM
洛克希德公司同时生产AGM-158 JASSM和AGM-158C LRASM。此外还有AGM-158 JASSM增程型，可打击远至500英里外的目标。
目前，B-1B“枪骑兵”、B-2A“幽灵”、B-52H“同温层堡垒”、F-15各型、F-16各型和C-130“大力神”均可携带JASSM。
美国空军也在将JASSM集成到F-35A“闪电”II和B-21“突袭者”上。
LRASM的射程接近JASSM基本型，略超过200英里。
《空军与太空军杂志》最近依据7月发布的五角大楼采办报告，报道了JASSM和LRASM的生产进展。
报告指出，截至4月，海军和空军正在扩大这种共用弹药的生产计划。洛克希德公司已向这两个军种共交付了5,348枚JASSM。该公司目前的产能为每年600枚JASSM，并计划在短期内将年产量提升至860枚导弹。
这一点很关键，因为新美国安全中心最近的一份报告估计，空军在“史诗之怒”行动中已消耗了其JASSM库存的四分之一。
洛克希德公司在9月于美国空军协会航空航天与网络会议上宣布了一款新的AGM-158 JASSM-FLEX改型。新改型允许用户更换头部和发射选项，以适应各种有效载荷和其他配置需求，其中可能包括LRASM选项。
AGM-158 FLEX弹体概念源于一项战略需求：跟上迅速演变的威胁、快速嵌入新兴技术、管理过时淘汰问题，并大规模提供一种经济高效的导弹系列，该系列可改用于广泛任务，同时为作战人员及时提供相关能力，”洛克希德·马丁公司发言人通过电子邮件告诉《空军与太空部队杂志》。
美国空军在2025财年花费2亿美元，为LRASM和JASSM-ER采购第二来源发动机。洛克希德公司计划到2030年投入800万至900万美元，以提高现有生产线的产量。

items.title: Pentagon barred Qatar base access to hide Iran war damage, US senator claims
items.author: Cristina Stassis
items.summary: Sen. Chris Murphy, D-Conn., was denied access to Al Udeid Air Base, Qatar, during a recent Congressional Delegation trip in what he calls a "cover-up."
items.body:
A U.S. senator was recently denied access to the largest military installation in the Middle East, calling it a “cover-up” over the damage suffered during the Iran war.

Sen. Chris Murphy, D-Conn., visited the Middle East this week on a Congressional Delegation trip, speaking with Gulf region leaders and visiting American facilities to assess damage done by the Iran war. Murphy was denied access to Al Udeid Air Base, Qatar, which had suffered damage from drone strikes during the conflict.

“They are using every tool they can, including withholding information about damages, slow walking the pace of reports about casualties and denying us access to see the damage as part of a campaign of cover-up, so as to mask the true cost of the war,” Murphy told reporters on Thursday.

The “unprecedented” base denial prepared Murphy, a member of the Senate Foreign Relations Committee and Defense Appropriations Committee, in the coming days to draft language that would explicitly require the Department of Defense to grant members of Congress access to military bases overseas under all circumstances if needed.

“I don’t have any illusions that that’s going to pass between now and the end of the year, but I think that’ll be a really important part of the discussion around an appropriations bill next year and the defense authorization bill,” he said during the press call.

Prior to his trip, Murphy requested access to the base through a letter and direct appeal to U.S. Central Command leadership. But he was denied access even as the Department of State supported his trip to the region, with the Defense Department saying it was due to previously imposed travel restrictions.

“Senator Murphy’s office was informed before his trip to the Middle East that he would not receive Department of War support to access Al Udeid Air Base, consistent with the Secretary of War’s directive on travel restrictions in the region ordered on March 3, 2026,” a senior Defense Department official told Military Times on Thursday.

“That decision was communicated in advance by the Office of the Secretary of War for Legislative Affairs,” the official continued. “The Department applies the Secretary’s guidance evenly.”

In early March, the State and Defense departments issued travel guidance, calling on Americans to depart areas in the region and updating its travel advisory to recommend against visiting certain countries, including Qatar.

“It is absolutely ordinary for members of Congress to travel to areas of conflict and get to talk directly to the military leaders and the soldiers that are involved in the conflict and see for ourselves the damage that has been done to our bases and equipment,” Murphy said, highlighting how during the Iraq and Afghanistan wars he was able to visit operating bases.

He argued that since Congress decides funding and authorization for war, it is necessary to see the consequences, but he was unable to visit Al Udeid or have a briefing on the war with American military officials while in the region.

On the same day the travel advisory was issued in March, the U.S. embassy in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, was hit by two Iranians drones, resulting in building damage and a fire. Murphy said that the drones impacted multiple floors of the embassy and part of the space is now “uninhabitable” with permanent damage.

The U.S. previously announced in 2023 plans to build a new embassy compound in Riyadh, which Murphy attributes the lack of repairs to.

Even though no injuries or casualties were reported from the strike, Murphy said that if the attack happened during the day it would have killed many Americans.

“[Secretary of Defense Pete] Hegseth is determined to hide the cost and the consequences of this war from the American public, and it is absolutely outrageous that I and Republican senators are being denied the ability to see the damage for ourselves,” he said.

Cristina Stassis is a reporter covering stories surrounding the defense industry, national security, military/veteran affairs and more. She previously worked as an editorial fellow for Defense News in 2024 where she assisted the newsroom in breaking news across Sightline Media Group.
items.titleZh: 美参议员称五角大楼禁止进入卡塔尔基地以掩盖伊朗战争损害
items.summaryZh: 康涅狄格州民主党参议员克里斯·墨菲在最近一次国会代表团访问期间被拒绝进入卡塔尔的乌代德空军基地，他称这是“掩盖”。
zhParas: 一名美国参议员最近被拒绝进入中东最大的军事基地，他称这是对伊朗战争期间所受损害的“掩盖”。
康涅狄格州民主党参议员克里斯·墨菲本周随国会代表团访问中东，与海湾地区领导人交谈，并视察美国设施，以评估伊朗战争造成的损害。墨菲被拒绝进入位于卡塔尔的乌代德空军基地，该基地在冲突期间曾遭无人机袭击而受损。
他们正在动用一切可用手段，包括隐瞒损失信息、故意放缓伤亡报告发布速度，并拒绝让我们查看受损情况，以此作为掩盖行动的一部分，从而掩盖战争的真实代价，”墨菲周四告诉记者。
这一“前所未有”的拒绝进入基地的做法，让身为参议院外交关系委员会和国防拨款委员会成员的墨菲准备在接下来几天起草相关措辞，明确要求国防部在必要时无论何种情况都允许国会议员进入海外军事基地。
我并不幻想这能在今年年底前获得通过，但我认为，这将成为明年围绕拨款法案和国防授权法案的讨论中非常重要的一部分，”他在记者电话会上说。
在此行之前，墨菲通过一封信并直接向美军中央司令部领导层提出请求，要求进入该基地。但尽管美国国务院支持他前往该地区，他仍被拒绝进入，国防部则表示这是由于此前实施的旅行限制。
墨菲参议员办公室在他前往中东之前已被告知，他不会获得战争部支持进入乌代德空军基地，这符合战争部长于2026年3月3日下达的关于该地区旅行限制的指令，”一名国防部高级官员周四对《军事时报》表示。
该决定已由战争部长立法事务办公室提前传达，”这名官员继续说道。“战争部会一视同仁地执行部长的指导意见。
3月初，国务院和国防部发布了旅行指引，呼吁美国人离开该地区的相关区域，并更新旅行建议，建议不要前往某些国家，包括卡塔尔。
国会议员前往冲突地区，直接与参与冲突的军方领导人和士兵交谈，并亲眼查看我们的基地和设备所遭受的损害，这完全是寻常之事，”墨菲说，并强调在伊拉克和阿富汗战争期间，他能够访问作战基地。
他辩称，既然国会决定战争的资金和授权，就有必要亲眼看到后果，但他在该地区期间却无法访问乌代德空军基地，也无法与美国军方官员就这场战争听取简报。
在3月发布旅行警告的同一天，位于沙特阿拉伯利雅得的美国大使馆遭到两架伊朗无人机袭击，导致建筑受损并起火。墨菲表示，无人机击中了使馆的多个楼层，部分区域现已“无法居住”，并受到永久性损坏。
美国此前于2023年宣布计划在利雅得新建大使馆园区，墨菲将缺乏维修归因于此。
尽管此次袭击未报告造成人员受伤或死亡，墨菲称，如果袭击发生在白天，本会造成许多美国人死亡。
国防部长皮特·赫格塞思决心向美国公众隐瞒这场战争的代价和后果，而我和共和党参议员们被剥夺了亲眼查看破坏情况的能力，这绝对令人愤慨，”他说。

一名美国参议员最近被拒绝进入中东最大的军事基地，他称这是对伊朗战争期间所受损害的“掩盖”。

康涅狄格州民主党参议员克里斯·墨菲本周随国会代表团访问中东，与海湾地区领导人交谈，并视察美国设施，以评估伊朗战争造成的损害。墨菲被拒绝进入位于卡塔尔的乌代德空军基地，该基地在冲突期间曾遭无人机袭击而受损。

他们正在动用一切可用手段，包括隐瞒损失信息、故意放缓伤亡报告发布速度，并拒绝让我们查看受损情况，以此作为掩盖行动的一部分，从而掩盖战争的真实代价，”墨菲周四告诉记者。

这一“前所未有”的拒绝进入基地的做法，让身为参议院外交关系委员会和国防拨款委员会成员的墨菲准备在接下来几天起草相关措辞，明确要求国防部在必要时无论何种情况都允许国会议员进入海外军事基地。

items.title: Space Force Completes Personnel Management Act Transfers from Air Force
items.author: Greg Hadley
items.summary: The Space Force has finished transferring the last of the Air Force Reserve and Air National Guard members covered by the Personnel Management Act that created a hybrid full-time/part-time force. The post Space Force Completes Personnel Management Act Transfers from Air Force appeared first on Air & Space Forces Magazine .
items.body:
The Space Force has finished transferring the last of the Air Force Reserve and Air National Guard members covered by the Personnel Management Act that created a hybrid full-time/part-time force.

The last cohort of transfers—Air Force Reservists transitioning to part-time jobs in the Space Force—swore in to their new service on Oct. 1. The main transfer ceremony took place at Los Angeles Air Force Base, Calif., with some service members joining via video teleconference, according to a service release.

Over the past two and a half years, hundreds of Reservists and Guardsmen have transferred into the Space Force as part of the groundbreaking effort to consolidate space-focused units and personnel and create a force with no components that will allow Guardians to transition between full-time and part-time positions with fewer bureaucratic hurdles.

The Space Force Personnel Management Act, passed in late 2023 as part of the 2024 National Defense Authorization Act, laid out the process for those transfers to take place, starting with the Air Force Reserve. A year later, lawmakers voted that space missions in the Air National Guard would also be absorbed by the Space Force instead of creating a separate Space National Guard.

Officials said implementing the Personnel Management Act, or PMA, would be a yearslong process.

In May 2024—before the transfer of Air National Guard space mission into the Space Force was finalized—USSF announced a six-month window for members of the Air Force Reserve to apply to transfer into the new service on a full-time basis. Officials then conducted a series of boards, eventually selecting 380 Reservists for transfer by April 2025.

Then, in August 2025, USSF started accepting applications from Air National Guardsmen to transfer on a full-time basis. Another board selected 99 Guard members in early 2026 for transfer.

Separately, in September 2025, the Space Force announced it was accepting applications for Air Force Reservists to transfer in for part-time positions. In April, the service said it selected 247 individuals to do so, and the first part-time Guardians came aboard in July.

The Oct. 1 transfer ceremony was for the last of the part-time cohort. Guard and Reserve members can still join the Space Force through the prior service program, but the main movement is complete.

“The recently completed transfer cohort represented the final PMA-directed movement of [Air Reserve Component] members in the designated space-mission population,” a Space Force spokesperson told Air & Space Forces Magazine.

As part of the transition, the Space Force started assuming the Air National Guard’s space missions on Oct. 1, 2025.

The Space Force never opened a window for Air National Guardsmen to transfer into part-time work roles. The spokesperson noted that USSF “will continue to evaluate manpower requirements and the potential need for subsequent transfer windows as part of the overall growth model.”

The new members serving in a part-time capacity are called Guardians “Not on Sustained Duty.” They will be required to serve the equivalent of at least 36 days—48 four-hour Inactive Duty Training periods and 12 Annual Training days—per year to have a “good year” toward retirement.

The former Reservists and Guardsmen joining the Space Force bring deep experience to the service at a time when it is looking to grow dramatically—that’s important, officials say, to match the coming surge of brand-new Guardians.

Too many new Guardians with little experience entering at the lowest ranks could wreak havoc on the service’s grade structure, Deputy Chief of Space Operations for personnel Katharine Kelley said last month at AFA’s Air, Space & Cyber conference.

“We’re trying to balance not having all of our accessions be brand new in terms of experience,” she said. “We’re looking for ways to make sure that we can kind of balance this as a sourcing model and a sustainment model for people.”
items.titleZh: 太空军完成从空军转隶《人事管理法》人员
items.summaryZh: 太空军已完成对《人事管理法》所涵盖的最后一批空军预备役和空军国民警卫队成员的转隶，该法打造了一支全职与兼职混合的部队。《太空军完成从空军转隶〈人事管理法〉人员》一文最初发表于《空军与太空军杂志》。
zhParas: 太空军已完成对《人事管理法》所涵盖的最后一批空军预备役和空军国民警卫队成员的转隶，该法打造了一支全职与兼职混合的部队。
最后一批转隶人员——即转入太空军兼职岗位的空军预备役人员——于10月1日宣誓加入新军种。据军方新闻稿称，主转隶仪式在加利福尼亚州洛杉矶空军基地举行，部分军人通过视频电话会议参加。
在过去两年半里，数百名预备役人员和国民警卫队人员已转隶太空军，这是这项开创性举措的一部分，旨在整合以太空为重点的部队和人员，并建立一支不设独立组成部分的军种，使“守护者”能够以更少的官僚障碍在全职和兼职岗位之间转换。
《太空军人事管理法》作为2024年国防授权法案的一部分于2023年底通过，规定了这些转隶的实施流程，首先从空军预备役开始。一年后，立法者投票决定，空军国民警卫队中的太空任务也将由太空军吸收，而不是单独组建一支太空国民警卫队。
官员表示，实施《人事管理法》（简称PMA）将是一个长达数年的过程。
2024年5月——在空军国民警卫队太空任务移交给太空军最终确定之前——美国太空军宣布了一个为期六个月的窗口期，供空军预备役成员申请以全职身份转入这个新军种。官员随后召开了一系列遴选委员会会议，最终选定380名预备役人员，在2025年4月前完成转入。
随后，2025年8月，美国太空军开始接受空军国民警卫队队员以全职身份转入的申请。另一个遴选委员会于2026年初选定了99名国民警卫队成员进行转入。
另外，2025年9月，太空军宣布开始接受空军预备役人员申请转入兼职岗位。4月，该军种表示已遴选247人进行转入，首批兼职太空军成员于7月加入。
10月1日的移交仪式是为最后一批兼职人员举行的。国民警卫队和预备役成员仍可通过先前服役人员项目加入太空军，但主体转移工作已经完成。
最近完成的这批移交人员，是《人事管理法》指示的、对指定太空任务人员群体中[空军预备役组成部分]成员的最后一次调动，”一位太空军发言人对《空军与太空军杂志》表示。
作为过渡的一部分，太空军于2025年10月1日开始接管空军国民警卫队的太空任务。
太空军从未为空军国民警卫队人员开放转入兼职工作岗位的窗口。发言人指出，美国太空军“将继续评估人力需求，以及作为整体增长模式一部分的后续转入窗口的潜在需求”。
以兼职身份服役的新成员被称为“非持续勤务”守护者。他们将需每年服役至少相当于36天——48个四小时的非现役训练期和12天年度训练日——才能在退休方面算作一个“良好年度”。
加入太空军的前预备役人员和国民警卫队队员为这个军种带来了深厚经验，而太空军眼下正寻求大幅扩张——官员们表示，这对于应对即将到来的大批全新守护者至关重要。
太空军负责人事的副作战部长凯瑟琳·凯利上个月在美国空军协会（AFA）航空航天与网络会议上表示，过多缺乏经验的新守护者从最低军衔加入，可能会严重扰乱该军种的军衔结构。
我们正试图平衡，不让所有新招录人员都完全没有经验，”她说。“我们正在寻找办法，确保能够将人员来源模式和人员维持模式在一定程度上平衡起来。

items.title: Counter-Drone Task Force Taps Directed Energy Systems for December Shoot-Off
items.author: Matthew Cox
items.summary: The Pentagon’s counter-drone task force recently selected four directed energy weapons it will test in a December shoot-off to identify lasers and microwave systems that could defend U.S. military installations from future aerial attacks. The post Counter-Drone Task Force Taps Directed Energy Systems for December Shoot-Off appeared first on Air & Space Forces Magazine .
items.body:
The Pentagon’s counter-drone task force recently selected four directed energy weapons it will test in a December shoot-off to identify lasers and microwave systems that could defend U.S. military installations from future aerial attacks.

The three laser weapons and one microwave system are the first to be selected for the Joint Interagency Task Force 401’s counter-unmanned aircraft systems directed energy pilot program, according to a Pentagon announcement. The pilot is a congressional requirement in the 2026 National Defense Authorization Act.

“High-energy lasers and high-powered microwave systems are tools that can be effectively used in a layered drone defense,” Army Brig. Gen. Matt Ross, director of JIATF 401, said in the announcement. “This pilot program will test these capabilities in an operational environment so we can understand how best to integrate and sustain them to defend the homeland.”

The four weapon systems selected to participate in the shoot-off at Dugway Proving Ground, Utah are:

- AeroVironment’s Palletized High-Energy Laser system

- Epirus’ Leonidas High-Powered Microwave system

- Kord Technologies’ Firefly High-Energy Laser system

- Boeing’s Compact Laser Weapon system

In May, JIATF 401 selected Grand Forks Air Force Base, N.D. and Whiteman Air Force Base, Mo.—along with Fort Huachuca, Ariz.; Fort Bliss, Texas; and Naval Base Kitsap, Wash.—to “support rigorous testing and operational assessments across diverse environments” for the pilot effort. U.S. Northern Command and the Federal Aviation Administration are also involved in the pilot, the announcement states.

The announcement of the four systems selected for the shoot-off comes seven months after an incident involving the firing of a military counter-drone laser on the southwest border that prompted the FAA to shut down all flight traffic over El Paso. The Pentagon and the FAA then quickly completed a “data-informed Safety Risk Assessment” of a high-energy laser counter-drone system which found that the counter-drone technology does “not pose undue risk to passenger aircraft.”

Epirus’ Leonidas system is the only high-powered microwave selected for the shoot-off so far. The Army awarded a $43.5 million contract to Epirus in July 2025, which included the delivery of two Integrated Fires Protection Capability High-Power Microwave, or IFPC-HPM Generation II systems, which rely on “weaponized electromagnetic interference” to down drones.

AeroVironment’s Palletized High-Energy Laser system features the firm’s LOCUST X3, a 30-kilowatt system the Army selected in September with a production contract valued at roughly $465 million.

Boeing’s Compact Laser Weapon is available in 2-kilowatt and 5-kilowatt versions. The 5-kilowatt system plugged into the Army’s Forward Area Air Defense Command and Control network to defeat Group 3 drones weighing up to 1,320 pounds during the September 2024 Red Sands Integrated Experimentation Center in Saudi Arabia, according to Boeing.

Kord’s Firefly High-Energy Laser is a palletized, mobile system that features scalable power from 5-kilowatts up to 30-kilowatts. It relies on advanced AI detection and tracking algorithms to “detect, track, intercept and defeat incoming drones at standoff ranges,” according to Kord, a subsidiary of KBR.

JIATF 401 plans to evaluate additional directed energy technologies that could be selected to participate in the shoot-off event, according to the announcement.

“Directed energy gives commanders another option within a layered defense, complementing existing counter-UAS capabilities with a scalable, safe, and effective way to respond to drone threats,” Ross said. “This pilot program will give us vital information in a real-world environment so we can employ these systems to protect the homeland.”

The Air Force is looking to up its counter-drone capabilities to defend bases, a mission it refers to as “point defense.” The service’s primary weapon system for doing so is the Small Unmanned Air Defense Systems, or SUADS. The system is capable of identifying and tracking enemy missiles or drones of multiple sizes, and downing incoming drones with an electronic warfare weapon, but officials have declined to identify what that system is. It can also interface with commercial counter-drone systems and other air defense systems, depending on the needs of a commander.

It’s unclear how much the service has spent or plans to spend on new counter-drone tech. The Air Force requested more than $1.5 billion for SUADS in the fiscal 2027 budget, most of it for missile defense components, according to budget documents. Additional counter-drone systems are being acquired with the assistance of JIATF 401, but those are not listed in the budget request and both Air Force and JIATF 401 officials have declined to provide funding details.

The Air Force Research Laboratory has experimented with high-powered microwave systems to down drones—in 2023, AFRL used the Tactical High-power Operational Responder, or THOR, to disable a drone swarm.
items.titleZh: 反无人机特遣部队选用定向能系统参加12月射击竞赛
items.summaryZh: 五角大楼的反无人机特遣部队最近选定了四种定向能武器，将于12月进行射击竞赛测试，以识别能够保护美国军事设施免受未来空中攻击的激光和微波系统。该文《反无人机特遣部队选用定向能系统参加12月射击竞赛》最初发表于《空军与太空部队杂志》。
zhParas: 五角大楼的反无人机特遣部队最近选定了四种定向能武器，将于12月进行射击竞赛测试，以识别能够保护美国军事设施免受未来空中攻击的激光和微波系统。
根据五角大楼发布的一项公告，这三种激光武器和一种微波系统是首批被选中参与联合跨机构特遣部队401反无人航空系统定向能试点项目的装备。该试点项目是2026年国防授权法案中的一项国会要求。
高能激光和高功率微波系统是可在分层无人机防御中有效使用的工具，”联合跨机构特遣部队401主任、陆军准将马特·罗斯在公告中表示。“该试点项目将在作战环境中测试这些能力，以便我们了解如何最好地整合并维持它们，从而保卫国土。
被选中参加在犹他州达格韦试验场射击对比测试的四套武器系统分别是：
- AeroVironment的托盘化高能激光系统
- Epirus的Leonidas高功率微波系统
- Kord Technologies的Firefly高能激光系统
- 波音公司的紧凑型激光武器系统
5月，JIATF 401选定北达科他州大福克斯空军基地和密苏里州怀特曼空军基地，以及亚利桑那州瓦丘卡堡、得克萨斯州布利斯堡和华盛顿州基察普海军基地，为这一试点工作“在多样化环境中支持严格测试和作战评估”。公告称，美军北方司令部和美国联邦航空管理局也参与了该试点。
入选射击演练的四套系统公布之时，距西南边境发生一起军用反无人机激光器发射事件已有七个月；该事件促使美国联邦航空管理局关闭了埃尔帕索上空的所有空中交通。五角大楼和美国联邦航空管理局随后迅速完成了一项针对高能激光反无人机系统的“基于数据的安全风险评估”，评估认为该反无人机技术“不会对客机构成不当风险”。
迄今为止，Epirus的Leonidas系统是唯一入选射击演练的高功率微波系统。美国陆军于2025年7月授予Epirus一份价值4350万美元的合同，其中包括交付两套综合火力防护能力高功率微波（IFPC-HPM）第二代系统；这些系统依靠“武器化电磁干扰”击落无人机。
AeroVironment公司的托盘式高能激光系统采用该公司的LOCUST X3，这是一种30千瓦系统；美国陆军于9月选定该系统，相关生产合同价值约4.65亿美元。
波音公司的紧凑型激光武器有2千瓦和5千瓦两种版本。据波音公司称，5千瓦系统接入美国陆军的“前方地区防空指挥与控制”网络，在2024年9月于沙特阿拉伯举行的“红沙综合实验中心”活动期间，击落了重达1320磅的第三类无人机。
Kord公司的“萤火虫”高能激光武器是一种托盘化、机动式系统，功率可从5千瓦扩展到30千瓦。据KBR子公司Kord称，该系统依靠先进的人工智能探测与跟踪算法，“在远距离上探测、跟踪、拦截并击败来袭无人机”。
根据公告，JIATF 401计划评估更多定向能技术，这些技术可能会被选中参加此次射击比测活动。
定向能为指挥官在分层防御中提供了另一种选择，它以可扩展、安全且有效的方式应对无人机威胁，补充现有反无人机能力，”罗斯说。“这一试点项目将在真实环境中为我们提供关键信息，以便我们能够运用这些系统来保卫国土。
美国空军正寻求提升其反无人机能力以保卫基地，这项任务被其称为“点防御”。该军种执行这一任务的主要武器系统是小型无人机防空系统（SUADS）。该系统能够识别和跟踪多种尺寸的敌方导弹或无人机，并用一种电子战武器击落来袭无人机，但官员们拒绝透露该系统是什么。它还可以根据指挥官的需求，与商用反无人机系统和其他防空系统对接。
目前尚不清楚该军种在新型反无人机技术方面已花费多少或计划花费多少。根据预算文件，美国空军在2027财年预算中为小型无人机防空系统（SUADS）申请了超过15亿美元，其中大部分用于导弹防御组件。更多反无人机系统正在JIATF 401的协助下采购，但这些系统未列入预算申请，美国空军和JIATF 401官员均拒绝提供资金细节。
美国空军研究实验室已试验用高功率微波系统击落无人机——2023年，AFRL使用战术高功率作战响应器（THOR）使一个无人机蜂群失能。

items.title: Legendary fighter takes final flight, Air Force Reserve delivers F-117A to Smithsonian
items.author: Staff Sgt. Alexis Morris
items.summary: The Air Force Reserve delivered an F-117A Nighthawk to the Smithsonian’s National Air and Space Museum aboard a C-5M Super Galaxy, preserving the historic stealth fighter for future generations.
items.body:
Published Oct. 8, 2026

By Staff Sgt. Alexis Morris

512th Airlift Wing

Nearly two decades after the U.S. Air Force retired the airframe from combat, one F-117A Nighthawk had the rare opportunity to take to the skies once more: this time, in the cargo hold of a C-5M Super Galaxy . The historic stealth aircraft, bound for the Smithsonian Institution’s National Air and Space Museum’s Steven F. Udvar-Hazy Center in Chantilly, Virginia, would soon join the institution’s permanent collection. The two-day, cross-country mission required precise weight distribution and millimeter-level clearances to fit the 29,500-pound load into the C-5M’s cargo compartment. For the 512th Airlift reservists, executing high-consequence, strategic airlift operations is business as usual—even when the payload is a piece of aviation history.

items.titleZh: 传奇战斗机完成最后一次飞行，美国空军预备役将F-117A交付史密森尼
items.summaryZh: 美国空军预备役用一架C-5M“超级银河”运输机将一架F-117A“夜鹰”隐形战斗机运抵史密森尼国家航空航天博物馆，为子孙后代保存这架具有历史意义的隐形战斗机。
zhParas: 发布于2026年10月8日
作者：亚历克西斯·莫里斯上士
第512空运联队

在美国空军将这型机体从作战序列中退役近二十年后，一架F-117A“夜鹰”获得了罕见的机会再次升空：这一次，它是在一架C-5M“超级银河”的货舱中。这架历史性的隐身飞机正运往位于弗吉尼亚州尚蒂伊的史密森学会国家航空航天博物馆史蒂文·F·乌德瓦-哈齐中心，不久将加入该机构的永久收藏。这次为期两天、横跨全国的任务需要精确的重量分配和毫米级间隙，才能将29,500磅的载荷装入C-5M的货舱。对于第512空运联队的预备役人员来说，执行后果重大的战略空运行动是家常便饭——即便载荷是一件航空历史文物。

items.title: Sig Sauer develops 25-round mag for Army’s next-gen rifle
items.author: Hope Hodge Seck
items.summary: Soldier feedback, from the constructive to the blistering, has been instrumental in guiding Sig Sauer in its development of the M8 carbine.
items.body:
EPPING, N.H. — Soldier feedback, from the constructive to the blistering, has been instrumental in guiding weapons manufacturer Sig Sauer in its development of the M8 carbine, staff here said this week.

The M8, a compact alternative to Sig’s much-criticized M7 Next Generation Squad Weapon rifle, appears poised to take the M7’s place as the new standard weapon for soldiers, with significant weight reduction and key modifications that address troops’ concerns.

Among those changes is a 25-round magazine to replace the 20-round mag that shipped with the M7, said Josh Shoemaker, Sig’s product manager for defense.

The NGSW program marked a transition from the legacy M4 rifle’s 5.56mm ammo to the 6.8X51mm Common Cartridge, an internally designed caliber used both by the rifle and the coming M250 light machine gun. For some soldiers accustomed to the M4’s 30-round magazines, this has represented a major concern.

“Guys are coming from the 5.56mm system, where they’re used to being able to carry seven 30-round magazines into combat, so they have 210 rounds, roughly, going into a fight,” Shoemaker said in an interview. “Well, now that they’ve gone to this larger caliber, there’s 20-round magazines, so you’re reducing the volume of rounds that you have.”

Previously, Sig Sauer and the Army have emphasized that the 6.8mm round is heavier and carries greater kinetic energy and power, allowing troops to use fewer rounds to achieve the same effect on a target.

Last year, Brig. Gen. Phil Kinniery, commandant for the Army’s Infantry School and Maneuver Center of Excellence at Fort Benning, Georgia, told Task and Purpose that the 6.8mm ammo “stops the enemy at one round” versus the several rounds the legacy system would require.

Regardless, Shoemaker said, that purported difference can’t be seen in training; paper targets respond the same to bullets of either caliber.

Early criticism has cited ammo-management challenges in training with troops who find themselves with only 140 rounds to fire instead of the 210 they’re used to.

“Guys are having to think, ‘OK, well, how much ammo do I have left?’” Shoemaker said. “Sig has already, in a year’s time, developed a 25-round mag solution to extend some of that mag capacity out of the gate.”

It’s not clear if that 25-round magazine will immediately ship with the M8 carbine when fielding of that weapon begins in December.

Shoemaker said the alternative magazines were in early soldier evaluations and feedback and had to complete a full Army evaluation before they could be approved for use by soldiers.

“But in terms of production and manufacturing, we’re pretty much ready to go here in the next few months, to start spitting those out,” he said.

Soldier feedback also pushed Sig Sauer to design a more rigid handguard on the M8, eliminating some of the flexibility in the M7 that had presented a problem for soldiers.

“We saw that with the guys jumping out of planes, and they were like, ‘Hey, man, we’re getting a lot of flex, and then our lasers don’t line up, and we can’t hit targets at night,’” Shoemaker said. “That’s a real problem.”

The new handguard uses a newly developed insert and additional screws to reduce unwanted movement to a minimum. It will come standard on the M8.

“The M4 was in service for over 60 years, and it had a lot of iterations in between that,” Shoemaker said. “There will be continuous improvements and evolutions of that as we go along. … And as the system matures, some of that feedback gets more and more nitpicky, you know, and we love it. The smaller stuff is just as important to us as the big stuff.”
items.titleZh: 西格绍尔为美陆军下一代步枪研制25发弹匣
items.summaryZh: 士兵反馈，从建设性意见到尖锐批评，在指导西格绍尔研发M8卡宾枪方面发挥了关键作用。
zhParas: 新罕布什尔州埃平——这里的工作人员本周表示，从建设性意见到尖锐批评，士兵反馈在指导武器制造商西格绍尔研发M8卡宾枪方面发挥了关键作用。
M8作为西格绍尔饱受批评的M7“下一代班组武器”步枪的紧凑型替代方案，似乎有望取代M7，成为士兵的新制式武器；其重量显著减轻，并进行了关键改进，以回应部队的关切。
西格绍尔防务产品经理乔什·舒梅克表示，这些改动之一是用25发弹匣取代随M7配发的20发弹匣。
NGSW计划标志着从老式M4步枪的5.56毫米弹药向6.8×51毫米通用弹的过渡，这是一种内部设计的口径，该步枪和即将推出的M250轻机枪都将使用。对于一些习惯了M4的30发弹匣的士兵来说，这构成了一个重大担忧。
这些人是从5.56毫米系统过来的，他们习惯在战斗中携带七个30发弹匣，也就是说，投入战斗时大约有210发子弹，”舒梅克在接受采访时说。“而现在他们改用这种更大的口径，弹匣是20发的，所以你携带的弹药数量就减少了。
此前，西格绍尔和陆军曾强调，6.8毫米弹药更重，具有更大的动能和威力，使部队能够用更少的弹药对目标取得相同的效果。
去年，佐治亚州本宁堡美国陆军步兵学校与机动卓越中心指挥官菲尔·金尼里准将告诉《任务与目的》，6.8毫米弹药“一发就能阻止敌人”，而旧式系统则需要数发。
尽管如此，舒梅克说，这种所谓的差异在训练中看不出来；纸靶对两种口径的子弹反应相同。
早期批评提到了训练中的弹药管理挑战：部队发现自己只有140发子弹可发射，而非他们惯常的210发。
士兵们不得不琢磨，‘好吧，我还剩多少弹药？’”舒梅克说。“西格已经在一年内开发出一种25发弹匣方案，从一开始就扩展了部分弹匣容量。
目前尚不清楚，当该武器于12月开始列装时，那种25发弹匣是否会立即随M8卡宾枪一同配发。
舒梅克表示，这些替代弹匣正处于早期士兵评估和反馈阶段，必须完成完整的陆军评估后，才能获准供士兵使用。
但在生产和制造方面，未来几个月内我们基本上已经准备就绪，可以开始把这些产品源源不断地生产出来了，”他说。
士兵的反馈还促使西格绍尔为M8设计了更坚固的护木，消除了M7上曾给士兵带来问题的一些形变。
我们在那些从飞机上跳下来的士兵身上看到了这一点，他们说，‘嘿，老兄，我们这儿形变很严重，结果激光对不上，晚上根本打不中目标，’”舒梅克说。“这是个大问题。
新型护木采用新开发的嵌件和额外螺钉，将不必要的移动降至最低。它将成为M8的标准配置。
M4服役超过60年，在此期间经历了大量迭代，”舒梅克说。“随着我们不断推进，该系统将持续改进和演进。……而且，随着系统日趋成熟，一些反馈会变得越来越吹毛求疵，你知道，而我们很喜欢这样。对我们来说，小问题和大问题同样重要。

新罕布什尔州埃平——这里的工作人员本周表示，从建设性意见到尖锐批评，士兵反馈在指导武器制造商西格绍尔研发M8卡宾枪方面发挥了关键作用。

M8作为西格绍尔饱受批评的M7“下一代班组武器”步枪的紧凑型替代方案，似乎有望取代M7，成为士兵的新制式武器；其重量显著减轻，并进行了关键改进，以回应部队的关切。

西格绍尔防务产品经理乔什·舒梅克表示，这些改动之一是用25发弹匣取代随M7配发的20发弹匣。

NGSW计划标志着从老式M4步枪的5.56毫米弹药向6.8×51毫米通用弹的过渡，这是一种内部设计的口径，该步枪和即将推出的M250轻机枪都将使用。对于一些习惯了M4的30发弹匣的士兵来说，这构成了一个重大担忧。

这些人是从5.56毫米系统过来的，他们习惯在战斗中携带七个30发弹匣，也就是说，投入战斗时大约有210发子弹，”舒梅克在接受采访时说。“而现在他们改用这种更大的口径，弹匣是20发的，所以你携带的弹药数量就减少了。

此前，西格绍尔和陆军曾强调，6.8毫米弹药更重，具有更大的动能和威力，使部队能够用更少的弹药对目标取得相同的效果。

去年，佐治亚州本宁堡美国陆军步兵学校与机动卓越中心指挥官菲尔·金尼里准将告诉《任务与目的》，6.8毫米弹药“一发就能阻止敌人”，而旧式系统则需要数发。

早期批评提到了训练中的弹药管理挑战：部队发现自己只有140发子弹可发射，而非他们惯常的210发。

士兵们不得不琢磨，‘好吧，我还剩多少弹药？’”舒梅克说。“西格已经在一年内开发出一种25发弹匣方案，从一开始就扩展了部分弹匣容量。

items.title: 403rd Wing evacuates aircraft, continues to fly Hurricane Isaias
items.author: Lt. Col. Marnee Losurdo
items.summary: The 403rd Wing and Air Force Reserve Hurricane Hunters have relocated aircraft to Joint Base San Antonio, Texas, but will continue flying weather reconnaissance missions into Hurricane Isaias to collect data for the National Hurricane Center to improve storm track and intensity forecasts.
items.body:
The 403rd Wing relocated its aircraft Oct. 8 as Hurricane Isaias approaches the U.S. Gulf Coast. The wing relocates its aircraft out of the path of the storm to protect the aircraft and preserve the ability to continue conducting weather reconnaissance. (U.S. Air Force photo by Jessica L. Kendziorek) Photo Details / Download Hi-Res

The 403rd Wing relocated its aircraft Oct. 8 as Hurricane Isaias approaches the U.S. Gulf Coast. The wing relocates its aircraft out of the path of the storm to protect the aircraft and preserve the ability to continue conducting weather reconnaissance. (U.S. Air Force photo by Jessica L. Kendziorek)

Second Lt. Andrew Wilson, a 53rd Weather Reconnaissance Squadron aerial reconnaissance weather officer, flies through Tropical Storm Isaias on Oct. 7, 2026. The crew members fly through the storm to collect vital weather data for the National Hurricane Center, which is used to update weather forecast models. (U.S. Air Force photo by Lt. Col. Marnee Losurdo)

items.title: New Kyiv Business Centre opens in Ukraine
items.summary: The inaugural meeting has been held at the centre, which provides a permanent foothold in Ukraine for UK companies.
items.body:
The UK’s first dedicated business centre for industry in Ukraine has now opened, offering companies a permanent presence in Kyiv to deepen industrial ties with our ally.

The Kyiv Business Centre (KBC) is the first of its kind in the Ukrainian capital and is the result of close collaboration between the National Armaments Director (NAD) Group, industrial partners and finance industry, demonstrating the sustained commitment to Ukraine under the 100-Year Partnership.

The KBC gives UK companies, particularly small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), a base from which to build trusted relationships with Ukrainian partners, access battlefield insight and pursue co-development, co-production and investment opportunities.

Until now the cost, security requirements and administrative complexity of operating in Ukraine have made it prohibitively difficult for smaller firms to establish a presence in the country.

Luke Pollard, Minister for Defence Readiness and Industry, said:

Britain has stood firmly with Ukraine since the first days of Russia’s illegal invasion, and with the Kyiv Business Centre now open, we are helping to unlock new opportunities for investment, growth and long-term recovery. By supporting UK companies in Kyiv, we are deepening the 100-Year Partnership and turning our shared resolve into shared innovation.

Britain has stood firmly with Ukraine since the first days of Russia’s illegal invasion, and with the Kyiv Business Centre now open, we are helping to unlock new opportunities for investment, growth and long-term recovery.

By supporting UK companies in Kyiv, we are deepening the 100-Year Partnership and turning our shared resolve into shared innovation.

The KBC’s operating model is built around three principles: industry, innovation and investment, giving members access to a networking platform to help form partnerships, raise investment and scale-up production and capability.

National Armaments Director Rupert Pearce met with senior industry figures and SMEs to mark the start of the centre’s work connecting UK and Ukrainian industries.

NAD Rupert Pearce said:

This new facility is not just a centre; it’s a permanent gateway transforming the UK’s ability to collaborate meaningfully with our Ukrainian partners now, and for the long term. Until now the costs, security considerations and other restrictions created by Russia’s full-scale invasion have made it difficult for firms, especially smaller firms, to work in Ukraine. Our previous Trade Missions successfully addressed some of those challenges - this centre breaks down those barriers, giving UK firms a permanent centre in Kyiv embedding real opportunities for innovation, investment and export.

This new facility is not just a centre; it’s a permanent gateway transforming the UK’s ability to collaborate meaningfully with our Ukrainian partners now, and for the long term.

Until now the costs, security considerations and other restrictions created by Russia’s full-scale invasion have made it difficult for firms, especially smaller firms, to work in Ukraine.

Our previous Trade Missions successfully addressed some of those challenges - this centre breaks down those barriers, giving UK firms a permanent centre in Kyiv embedding real opportunities for innovation, investment and export.

It builds on more than 40 major UK-Ukraine industrial partnerships already in place and on the success of the MOD’s trade missions to Ukraine. The KBC also supports Ukrainian firms seeking UK industrial partners or establishing UK-based subsidiaries.

UK companies interested in doing business in Ukraine can find out more by emailing enquiries@kyivbusinesscentre.com , or visiting www.kyivbusinesscentre.com .
items.titleZh: 乌克兰基辅新商务中心开业
items.summaryZh: 该中心已举行首次会议，为英国企业提供了在乌克兰的常设据点。
zhParas: 英国在乌克兰的首个专门面向工业界的商务中心现已开业，为各企业提供了在基辅的常设据点，以深化与我们盟友的工业联系。
基辅商务中心（KBC）是乌克兰首都首个此类中心，由国家军备总监（NAD）小组、工业合作伙伴和金融业密切协作促成，彰显了在百年伙伴关系框架下对乌克兰的持续承诺。
基辅商务中心（KBC）为英国公司，尤其是中小企业（SMEs），提供了一个基地，使其能够与乌克兰合作伙伴建立可信关系、获取战场洞察，并寻求共同开发、共同生产和投资机会。
迄今为止，在乌克兰运营的成本、安全要求和行政复杂性，使得较小型企业极难在该国建立业务存在。
国防战备与工业大臣卢克·波拉德表示：
自俄罗斯非法入侵的最初几天起，英国就坚定地与乌克兰站在一起。如今基辅商务中心已经启用，我们正帮助释放投资、增长和长期复苏的新机遇。通过支持在基辅的英国企业，我们正在深化百年伙伴关系，并将我们共同的决心转化为共同的创新。
自俄罗斯非法入侵的最初几天起，英国就坚定地与乌克兰站在一起；随着基辅商务中心如今启用，我们正帮助释放投资、增长和长期复苏的新机遇。
通过支持在基辅的英国公司，我们正在深化百年伙伴关系，并将我们共同的决心转化为共同的创新。
KBC的运营模式围绕三大原则构建：产业、创新和投资，使成员能够接入一个交流联络平台，以帮助建立合作伙伴关系、筹集投资并扩大生产规模、提升能力。
国家军备总监鲁珀特·皮尔斯会见了行业资深人士和中小企业代表，共同纪念该中心连接英国与乌克兰产业的工作正式启动。
国家军备总监鲁珀特·皮尔斯表示：
这一新设施不仅仅是一个中心；它是一个永久性门户，正在改变英国当前及长期与乌克兰伙伴开展有意义合作的能力。迄今为止，俄罗斯全面入侵造成的成本、安全考量和其他限制，使企业——尤其是规模较小的企业——难以在乌克兰开展工作。我们此前的贸易代表团成功应对了其中一些挑战——该中心打破了这些壁垒，为英国企业在基辅提供了一个永久中心，将创新、投资和出口的真正机遇扎根于此。
这一新设施不仅仅是一个中心；它是一个永久性门户，正在改变英国当前及长期与乌克兰伙伴开展有意义合作的能力。
迄今为止，俄罗斯全面入侵所造成的成本、安全考量及其他限制，使企业——尤其是规模较小的企业——难以在乌克兰开展工作。
我们此前的贸易代表团成功应对了其中一些挑战——该中心打破了这些障碍，为英国企业在基辅提供了一个永久性中心，将创新、投资和出口的真正机遇嵌入其中。
它依托于已在实施的40多个重大英乌产业伙伴关系，以及英国国防部赴乌克兰贸易代表团所取得的成功。基辅商务中心（KBC）还支持寻求英国产业合作伙伴或正在英国设立子公司的乌克兰企业。
有意在乌克兰开展业务的英国公司可通过发送电子邮件至 enquiries@kyivbusinesscentre.com，或访问 www.kyivbusinesscentre.com 了解更多信息。

items.title: What Will a Growing MQ-9 Presence in Latin America Mean for SOUTHCOM?
items.author: Todd South
items.summary: A reported surge of MQ-9 Reaper drones to Latin America could widen the scope of intelligence gathering and free up more strike options against cartels in the region, experts tell Air & Space Forces Magazine. The post What Will a Growing MQ-9 Presence in Latin America Mean for SOUTHCOM? appeared first on Air & Space Forces Magazine .
items.body:
A reported surge of MQ-9 Reaper drones to Latin America could widen the scope of intelligence gathering and free up more strike options against cartels in the region, experts tell Air & Space Forces Magazine.

According to numerous media reports, the Pentagon has supplied Colombia and Ecuador with several Reapers and transferred an undisclosed number of MQ-9s from U.S. Africa Command to U.S. Southern Command.

Officials from Colombia and Ecuador have confirmed they are receiving MQ-9s to local media outlets, and CNN, the New York Times, and the Wall Street Journal have all reported that Reapers are moving from Africa to Central and South America.

Spokespeople from AFRICOM and SOUTHCOM both declined to comment on the movement of any aircraft, but the reports indicate how Reapers, long known for their role in counterinsurgency operations in the Middle East and Africa, are becoming more and more important to the U.S. military’s counter-narcotics efforts.

“We’re helping our partners build up their capabilities, and then that allows us to kind of push more resources into countries with fewer capabilities,” Henry Ziemer, an associate fellow with the Center for Strategic and International Studies Americas Program, told Air & Space Forces Magazine.

Marine Corps Gen. Francis L. Donovan, head of SOUTHCOM, has made a point of emphasizing the use of unmanned, autonomous systems in the region since taking command in February.

“U.S. Southern Command is focusing on integrating autonomous warfare systems to enhance domain awareness across maritime, air, and border areas,” SOUTHCOM spokesperson Steven McCloud told Air & Space Forces Magazine in an email. “These unmanned systems allow our partners to monitor their territory better and facilitate informed interdiction decisions. Improved data flows and situational awareness benefit everyone.”

SOUTHCOM established an Autonomous Warfare Command in April to lead its efforts on that front.

Any increase in the number of long-endurance intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance platforms in SOUTHCOM—both piloted and remotely piloted—will give the combatant commander more options and allow them to share intelligence with their counterparts, retired Air Force Maj. Gen. Julian “Ghost” Cheater told Air & Space Forces Magazine.

And demand for intel is surging amid a growing effort to combat the cartels and the flow of drugs in the region, led by President Donald Trump and boosted by allies and partners in the region.

Beginning in March, a U.S.-led effort helped create the Americas Counter Cartel Coalition, which has grown from an initial dozen members to 19 nations, with Colombia being the most recent. In August, SOUTHCOM announced its new Joint Task Force-Western Hemisphere, the region’s “action arm” for missions like counter-narcotics.

At the time, former Air Forces Southern Commander Lt. Gen. Norm Seip told Air & Space Forces Magazine that the new task force could lead to more prioritization of assets for the SOUTHCOM commander.

Cheater, who retired in June and most recently served as the director of strategy, policy, and plans for SOUTHCOM, added that any new allocation of ISR assets would be based on the combatant commander’s priorities—which would suggest Donovan is putting an emphasis on intelligence gathering.

“Ultimately, AFSOUTH is responsible for providing that comprehensive command and control of airborne operations in theater,” said Cheater, who has more than 3,700 flight hours, a good chunk of that on drones, and commanded drone units such as the 432nd Wing out of Creech Air Force Base, Nev. “This component reports directly to the combatant commander, and if AFSOC or another entity provides those assets, those are generally commanded and controlled via AFSOUTH.”

In addition to the reported MQ-9 transfers, SOUTHCOM also announced in mid-September the sale of more than $6 million worth of K1000 ultra-long endurance drones to Panama to “monitor remote borders, safeguard strategic maritime corridors, and dismantle illicit drug trafficking and human smuggling networks,” according to a command release.

Built by Kraus Hamdani Aerospace, the K1000 is a 45-pound, 9.8-foot-long drone with a 16.4-foot wingspan that can reach speeds up to 75 miles per hour and has a ceiling of 20,000 feet. It can fly continuously for 24 hours in its solar-recharge configuration or 12 hours in its electronic vertical take-off and landing configuration. It has a range of about 1,000 miles and can be controlled via line of sight comms within 90 miles or beyond line of sight using satellite comms. A three-person crew can pack it into Pelican cases in under 15 minutes.

The Reaper’s airframe costs between $30 and $50 million each; sensors and weapons can add to that cost. It is a medium-to-high-altitude, long-endurance drone with a 66-foot wingspan and a 50,000-foot ceiling. The drone can fly for 27 continuous hours and up to 42 hours in extended-range variants with a range of 1,000 to 1,400 nautical miles. It has similar line of sight/beyond line of sight command and control capabilities to the K1000.

As of Sept. 30, 2025, the Air Force reported 182 Reapers in its inventory, though at least 45 have been lost during operations against Iran.

As operations in SOUTHCOM have ramped up under the Trump administration, the MQ-9 has already played a role.

Since September 2025, SOUTHCOM has conducted at least 71 lethal, kinetic strikes targeting alleged drug boats. The strikes, some of which have reportedly been made with MQ-9s, have killed at least 215 people, with another 17 missing or presumed dead, according to government accounts and media reports.

The strikes have mostly targeted vessels near Venezuela’s shores, in the Pacific Ocean, and across the Caribbean. Early strikes began before the Pentagon formally announced Operation Southern Spear in November 2025, the wider effort to target cartel assets with kinetic strikes and other means. That temporary operation has become the more permanent JTF-WH.

Drug Boat Strikes

Those strikes have sparked intense debate among legal experts and lawmakers, and the Washington Post reported in July that a Drug Enforcement Administration assessment found that they have not been effective in stemming the flow of cocaine into the U.S.

Ben Friedman, policy director at Defense Priorities, a D.C.-based think tank that promotes a restrained U.S. foreign policy, told Air & Space Forces Magazine that he doubts the strikes will ever be effective.

“I don’t think it—using military forces to counter the flow of narcotics—works particularly well, and we have decades of experience at that. Even if we intensify it, I think we’ll get the same result at a higher price,” Friedman said.

During Congressional testimony in March, Donovan indicated that SOUTHCOM is shifting to take a more comprehensive approach to the counter-cartel fight.

“We’ve seen changes in the narco-traffickers’ patterns, and in a closed setting I’d like to provide some more details specifically on that, but … the boat strikes aren’t the answer,” Donovan told Sen. Mark Kelly (D-Ariz.) on March 19.

“What we’re moving for right now [is] … really a counter-cartel campaign process that puts total systemic friction across this network,” Donovan added.

More MQ-9s in theater could aid this expanded effort.

Currently, Reapers are tasked out of various locations, including U.S. facilities in Puerto Rico. And while the platform has a long loiter time, its eye-in-the-sky is not infinite. Having Reapers actually located in Ecuador and Colombia extends the regional reach by freeing up assets for other operations with other partners.

“These drones to SOUTHCOM, they can also be operated out of Colombia. I think the drones of Panama [are] really going to help find the targets that they’re looking for, targets being drug traffickers,” Wilder Alejandro Sanchez, president of the D.C.-based consulting firm Second Floor Strategies and nonresident senior associate at the CSIS Americas program, told Air & Space Forces Magazine.

Potential MQ-9 Operating Locations

Ziemer said increased use of drones like the MQ-9 will widen the ISR and data and communications sharing between the United States and regional allies and partners.

“Long-endurance UASs are tremendously useful to patrol large swaths of the jungle, patrol large maritime borders, looking for illicit activity,” Ziemer said.

That can include illegal mining and fishing, human trafficking and a host of other nefarious cartel and criminal organization or foreign terrorist organization practices, Ziemer said.

Retired Air Force Lt. Gen. Mark “Chris” Nowland, former deputy chief of staff for operations and commander of Air Forces Southern, told Air & Space Forces Magazine that the airborne assets will prove vital for building “patterns of life” on cartel activities.

“The advantage of the Reaper being there is it gives you this incredible distance that you can cover now and put ISR on,” Nowland said. “Now you just have something that you can cue and go and get better vigilance on or discover new stuff that you couldn’t because of the sensor capabilities they have.”

While the experts and former military officials lauded the increased capabilities the new MQ-9s could bring, they also noted limitations and risks with the move.

Sanchez, a Peruvian native, and Ziemer agreed that MQ-9s are not the only drones needed. Long-endurance, high-altitude drones play a crucial role, Sanchez said, but under the canopy of dense jungles or on remote mountaintops, smaller, nimbler, backpack-portable drones already feature in counter-narcotics operations and will become even more necessary.

“It’s not just big, expensive Reapers or MQ-4 Tritons, but also small … [drones] that they can transport in a backpack, so the small squads can deploy them and find the objective much faster when they’re on the ground,” Sanchez said.

Sanchez also noted that regardless of the platform, communication and intel sharing must ramp up, which will require building that capacity within under-resourced partner nations.

“Imagine the Reaper drone has some information. It’s going to be sent to a base … and then how long does it take for that information to be sent to the troops, who need to go to that location?” Sanchez asked.

Presuming Reapers operate out of partner bases, they face their own dangers, Nowland added.

“If these U.S. assets are effective, [they] could become targets,” Nowland said. “So how do you protect them wherever you put them…? This is a dilemma that I’m sure SOUTHCOM is thinking about.”

Friedman also worries that with a change in government, assets sold or given to partner nations could be used for unintended measures.

“South American politics are not nearly as unstable as they used to be, but there are changes of government, changes of leadership, even the potential for coups,” he said. “They might be doing things that lack discretion and control… to see a South American government just doing the kind of drone strikes that we do against their own populations with capability that we gave them.”

More broadly, Friedman argued that the overall push of military assets in Latin America is an escalation in the region and threatens to make the decadeslong Drug War into a literal war.

“I don’t see a lot of virtue in having a more militarized approach to the Western Hemisphere,” said Friedman. “In practice, I think you wind up doing a bunch of things if you’re doing it with the Pentagon that probably don’t make sense.”

“If I had my druthers, they’d probably be using [them] more for training in the United States and not either of these missions,” he said. “You know, preparing for a war that actually involves some kind of core U.S. interest.”

- On Jan. 20, 2025, President Donald Trump signed an executive order declaring cartels Foreign Terrorist Organizations (FTOs) and asserting that the U.S. is in a “non-international armed conflict” with drug-trafficking entities.

- On Sept. 2, 2025, Trump and SOUTHCOM confirmed the first lethal drug boat strike, saying it killed 11 individuals belonging to the Tren de Aragua gang.

- In December 2025, the Trump administration released a new National Defense Strategy and National Security Strategy prioritizing the Western Hemisphere and military actions against drug cartels, including “targeted deployments to secure the border and defeat cartels, including where necessary the use of lethal force to replace the failed law enforcement-only strategy of the last several decades.”

- On March 5, 2026, at a Americas Counter Cartel Coalition conference, Trump said the U.S. will work with Latin American countries “to do whatever we have to do. We’ll use missiles. … But we’ll do whatever you need. The only way to defeat these enemies is by unleashing the power of our militaries.”
items.titleZh: MQ-9在拉丁美洲日益增长的存在对美军南方司令部意味着什么？
items.summaryZh: 专家告诉《空天力量》杂志，据报大量MQ-9“死神”无人机涌入拉丁美洲，可能扩大情报搜集范围，并为打击该地区贩毒集团腾出更多打击选项。《MQ-9在拉丁美洲日益增长的存在对美军南方司令部意味着什么？》一文最初发表于《空天力量》杂志。
zhParas: 专家告诉《空天力量》杂志，据报大量MQ-9“死神”无人机涌入拉丁美洲，可能扩大情报搜集范围，并为打击该地区贩毒集团腾出更多打击选项。
据多家媒体报道，五角大楼已向哥伦比亚和厄瓜多尔提供了数架“死神”无人机，并将数量不详的MQ-9无人机从美军非洲司令部转移到美军南方司令部。
哥伦比亚和厄瓜多尔官员已向当地媒体证实，他们正在接收MQ-9无人机；CNN、《纽约时报》和《华尔街日报》均报道称，“死神”无人机正从非洲转移至中美洲和南美洲。
美国非洲司令部和南方司令部的发言人均拒绝就任何飞机的调动置评，但这些报道表明，长期以来以在中东和非洲执行反叛乱行动而闻名的“死神”无人机，正对美国军方的禁毒工作变得越来越重要。
我们正在帮助伙伴提升能力，这样一来，我们就能把更多资源投入到能力较弱的国家，”战略与国际研究中心美洲项目副研究员亨利·齐默对《空军与太空军杂志》表示。
美国南方司令部司令、海军陆战队上将弗朗西斯·L·多诺万自2月上任以来，一直强调在该地区使用无人和自主系统。
美国南方司令部正专注于整合自主作战系统，以增强海上、空中和边境地区的领域感知能力，”美国南方司令部发言人史蒂文·麦克劳德在电子邮件中告诉《空军与太空军杂志》。“这些无人系统使我们的伙伴能够更好地监视其领土，并有助于做出有依据的拦截决策。改进的数据流和态势感知惠及各方。
美军南方司令部于4月成立了一个自主作战司令部，以领导其在这一领域的工作。
退役空军少将朱利安·“幽灵”·奇特告诉《空军与太空军杂志》，美军南方司令部任何长航时情报、监视与侦察平台——无论有人驾驶还是遥控驾驶——数量的增加，都将为该作战司令部司令提供更多选择，并使其能够与同行分享情报。
随着在该地区打击贩毒集团和毒品流动的努力不断加强——这一努力由唐纳德·特朗普总统领导，并得到该地区盟友和伙伴的支持——对情报的需求正在激增。
从3月开始，一项由美国主导的努力帮助创建了美洲反卡特尔联盟，该联盟已从最初的12个成员扩大到19个国家，哥伦比亚是最近加入的。8月，美军南方司令部宣布成立新的西半球联合特遣部队，作为该地区执行禁毒等任务的“行动臂”。
当时，前南方空军司令部司令诺姆·塞普中将告诉《空军与太空军杂志》，这支新成立的特遣部队可能促使更多资产向美军南方司令部司令倾斜。
6月退役、最近担任美军南方司令部战略、政策与计划主任的奇特尔补充说，任何新的情报、监视与侦察（ISR）资产分配都将以作战司令部司令的优先事项为依据——这表明多诺万正把重点放在情报搜集上。
归根结底，南方空军负责提供战区空中行动的全面指挥与控制，”奇特尔说。他拥有超过3700个飞行小时，其中很大一部分是在无人机上，并曾指挥过无人机部队，例如内华达州克里奇空军基地的第432联队。“该组成部分直接向作战司令部司令汇报，如果空军特种作战司令部或其他实体提供这些资产，它们通常通过南方空军进行指挥与控制。
除了有报道的MQ-9转移外，美军南方司令部还在9月中旬宣布，向巴拿马出售价值超过600万美元的K1000超长航时无人机，以“监控偏远边境、保卫战略海上走廊，并瓦解非法毒品贩运和人口走私网络”，据该司令部的一份新闻稿称。
K1000无人机由Kraus Hamdani Aerospace制造，重45磅，长9.8英尺，翼展16.4英尺，最高时速可达75英里，升限为20,000英尺。在太阳能充电构型下，它可连续飞行24小时；在电动垂直起降构型下，可连续飞行12小时。其航程约为1,000英里，可在90英里内通过视距通信控制，或使用卫星通信进行超视距控制。一个三人机组可在15分钟内将其装入Pelican箱。
死神”无人机的机体单价在3000万至5000万美元之间；传感器和武器还会增加这一成本。它是一款中高空、长航时无人机，翼展66英尺，升限5万英尺。该无人机可连续飞行27小时，增程型最长可飞行42小时，航程为1000至1400海里。其视距/超视距指挥控制能力与K1000类似。
截至2025年9月30日，美国空军报告其库存中有182架“死神”无人机，不过在对伊朗的行动中至少损失了45架。
随着特朗普政府时期美军南方司令部的行动不断加强，MQ-9已经发挥了作用。
自2025年9月以来，美国南方司令部至少实施了71次针对涉嫌运毒船只的致命性动能打击。据报道，其中一些打击由MQ-9无人机实施；据政府通报和媒体报道，这些打击已造成至少215人死亡，另有17人失踪或推定死亡。
这些打击主要针对委内瑞拉海岸附近、太平洋以及加勒比海各地的船只。早期打击始于五角大楼于2025年11月正式宣布“南方长矛行动”之前；该行动是一项更广泛的努力，旨在通过动能打击和其他手段打击贩毒集团资产。那项临时行动已成为更为常设的联合特遣部队-西半球（JTF-WH）。
打击毒品船只
这些打击在法律专家和议员中引发了激烈辩论，而《华盛顿邮报》7月报道称，美国缉毒局的一项评估发现，这些打击并未有效遏制可卡因流入美国。
位于华盛顿、主张美国奉行克制外交政策的智库“国防优先事项”政策主任本·弗里德曼对《空军与太空军杂志》表示，他怀疑这些打击永远不会奏效。
我不认为——动用军事力量来遏制毒品流动——效果会特别好，而且我们在这方面有几十年的经验。即使我们加大力度，我认为我们也只会付出更高代价，却得到同样的结果，”弗里德曼说。
在3月的国会作证中，多诺万表示，美军南方司令部正转向采取更全面的方式来打击贩毒集团。
我们已经看到毒品贩运者的活动模式发生了变化，在闭门场合中，我想就此具体提供更多细节，但……打击船只并非解决之道，”多诺万在3月19日对参议员马克·凯利（亚利桑那州民主党人）说。
我们眼下正在推动的……实际上是一个反贩毒集团战役进程，旨在让整个网络承受全面的系统性摩擦，”多诺万补充说。
战区内更多MQ-9无人机可能有助于这项扩大的行动。
目前，“死神”无人机以多个地点为基地执行任务，包括波多黎各的美军设施。尽管该平台拥有较长滞空时间，但其“空中之眼”并非无限。让“死神”无人机实际部署在厄瓜多尔和哥伦比亚，可扩大区域覆盖范围，并腾出资源用于与其他伙伴开展的其他行动。
这些派往美军南方司令部的无人机，也可以从哥伦比亚境内操作。我认为，巴拿马的这些无人机确实将有助于找到他们正在寻找的目标，也就是毒贩，”总部位于华盛顿特区的咨询公司Second Floor Strategies总裁、战略与国际研究中心（CSIS）美洲项目非常驻高级研究员怀尔德·亚历杭德罗·桑切斯告诉《空军与太空军杂志》。
MQ-9潜在作战地点
齐默表示，增加使用MQ-9等无人机将扩大美国与地区盟友和伙伴之间的情报、监视与侦察（ISR）以及数据和通信共享。
长航时无人机系统对于巡查大片丛林、巡逻漫长的海上边界以及搜寻非法活动极其有用，”齐默说。
齐默尔说，这可能包括非法采矿和捕鱼、人口贩运，以及贩毒集团、犯罪组织或外国恐怖组织的一大批其他邪恶行径。
退役空军中将马克·“克里斯”·诺兰德曾任负责作战的副参谋长和空军南方司令部司令，他对《空军与太空军杂志》表示，这些空中资产对于构建贩毒集团活动的“生活模式”将发挥至关重要的作用。
死神”出现在那里的优势在于，它能赋予你如今可覆盖的惊人距离，并在该范围内实施ISR，”诺兰说。“现在，你就有了一种可以提示、派去加强警戒，或发现以往因缺乏它们所具备的传感器能力而无法发现的新情况的东西。
尽管专家和前军方官员对新型MQ-9可能带来的能力提升表示赞赏，但他们也指出了这一举措的局限性和风险。
身为秘鲁人的桑切斯与齐默一致认为，MQ-9无人机并非唯一所需的无人机。桑切斯说，长航时、高空无人机发挥着关键作用，但在茂密丛林树冠下或偏远山顶上，更小、更灵活、可装入背包携带的无人机已用于禁毒行动，并将变得更加必要。
桑切斯说：“这不仅仅是大型、昂贵的‘死神’无人机或MQ-4‘特里同’无人机，还包括可由人员装在背包中携行的小型……[无人机]，这样小分队就能在地面部署这些无人机，并更快找到目标。
桑切斯还指出，无论采用何种平台，通信与情报共享都必须加强，而这将需要在资源不足的伙伴国家内部建设相关能力。
想象一下，‘死神’无人机掌握了一些情报。这些情报会被传送到一个基地……然后，再把情报发送给需要前往该地点的部队，要花多长时间？”桑切斯问道。
诺兰补充说，假设“死神”无人机从伙伴基地起飞执行任务，它们也会面临自身的危险。
如果这些美军资产确实有效，[它们]就可能成为目标，”诺兰说。“那么，无论把它们部署在哪里，你该如何保护它们……？我确信，这是美军南方司令部正在思考的一个两难问题。
弗里德曼还担心，随着政府更迭，出售或提供给伙伴国的装备可能被用于非预期用途。
南美政治远不像过去那样不稳定，但政府会更迭、领导层会变动，甚至存在发生政变的可能，”他说。“他们可能会做出缺乏审慎和管控的事情……看到南美政府用我们提供给他们的能力，对自己的民众实施那种我们常做的无人机打击。
更广泛地说，弗里德曼认为，在拉丁美洲整体推进军事资产是该地区局势的升级，并有可能使长达数十年的“毒品战争”变成一场字面意义上的战争。
我不认为对西半球采取更加军事化的做法有多大好处，”弗里德曼说。“实际上，我认为如果由五角大楼来做这件事，你最终会做一堆可能并不合理的事情。
如果由我做主，他们大概会把[它们]更多地用于在美国本土训练，而不是执行这两项任务中的任何一项，”他说，“你知道，就是为一场真正涉及美国某种核心利益的战争做准备。
2025年1月20日，唐纳德·特朗普总统签署行政命令，宣布贩毒集团为外国恐怖组织（FTO），并声称美国正与毒品贩运实体处于“非国际性武装冲突”之中。
