专家告诉《空天力量》杂志，据报大量MQ-9“死神”无人机涌入拉丁美洲，可能扩大情报搜集范围，并为打击该地区贩毒集团腾出更多打击选项。

据多家媒体报道，五角大楼已向哥伦比亚和厄瓜多尔提供了数架“死神”无人机，并将数量不详的MQ-9无人机从美军非洲司令部转移到美军南方司令部。

哥伦比亚和厄瓜多尔官员已向当地媒体证实，他们正在接收MQ-9无人机；CNN、《纽约时报》和《华尔街日报》均报道称，“死神”无人机正从非洲转移至中美洲和南美洲。

美国非洲司令部和南方司令部的发言人均拒绝就任何飞机的调动置评，但这些报道表明，长期以来以在中东和非洲执行反叛乱行动而闻名的“死神”无人机，正对美国军方的禁毒工作变得越来越重要。

我们正在帮助伙伴提升能力，这样一来，我们就能把更多资源投入到能力较弱的国家，”战略与国际研究中心美洲项目副研究员亨利·齐默对《空军与太空军杂志》表示。

美国南方司令部司令、海军陆战队上将弗朗西斯·L·多诺万自2月上任以来，一直强调在该地区使用无人和自主系统。

美国南方司令部正专注于整合自主作战系统，以增强海上、空中和边境地区的领域感知能力，”美国南方司令部发言人史蒂文·麦克劳德在电子邮件中告诉《空军与太空军杂志》。“这些无人系统使我们的伙伴能够更好地监视其领土，并有助于做出有依据的拦截决策。改进的数据流和态势感知惠及各方。

美军南方司令部于4月成立了一个自主作战司令部，以领导其在这一领域的工作。

退役空军少将朱利安·“幽灵”·奇特告诉《空军与太空军杂志》，美军南方司令部任何长航时情报、监视与侦察平台——无论有人驾驶还是遥控驾驶——数量的增加，都将为该作战司令部司令提供更多选择，并使其能够与同行分享情报。

随着在该地区打击贩毒集团和毒品流动的努力不断加强——这一努力由唐纳德·特朗普总统领导，并得到该地区盟友和伙伴的支持——对情报的需求正在激增。

从3月开始，一项由美国主导的努力帮助创建了美洲反卡特尔联盟，该联盟已从最初的12个成员扩大到19个国家，哥伦比亚是最近加入的。8月，美军南方司令部宣布成立新的西半球联合特遣部队，作为该地区执行禁毒等任务的“行动臂”。

当时，前南方空军司令部司令诺姆·塞普中将告诉《空军与太空军杂志》，这支新成立的特遣部队可能促使更多资产向美军南方司令部司令倾斜。

6月退役、最近担任美军南方司令部战略、政策与计划主任的奇特尔补充说，任何新的情报、监视与侦察（ISR）资产分配都将以作战司令部司令的优先事项为依据——这表明多诺万正把重点放在情报搜集上。

归根结底，南方空军负责提供战区空中行动的全面指挥与控制，”奇特尔说。他拥有超过3700个飞行小时，其中很大一部分是在无人机上，并曾指挥过无人机部队，例如内华达州克里奇空军基地的第432联队。“该组成部分直接向作战司令部司令汇报，如果空军特种作战司令部或其他实体提供这些资产，它们通常通过南方空军进行指挥与控制。

除了有报道的MQ-9转移外，美军南方司令部还在9月中旬宣布，向巴拿马出售价值超过600万美元的K1000超长航时无人机，以“监控偏远边境、保卫战略海上走廊，并瓦解非法毒品贩运和人口走私网络”，据该司令部的一份新闻稿称。

K1000无人机由Kraus Hamdani Aerospace制造，重45磅，长9.8英尺，翼展16.4英尺，最高时速可达75英里，升限为20,000英尺。在太阳能充电构型下，它可连续飞行24小时；在电动垂直起降构型下，可连续飞行12小时。其航程约为1,000英里，可在90英里内通过视距通信控制，或使用卫星通信进行超视距控制。一个三人机组可在15分钟内将其装入Pelican箱。

死神”无人机的机体单价在3000万至5000万美元之间；传感器和武器还会增加这一成本。它是一款中高空、长航时无人机，翼展66英尺，升限5万英尺。该无人机可连续飞行27小时，增程型最长可飞行42小时，航程为1000至1400海里。其视距/超视距指挥控制能力与K1000类似。

截至2025年9月30日，美国空军报告其库存中有182架“死神”无人机，不过在对伊朗的行动中至少损失了45架。

随着特朗普政府时期美军南方司令部的行动不断加强，MQ-9已经发挥了作用。

自2025年9月以来，美国南方司令部至少实施了71次针对涉嫌运毒船只的致命性动能打击。据报道，其中一些打击由MQ-9无人机实施；据政府通报和媒体报道，这些打击已造成至少215人死亡，另有17人失踪或推定死亡。

这些打击主要针对委内瑞拉海岸附近、太平洋以及加勒比海各地的船只。早期打击始于五角大楼于2025年11月正式宣布“南方长矛行动”之前；该行动是一项更广泛的努力，旨在通过动能打击和其他手段打击贩毒集团资产。那项临时行动已成为更为常设的联合特遣部队-西半球（JTF-WH）。

打击毒品船只

这些打击在法律专家和议员中引发了激烈辩论，而《华盛顿邮报》7月报道称，美国缉毒局的一项评估发现，这些打击并未有效遏制可卡因流入美国。

位于华盛顿、主张美国奉行克制外交政策的智库“国防优先事项”政策主任本·弗里德曼对《空军与太空军杂志》表示，他怀疑这些打击永远不会奏效。

我不认为——动用军事力量来遏制毒品流动——效果会特别好，而且我们在这方面有几十年的经验。即使我们加大力度，我认为我们也只会付出更高代价，却得到同样的结果，”弗里德曼说。

在3月的国会作证中，多诺万表示，美军南方司令部正转向采取更全面的方式来打击贩毒集团。

我们已经看到毒品贩运者的活动模式发生了变化，在闭门场合中，我想就此具体提供更多细节，但……打击船只并非解决之道，”多诺万在3月19日对参议员马克·凯利（亚利桑那州民主党人）说。

我们眼下正在推动的……实际上是一个反贩毒集团战役进程，旨在让整个网络承受全面的系统性摩擦，”多诺万补充说。

战区内更多MQ-9无人机可能有助于这项扩大的行动。

目前，“死神”无人机以多个地点为基地执行任务，包括波多黎各的美军设施。尽管该平台拥有较长滞空时间，但其“空中之眼”并非无限。让“死神”无人机实际部署在厄瓜多尔和哥伦比亚，可扩大区域覆盖范围，并腾出资源用于与其他伙伴开展的其他行动。

这些派往美军南方司令部的无人机，也可以从哥伦比亚境内操作。我认为，巴拿马的这些无人机确实将有助于找到他们正在寻找的目标，也就是毒贩，”总部位于华盛顿特区的咨询公司Second Floor Strategies总裁、战略与国际研究中心（CSIS）美洲项目非常驻高级研究员怀尔德·亚历杭德罗·桑切斯告诉《空军与太空军杂志》。

MQ-9潜在作战地点

齐默表示，增加使用MQ-9等无人机将扩大美国与地区盟友和伙伴之间的情报、监视与侦察（ISR）以及数据和通信共享。

长航时无人机系统对于巡查大片丛林、巡逻漫长的海上边界以及搜寻非法活动极其有用，”齐默说。

齐默尔说，这可能包括非法采矿和捕鱼、人口贩运，以及贩毒集团、犯罪组织或外国恐怖组织的一大批其他邪恶行径。

退役空军中将马克·“克里斯”·诺兰德曾任负责作战的副参谋长和空军南方司令部司令，他对《空军与太空军杂志》表示，这些空中资产对于构建贩毒集团活动的“生活模式”将发挥至关重要的作用。

死神”出现在那里的优势在于，它能赋予你如今可覆盖的惊人距离，并在该范围内实施ISR，”诺兰说。“现在，你就有了一种可以提示、派去加强警戒，或发现以往因缺乏它们所具备的传感器能力而无法发现的新情况的东西。

尽管专家和前军方官员对新型MQ-9可能带来的能力提升表示赞赏，但他们也指出了这一举措的局限性和风险。

身为秘鲁人的桑切斯与齐默一致认为，MQ-9无人机并非唯一所需的无人机。桑切斯说，长航时、高空无人机发挥着关键作用，但在茂密丛林树冠下或偏远山顶上，更小、更灵活、可装入背包携带的无人机已用于禁毒行动，并将变得更加必要。

桑切斯说：“这不仅仅是大型、昂贵的‘死神’无人机或MQ-4‘特里同’无人机，还包括可由人员装在背包中携行的小型……[无人机]，这样小分队就能在地面部署这些无人机，并更快找到目标。

桑切斯还指出，无论采用何种平台，通信与情报共享都必须加强，而这将需要在资源不足的伙伴国家内部建设相关能力。

想象一下，‘死神’无人机掌握了一些情报。这些情报会被传送到一个基地……然后，再把情报发送给需要前往该地点的部队，要花多长时间？”桑切斯问道。

诺兰补充说，假设“死神”无人机从伙伴基地起飞执行任务，它们也会面临自身的危险。

如果这些美军资产确实有效，[它们]就可能成为目标，”诺兰说。“那么，无论把它们部署在哪里，你该如何保护它们……？我确信，这是美军南方司令部正在思考的一个两难问题。

弗里德曼还担心，随着政府更迭，出售或提供给伙伴国的装备可能被用于非预期用途。

南美政治远不像过去那样不稳定，但政府会更迭、领导层会变动，甚至存在发生政变的可能，”他说。“他们可能会做出缺乏审慎和管控的事情……看到南美政府用我们提供给他们的能力，对自己的民众实施那种我们常做的无人机打击。

更广泛地说，弗里德曼认为，在拉丁美洲整体推进军事资产是该地区局势的升级，并有可能使长达数十年的“毒品战争”变成一场字面意义上的战争。

我不认为对西半球采取更加军事化的做法有多大好处，”弗里德曼说。“实际上，我认为如果由五角大楼来做这件事，你最终会做一堆可能并不合理的事情。

如果由我做主，他们大概会把[它们]更多地用于在美国本土训练，而不是执行这两项任务中的任何一项，”他说，“你知道，就是为一场真正涉及美国某种核心利益的战争做准备。

2025年1月20日，唐纳德·特朗普总统签署行政命令，宣布贩毒集团为外国恐怖组织（FTO），并声称美国正与毒品贩运实体处于“非国际性武装冲突”之中。

- 2025年9月2日，特朗普与美军南方司令部证实了首次针对贩毒船只的致命打击，称其击毙了11名隶属于“阿拉瓜火车”帮派的人员。

2025年12月，特朗普政府发布了新的《国防战略》和《国家安全战略》，将西半球和针对贩毒集团的军事行动置于优先位置，其中包括“开展定向部署以保卫边境、击败贩毒集团，并在必要时使用致命武力，以取代过去几十年失败的仅靠执法战略”。

2026年3月5日，在美洲反卡特尔联盟会议上，特朗普表示，美国将与拉丁美洲国家合作，“做我们必须做的事。我们会使用导弹。……但我们会做你们需要的一切。击败这些敌人的唯一办法，就是释放我们军队的力量。

items.title: Future cost, use of Marine Corps ACVs scrutinized in congressional report
items.author: Michael Peck
items.summary: The Congressional Research Service pointed to the war in Ukraine, where armored vehicles have largely been driven from the battlefield by drones.
items.body:
With today’s armored vehicles vulnerable to drones, congressional researchers are raising questions about the U.S. Marine Corps’ new Amphibious Combat Vehicle.

In particular, a Congressional Research Service report, released Tuesday, pointed to the war in Ukraine, where armored vehicles have largely been driven from the battlefield by unmanned aerial vehicles and guided munitions.

“As ACVs are intended to provide organic, direct fire support to dismounted Marines in the attack, how vulnerable to these threat systems are ACVs during amphibious operations and when operating ashore to support combat operations?” the research service asked in its report. “Are the Marines considering additional ACV survivability modifications based on lessons learned in Ukraine?”

In fact, the Marine Corps did award a contract last month to Anduril for a counter-UAS system to protect the ACV from small drones. Anduril’s Pulsar-L is a sensor and jammer package designed to stop small Group 1 and 2 radio-frequency drones.

“The system is currently in use by the Special Operations Command due to the system’s low weight, proven performance in engaging multiple UASs, and simultaneous execution of the full kill-chain while static or on the move,” noted the Marine contract award.

The Congressional Research Service also questioned whether a possible plan to expand the Marine Corps would, in turn, require more ACVs, which cost about $6 million each, depending on the variant.

Last month, a Force Structure Review suggested adding more than 6,500 personnel by 2032, including additional slots in 19 infantry battalions and two Littoral Combat Teams.

If the plan is implemented, “would additional ACVs be required to accommodate growth in Marine infantry units?” CRS asked.

The ACV comes in multiple variants, including the ACV-P troop carrier, ACV-C command vehicle, ACV-30 fire support model armed with a 30mm cannon, and the ACV-R armored recovery vehicle.

Initially, the Marines envisioned buying 1,122 ACVs. But the current plan is for 608 vehicles, comprising 389 ACV-P, 33 ACV-C, 152 ACV-30 and 34 ACV-R, Marine Corps officials told CRS.

BAE was just awarded a $230 million contract modification for 32 ACV-Rs, which will be the final ACV variant. The order is scheduled to be fulfilled by November 2028.

For fiscal 2027, the Navy is requesting $237 million for ACV upgrades.

The ACV has already experienced teething pains. After two ACVs tipped over in 2022 while operating in surf up to 10 feet high, the Marines briefly suspended ACV operations in the open ocean, as long as significant breaker height doesn’t exceed four feet.

One issue is the weight of the ACV, which now stands at around 35 tons. In 2025, a Navy Small Business Innovation Research solicitation called for reducing the weight of all ACV variants, and particularly the heavier ACV-30 and ACV-R. The goal is to slim down at least 2,000 pounds per vehicle.

“Components identified as having potential for weight reduction include engine access covers, drive shafts, ramp door, ramp, hatches, external fuel tanks, external metallic and metallic/composite add-on-armor components, suspension, turret exterior panels, and bow plane,” the 2025 solicitation stated.

Saltwater corrosion of ACV struts has also created problems.

“The high deployment schedule combined with the high training tempo of the United States Marine Corps creates an extremely corrosive environment for the ACV not typically experienced by other vehicles,” claimed a January 2026 Sources Sought notice for more than 5,000 corrosion-resistant struts.

In addition, the weight reduction SBIR specified that any solution “must address corrosion issues expected from use in and around salt water. Weight reduction will improve fuel efficiency and can lower the Center of Gravity and Center of Buoyancy.”

items.titleZh: 国会报告审查海军陆战队两栖战斗车的未来成本与用途
items.summaryZh: 国会研究服务处指出，在乌克兰战争中，装甲车辆已基本被无人机逐出战场。
zhParas: 在当今装甲车辆易受无人机攻击的情况下，国会研究人员正对美国海军陆战队的新型两栖战斗车提出疑问。
尤其值得一提的是，美国国会研究服务处周二发布的一份报告以乌克兰战争为例指出，在那里，装甲车辆已在很大程度上被无人机和制导弹药逐出战场。
鉴于两栖战斗车（ACV）旨在为进攻中下车作战的海军陆战队员提供建制内直接火力支援，在两栖作战期间以及上岸支援作战行动时，ACV在面对这些威胁系统时有多脆弱？”该研究机构在其报告中问道。“海军陆战队是否正根据在乌克兰汲取的经验教训，考虑对ACV进行额外的生存能力改装？
事实上，海军陆战队上个月确实授予安杜里尔公司一份反无人机系统合同，以保护两栖战车免受小型无人机攻击。安杜里尔的Pulsar-L是一种传感器与干扰器套件，旨在阻止小型第1类和第2类射频无人机。
由于该系统重量轻、在应对多个无人机系统方面性能经证实，并且能在静止或移动时同时执行完整杀伤链，该系统目前正由美军特种作战司令部使用，”海军陆战队合同授予公告指出。
美国国会研究服务处还质疑，可能的海军陆战队扩编计划是否会进而需要更多两栖战斗车（ACV），这些车辆每辆造价约600万美元，具体视型号而定。
上个月，一份部队结构审查报告建议到2032年前增加6500多名人员，包括在19个步兵营和两个濒海战斗队中增设岗位。
如果该计划得以实施，“是否需要增加两栖战斗车，以适应海军陆战队步兵部队的扩编？”国会研究服务处问道。
ACV 有多种变型，包括 ACV-P 运兵车、ACV-C 指挥车、配备 30 毫米机关炮的 ACV-30 火力支援型，以及 ACV-R 装甲抢救车。
最初，海军陆战队设想采购1122辆两栖战斗车（ACV）。但海军陆战队官员告诉国会研究服务处（CRS），当前计划为608辆，包括389辆ACV-P、33辆ACV-C、152辆ACV-30和34辆ACV-R。
BAE系统公司刚刚获得一份价值2.3亿美元的合同修改，用于32辆ACV-R，这将是ACV的最终变型。该订单计划于2028年11月前完成履约。
2027财年，海军申请2.37亿美元用于ACV升级。
ACV已经历过初期阵痛。2022年，两辆ACV在高达10英尺的碎浪中作业时倾覆，此后海军陆战队一度暂停了ACV在开阔大洋中的行动；目前，只要有效碎波高度不超过四英尺，便可开展行动。
一个问题是两栖战斗车（ACV）的重量，目前约为35吨。2025年，一份美国海军小企业创新研究招标文件呼吁减轻所有ACV型号的重量，尤其是较重的ACV-30和ACV-R。目标是每辆车至少减重2000磅。
被认定具有减重潜力的部件包括发动机检修盖、传动轴、坡道门、坡道、舱口、外部燃油箱、外部金属及金属/复合材料附加装甲部件、悬挂系统、炮塔外板和艏板，”2025年的招标文件称。
ACV 支杆的海水腐蚀也造成了问题。
2026年1月一份为采购5000多根耐腐蚀支撑杆而发布的来源征集通知称：“高部署安排加之美国海军陆战队的高强度训练节奏，为ACV营造了其他车辆通常不会经历的极端腐蚀环境。
此外，减重SBIR项目规定，任何解决方案“都必须解决在海水及其周边环境中使用时预计会出现的腐蚀问题。减重将提高燃油效率，并可降低重心和浮心。
迈克尔·佩克是《防务新闻》的通讯员，也是欧洲政策分析中心的专栏作家。他拥有罗格斯大学政治学硕士学位。可在 theuncommondefense.com 找到他。他的电子邮箱是 mikedefense1@gmail.com。

items.title: US Air Force, Army eye industry access on test ranges
items.author: Hope Hodge Seck
items.summary: The U.S. Air Force is partnering with the U.S. Army to open its test ranges to approved defense firms.
items.body:
Earlier this year, the Army announced it was opening five of its military test ranges – four domestic and one overseas – to approved companies in a move designed to speed innovation and get weapons and tech to the warfighter faster.

Now, the Air Force says it’s considering a similar move. In a forum hosted by the Mitchell Institute for Aerospace Studies on Tuesday, the commander of the Air Force Test Center, Brig. Gen. Mark Massaro, said service leaders were “actively working with the Army” to understand how they could apply the concept.

“We’re … looking at how the Army has opened up some of their ranges to commercial access and understanding what it is that we can do, on the Air Force side, to maybe move forward in that direction,” Massaro said.

The Air Force, he said, has had discussions with leaders from Army Test and Evaluation Command to “understand where they have gone with their access to ranges … to open up opportunities for contractors,” he said. He added that in a previous posting as commander of the 96th Test Wing at Eglin Air Force Base, Fla., he had worked with Air Force officials and contractors to arrange smaller-scale test range access for specific tests. That experience, he said, had yielded “a lot of lessons” for how the arrangement could work.

He acknowledged the threat from adversaries gathering imagery from above – an existing and growing risk with the rise of drone incursions that such a move might exacerbate.

“We do understand that we have critical capabilities that we’re testing and we need to protect them,” Massaro said. “We do understand that there is a threat from an information security standpoint that we do pay attention to when we execute our tests, and we do work to design our processes and our ways of testing to account for that.”

But the advantages, he said, are also evident.

“Industry really is leading the way in a lot of ways on exploration and development, using their own internal research and development,” Massaro said. “And allowing them the ability to gain access to capabilities like the ranges helps … them to accelerate that learning to a point when it may become a useful, relevant technology for our military to consider using … So to to help them along that process in ways that we can through range or other assets, enable some of that work to help move the needle forward.”

Former Army Secretary Dan Driscoll made the opening of service test ranges to industry one of the centerpieces of his work to eliminate barriers to industry and drive efficiency in innovation. In a January interview with CBS, he described conditions that private companies couldn’t easily replicate on their own, such as a range set up to imitate a Ukrainian battlefield and space to test anti-jamming and hypersonic weapons technology. He also said that opening Army ranges would cut down the traditional range test process from up to 18 months to as little as 30 days.

“A company with a good idea shouldn’t need a team of lawyers and a program of record just to prove their equipment works,” Driscoll said in an August statement announcing the range openings. “So we fixed that. One front door … a real person to walk you in, and on the other side, everything the modern battlefield demands: contested airspace, degraded signals and the space to test at real scale.”

The ranges the Army made available to industry via an online application portal include Dugway Proving Ground, Utah; West Cibola Range, part of Yuma Proving Ground, Ariz.; Camp Shelby Joint Forces Training Center, Miss.; Camp Grayling Joint Maneuver Training Center, Mich.; and the Multidomain Training Area range complex within the Morocco-based Africa Multidomain Training and Experimentation Center.
items.titleZh: 美国空军与陆军考虑向工业界开放试验靶场
items.summaryZh: 美国空军正与美国陆军合作，向经批准的国防企业开放其试验靶场。
zhParas: 今年早些时候，美国陆军宣布，将向经批准的公司开放其五个军事试验靶场——四个本土靶场和一个海外靶场——此举旨在加速创新，并让武器和技术更快地到达作战人员手中。
如今，美国空军表示正在考虑采取类似举措。在米切尔航空航天研究所周二主办的一场论坛上，美国空军测试中心司令马克·马萨罗准将表示，空军领导层正“积极与陆军合作”，以了解他们如何应用这一构想。
我们……正在研究陆军如何将其部分靶场开放给商业准入，并了解我们空军方面能做什么，或许可以朝这个方向推进，”马萨罗说。
他说，空军已与陆军测试与评估司令部的领导人进行讨论，以“了解他们在靶场准入方面已进展到何种程度……从而为承包商创造机会”。他补充说，此前在佛罗里达州埃格林空军基地担任第96测试联队指挥官时，他曾与空军官员和承包商合作，为特定试验安排较小规模的试验靶场准入。他说，那段经历为这种安排如何运作提供了“许多经验教训”。
他承认了对手从空中收集影像所带来的威胁——随着无人机入侵事件增多，这一风险本就存在且日益加剧，而此举可能会使其进一步恶化。
我们确实知道，我们拥有正在测试的关键能力，而且需要保护它们，”马萨罗说。“我们确实明白，从信息安全角度来看存在威胁，我们在执行测试时会对此予以关注，也确实会努力设计我们的流程和测试方式，以将这一点考虑在内。
但他表示，这些优势也显而易见。
在许多方面，工业界确实在探索和开发方面走在前列，利用它们自己的内部研发，”马萨罗说。“而允许它们获得使用靶场等能力的机会，有助于……它们加快这种学习，使其达到某个阶段，届时它可能成为一种有用且相关的技术，供我们的军队考虑使用……因此，以我们能够通过靶场或其他资产做到的方式帮助它们推进这一进程，让其中一些工作得以开展，有助于推动事情向前发展。
前陆军部长丹·德里斯科尔将向工业界开放军种试验靶场作为其消除工业界参与壁垒、提高创新效率工作的核心内容之一。在1月接受CBS采访时，他描述了私营企业无法自行轻易复制的条件，例如一个为模拟乌克兰战场而设立的靶场，以及用于测试抗干扰和高超声速武器技术的场地。他还表示，开放陆军靶场将把传统的靶场测试流程从最长18个月缩短到最短30天。
一家有好点子的公司不应仅仅为了证明自家设备能用，就需要一个律师团队和一个正式立项项目，”德里斯科尔在8月宣布开放试验靶场的声明中说。“所以我们解决了这个问题。一个统一入口……有真人带你进门，而门后则是现代战场所需的一切：争夺激烈的空域、降级的信号，以及按真实规模进行测试的空间。
美国陆军通过在线申请门户向工业界开放的靶场包括：犹他州达格韦试验场；亚利桑那州尤马试验场的一部分——西锡沃拉靶场；密西西比州谢尔比营联合部队训练中心；密歇根州格雷林营联合机动训练中心；以及位于摩洛哥的非洲多域训练与试验中心内的多域训练区靶场综合体。

美国陆军通过在线申请门户向工业界开放的靶场包括：犹他州达格韦试验场；亚利桑那州尤马试验场的一部分——西锡沃拉靶场；密西西比州谢尔比营联合部队训练中心；密歇根州格雷林营联合机动训练中心；以及位于摩洛哥的非洲多域训练与试验中心内的多域训练区靶场综合体。

In line with the government’s transparency and open data initiative, the Military Court Service is to publish the court listings for the military court centres.

Each court listing covers the next one or two week assize period. This will be published on the internet by the last working day in advance of the assize period.

In addition to this, the court listings are published using digital signage technology within the reception areas of both military court centres.

Please be aware that the court listings are subject to change after publication, if you wish to find out more please contact the relevant military court centre. Details can be found at the bottom of each court listing.

items.title: Dutch firm uses AI to help drone systems ‘talk’ on Ukraine’s battlefield
items.author: Anthony Deutsch and Bart Biesemans, Reuters
items.summary: Amsterdam-based Intelic now has an office in Kyiv and is helping Ukrainian forces as they face intensified Russian drone and missile barrages.
items.body:
A high-velocity drone launched at a disused Dutch airbase by the North Sea roars through the clouds and intercepts a mock enemy target detected by radar and verified using artificial intelligence.

The test by software company Intelic, which has a €30-million ($33.5-million) contract with the Dutch Defence Ministry to upgrade its air defenses, is an example of how technology is being developed and provided to Ukraine by European companies to help it defend itself against Russian attacks.

Amsterdam-based Intelic, one of scores of firms operating out of converted hangars at the airbase, now has an office in Kyiv and is helping Ukrainian forces as they face intensified Russian drone and missile barrages in a war in which drones have transformed the battlefield and driven rapid innovation.

In the test in late September, Intelic’s AI-powered software, Nexus, used multiple radars, sensors and cameras provided by other companies to identify the projectile as an enemy attack. A reconnaissance drone then verified it was an enemy drone with image recognition.

Although a human made the final decision to launch the AI-guided interceptor drone, the process could be fully autonomous, said Intelic CEO and founder Maurits Korthals Altes.

“Most of these systems use AI at the edge, so in the drone itself, to be able to hit a target, a flying drone for instance, and then actually get intercepted at high speeds,” he said.

“But you can also have AI for decision support,” for example by assisting a commander in the field, when there is sometimes a window of only a few seconds to decide whether or not to fire on an incoming jet-propelled drone.

The integration between the different systems enables a commander to make such decisions quickly. At high speeds, Korthals Altes said, “you’re not so likely to hit it manually, and you need a more autonomous system.”

The Dutch government’s investment is part of a spending push by the NATO country, which has allocated about €1.4 billion since 2022 to Ukraine’s drone program, making it one of Europe’s leading contributors along with Germany and Britain, figures from the Kiel Institute in Germany show.

Since 2022, the Netherlands has provided military aid to Ukraine worth more than €12.5 billion, including nearly 1 million drones, the Defence Ministry said.

The Kiel Institute, which tracks military spending in Ukraine, said European aid for drones had jumped from €400 million in 2022, the year of Russia’s full-scale invasion, to €1.2 billion in 2025. The figure rose to €1.6 billion in the first four months of 2026 alone, it said.

Kyiv has increasingly sought support from allies to boost its air defenses, but European companies provide many different types of drones, which do not always “talk” to each other.

“Right now in Europe, there are over 700 drone manufacturers, and if we want to stay sovereign within Europe, we need to be able to have a system that is the connecting tissue between those different systems,” said Anika Kempter, a senior software engineer at Intelic.

She said Ukrainian brigades “might have different drones of different types from different vendors with different screens. Nexus solves this problem. So they can connect all of their drones in one system.”

During the airbase test, engineers hovered over screens in a mobile command post using an interface that for the first time brings together radar target detection, AI verification and interceptor drones. Each component could be individually selected and operated from the single control panel.

Intelic’s command-and-control system is being rolled out on Ukraine’s battlefield, where operational decisions are sometimes still communicated via chat apps or phone calls. It supplements Delta, Ukraine’s own advanced battlefield management system.

Replacing human communication with autonomous systems shaves minutes off the time between when a drone is detected and forces try to shoot it down, potentially meaning the difference between life and death, Kempter said.

Russia now uses jet-propelled attack drones that fly at high altitude. In the first three weeks of September, Russia launched 2,100 such drones and 136 missiles at Ukraine, killing 288 people, Prime Minister Sergii Koretskyi said.

Drone technology develops so quickly that air-defense hardware can rapidly become obsolete and need upgrading, but Intelic’s software can bridge the gap by adding new weapon systems to the platform, said Korthals Altes.

“That’s very important in an environment that’s unpredictable,” he said. “Because nobody really knows how a war or threat would look ... in two years. We have an idea, but we don’t know for sure. So that adaptability is key.”
items.titleZh: 荷兰公司利用人工智能帮助无人机系统在乌克兰战场上“对话
items.summaryZh: 总部位于阿姆斯特丹的Intelic公司现已在基辅设立办事处，并正在帮助乌克兰军队应对俄罗斯不断加剧的无人机和导弹袭击。
zhParas: 一架从北海之滨一座废弃荷兰空军基地发射的高速无人机呼啸着穿过云层，拦截了一个由雷达探测并经人工智能验证的模拟敌方目标。
软件公司Intelic与荷兰国防部签有价值3000万欧元（3350万美元）的合同，以升级其防空系统；该公司进行的这次测试是一个例证，表明欧洲公司正在如何开发技术并将其提供给乌克兰，以帮助乌克兰抵御俄罗斯的攻击。
总部位于阿姆斯特丹的Intelic是该空军基地由机库改建的场所内运营的数十家公司之一，如今在基辅设有办公室，并正在帮助乌克兰军队应对俄罗斯日益加剧的无人机和导弹袭击；在这场战争中，无人机已改变战场面貌，并推动了快速创新。
在9月下旬的测试中，Intelic公司的人工智能驱动软件Nexus利用其他公司提供的多部雷达、传感器和摄像头，将该飞行物识别为敌方来袭目标。随后，一架侦察无人机通过图像识别确认其为一架敌方无人机。
尽管是由人类做出发射人工智能制导拦截无人机的最终决定，但这一过程可以完全自主，Intelic首席执行官兼创始人毛里茨·科塔尔斯·阿尔特斯表示。
这些系统大多在边缘端使用人工智能，也就是在无人机本身上，以便能够击中目标——例如一架飞行中的无人机——然后在高速下实际被拦截，”他说。
但你也可以让人工智能用于决策支持，”例如在战场上协助指挥官，因为有时只有短短几秒钟的时间来决定是否向来袭的喷气式无人机开火。
不同系统之间的集成使指挥官能够迅速做出此类决定。科塔尔斯·阿尔特斯表示，在高速情况下，“靠手动不太可能击中它，你需要一个更自主的系统。
荷兰政府的投资是这个北约国家加大支出努力的一部分；德国基尔研究所的数据显示，自2022年以来，该国已向乌克兰无人机项目拨款约14亿欧元，使其与德国和英国一道成为欧洲的主要捐助方之一。
荷兰国防部表示，自2022年以来，荷兰已向乌克兰提供价值超过125亿欧元的军事援助，其中包括近100万架无人机。
追踪乌克兰军费开支的基尔研究所表示，欧洲对无人机的援助已从2022年——俄罗斯全面入侵的那一年——的4亿欧元跃升至2025年的12亿欧元。该研究所称，仅2026年前四个月，这一数字就上升至16亿欧元。
基辅越来越多地寻求盟友支持以增强其防空系统，但欧洲公司提供许多不同类型的无人机，而这些无人机并不总能彼此“对话”。
目前在欧洲有700多家无人机制造商，如果我们想在欧洲保持主权，就需要有一个系统能充当这些不同系统之间的连接纽带，”Intelic高级软件工程师阿妮卡·肯普特说。
她说，乌克兰各旅“可能拥有来自不同供应商、不同类型、配备不同屏幕的无人机。Nexus 解决了这一问题。这样他们就能将所有无人机接入同一个系统。
在空军基地测试期间，工程师们在移动指挥所内俯身于屏幕前，使用一种首次将雷达目标探测、人工智能验证和拦截无人机整合在一起的界面。每个组件均可通过同一控制面板单独选择并操作。
Intelic 的指挥控制系统正在乌克兰战场推广，当地作战决策有时仍通过聊天应用或电话传达。它是对乌克兰自己的先进战场管理系统 Delta 的补充。
肯普特说，用自主系统取代人工通信，可将从发现无人机到部队试图将其击落之间的时间缩短数分钟，这可能意味着生与死的差别。
俄罗斯现在使用在高空飞行的喷气式攻击无人机。总理谢尔希·科列茨基表示，在9月的前三周，俄罗斯向乌克兰发射了2100架此类无人机和136枚导弹，造成288人死亡。
科塔尔斯·阿尔特斯表示，无人机技术发展如此之快，以至于防空硬件可能迅速过时并需要升级，但Intelic的软件可以通过向该平台添加新的武器系统来弥合这一差距。
在一个不可预测的环境中，这非常重要，”他说。“因为没有人真正知道一场战争或威胁……在两年后会是什么样子。我们有一些设想，但不能确定。所以，这种适应能力至关重要。

items.title: Pentagon recruits drone pilots from across services for upcoming competition
items.author: Daniel Terrill
items.summary: The Defense Innovation Unit is looking to recruit about 100 drone pilots and create a standing registry of operators across the military services.
items.body:
The Defense Innovation Unit is recruiting service members with first-person-view drone experience to participate in the Defense Department’s Drone Dominance program, according to a recent announcement.

The $1.1 billion program is the Pentagon’s effort to rapidly expand the domestic drone industry by having companies submit small unmanned aircraft systems, or sUASs, for competition and then building stockpiles of the systems that perform best for military use.

Erin Cherry, the program’s test lead, told Military Times in an email that DIU is looking to recruit about 100 pilots for the program’s next phase, known as Gauntlet III. But the larger goal is to create a standing registry of drone operators across the military services.

“There’s no cap on the registry,” Cherry said. “We want to hear from any warfighter with FPV experience.”

She explained that service members selected to participate will get “stick time” with some of the newest drones, including systems that are not yet in military service, and some will receive specialized training on one-way attack drones.

“Most importantly, Gauntlet results strongly inform which systems move forward, and these pilots are the ones flying,” Cherry said.

The DIU announcement specifically calls for troops with experience flying FPV drones, which are typically flown manually in “acro” mode and are used for missions ranging from reconnaissance and surveillance to kamikaze attacks and close-quarters combat.

But Cherry said DIU is looking for more than just experienced FPV pilots.

“‘Pilot skill’ isn’t just one thing,” she said. “Flying ability, tactical knowledge, payload experience, and specialized skills like long-distance navigation and urban flight are all distinct, so we look at each one.”

That variety is important because the drones will ultimately be used by more than just the military’s most experienced operators.

“A drone that only performs well in an expert’s hands isn’t ready for the force,” Cherry said, adding that “whether someone has been flying FPV for five years or five months, we want to hear from them.”

For service members interested in participating, DIU is asking them to complete a Pilot Interest Form. Officials will only respond to applicants using a valid .mil email address, and all pilot participation will be coordinated through the individual military services.

Daniel Terrill is a contributor to Military Times. He’s been reporting on military issues, the gun industry, and the outdoors for nearly two decades. Although writing is his passion, he’s been a Marine, police officer, and, perhaps the most dangerous job of his career, a substitute teacher.
items.titleZh: 五角大楼为即将举行的竞赛从各军种招募无人机飞行员
items.summaryZh: 国防创新单元正寻求招募约100名无人机飞行员，并建立一份覆盖各军种操作员的常设名册。
zhParas: 根据近期发布的一项公告，国防创新单元正在招募具有第一人称视角无人机经验的军人，以参与国防部的“无人机优势”项目。
这项耗资11亿美元的项目，是五角大楼为迅速扩张美国国内无人机产业所做的努力：让企业提交小型无人机系统（sUAS）参与竞争，然后为在军事用途中表现最佳的系统建立库存。
该项目测试负责人艾琳·切里在一封电子邮件中告诉《军事时报》，国防创新单元正寻求为该项目的下一阶段——被称为“Gauntlet III”——招募约100名飞行员。但更大的目标是建立一个涵盖各军种无人机操作员的常设登记册。
登记册没有人数上限，”切里说。“我们希望收到任何有第一人称视角（FPV）经验的作战人员的消息。
她解释说，被选中参与的军人将获得操作一些最新型无人机的“实操时间”，其中包括尚未服役的系统，部分人员还将接受关于单向攻击无人机的专门训练。
最重要的是，Gauntlet 的结果会极大地影响哪些系统能够继续推进，而这些飞行员才是实际操控飞行的人，”切里说。
国防创新单元的公告特别征集具有操作FPV无人机经验的军人；这类无人机通常以“特技”（acro）模式手动飞行，用于从侦察与监视到自杀式袭击和近距离作战等多种任务。
但切里表示，国防创新单元要招募的不仅仅是经验丰富的FPV飞手。
‘飞行员技能’不只是一项能力，”她说。“飞行能力、战术知识、有效载荷经验，以及远距离导航和城市飞行等专业技能都各不相同，因此我们会逐一考量。
这种多样性很重要，因为这些无人机最终将不仅仅由军队中最有经验的操作员使用。
一架只有在专家手中才能表现出色的无人机，还没有准备好供部队使用，”切里说，并补充道，“无论一个人飞FPV已有五年还是五个月，我们都希望他们与我们联系。
对于有兴趣参与的军人，国防创新单元要求他们填写一份飞行员意向表。官员只会回复使用有效 .mil 电子邮箱地址的申请人，所有飞行员的参与都将通过各军种进行协调。
丹尼尔·特里尔是《军事时报》的特约撰稿人。近二十年来，他一直报道军事问题、枪支行业和户外领域。尽管写作是他的热情所在，但他曾当过海军陆战队队员、警察，以及或许是他职业生涯中最危险的工作——代课教师。

items.title: AF Week in Photos
items.author: Pentagon News
items.summary: This week's photos feature Airmen from around the globe involved in activities supporting expeditionary operations and defending America. This weekly feature showcases the men and women of the Air Force.
items.body:
Victory formation Air Force defensive back Jax Gates points toward two B-2 Spirit stealth bombers soaring above Falcon Stadium at the U.S. Air Force Academy, Colo., Oct. 3, 2026. The Air Force Falcons defeated the Navy Midshipmen 14-9 during the annual service academy rivalry matchup. (U.S. Air Force photo by Ray Bahner)

Air Force defensive back Jax Gates points toward two B-2 Spirit stealth bombers soaring above Falcon Stadium at the U.S. Air Force Academy, Colo., Oct. 3, 2026. The Air Force Falcons defeated the Navy Midshipmen 14-9 during the annual service academy rivalry matchup. (U.S. Air Force photo by Ray Bahner)

Welcome home An Air National Guard KC-135 Stratotanker assigned to the 121st Air Refueling Wing touches down on the flightline at Rickenbacker Air National Guard Base in Columbus, Ohio, Oct. 2, 2026. Unit personnel returned home following an expeditionary deployment supporting air mobility operations across the U.S. Indo-Pacific Command theater. (U.S. Air National Guard photo by Ralph Branson)

An Air National Guard KC-135 Stratotanker assigned to the 121st Air Refueling Wing touches down on the flightline at Rickenbacker Air National Guard Base in Columbus, Ohio, Oct. 2, 2026. Unit personnel returned home following an expeditionary deployment supporting air mobility operations across the U.S. Indo-Pacific Command theater. (U.S. Air National Guard photo by Ralph Branson)

Paws and reflect Master Sgt. Adam Macowicz pets Rita, a military working dog, during her formal retirement ceremony hosted by the 412th Security Forces Squadron at Edwards Air Force Base, Calif., Sept. 25, 2026. Rita concluded years of faithful service safeguarding base personnel, visiting dignitaries and national flight test assets. (U.S. Air Force photo by Blaine Torres)

Paws and reflect

Master Sgt. Adam Macowicz pets Rita, a military working dog, during her formal retirement ceremony hosted by the 412th Security Forces Squadron at Edwards Air Force Base, Calif., Sept. 25, 2026. Rita concluded years of faithful service safeguarding base personnel, visiting dignitaries and national flight test assets. (U.S. Air Force photo by Blaine Torres)

In thrust we trust Capt. Nick Le Tourneau, F-22 Raptor Demonstration Team commander and pilot, executes high-G aerial maneuvers during the Naval Air Station Oceana Air Show at NAS Oceana, Va., Sept. 20, 2026. The flight performance highlighted the fifth-generation stealth fighter’s thrust-vectoring agility, speed and operational capabilities. (U.S. Air Force photo by Airman 1st Class Kaden Ciminnisi)

In thrust we trust

Capt. Nick Le Tourneau, F-22 Raptor Demonstration Team commander and pilot, executes high-G aerial maneuvers during the Naval Air Station Oceana Air Show at NAS Oceana, Va., Sept. 20, 2026. The flight performance highlighted the fifth-generation stealth fighter’s thrust-vectoring agility, speed and operational capabilities. (U.S. Air Force photo by Airman 1st Class Kaden Ciminnisi)

Jam session Senior Airman Mia Villarreal, a 9th Security Forces Squadron defender, tracks a simulated rogue aircraft with a Dronebuster system at Beale Air Force Base, Calif., Sept. 25, 2026. The base defense exercise validated joint communication and rapid interception procedures against unauthorized unmanned aircraft systems. (U.S. Air Force photo by Senior Airman Chelsea Arana)

Senior Airman Mia Villarreal, a 9th Security Forces Squadron defender, tracks a simulated rogue aircraft with a Dronebuster system at Beale Air Force Base, Calif., Sept. 25, 2026. The base defense exercise validated joint communication and rapid interception procedures against unauthorized unmanned aircraft systems. (U.S. Air Force photo by Senior Airman Chelsea Arana)

Peak performance A C-17 Globemaster III assigned to the 62nd Airlift Wing climbs into the sky in front of Mount Rainier near Joint Base Lewis-McChord, Wash., Sept. 18, 2026. The aircraft participated in the flying competition of the Team McChord Rodeo, evaluating aircrews on navigation precision, timing and tactical combat offloads. (U.S. Air Force photo by Airman 1st Class Giselle Nicasio)

A C-17 Globemaster III assigned to the 62nd Airlift Wing climbs into the sky in front of Mount Rainier near Joint Base Lewis-McChord, Wash., Sept. 18, 2026. The aircraft participated in the flying competition of the Team McChord Rodeo, evaluating aircrews on navigation precision, timing and tactical combat offloads. (U.S. Air Force photo by Airman 1st Class Giselle Nicasio)

Feel the heat Air Force firefighters extinguish a simulated vehicle blaze during a live-fire demonstration at Dobbins Air Reserve Base, Ga., Sept. 22, 2026. The demonstration showcased civil engineer emergency response and airfield damage repair capabilities for international military delegates attending the International Air Reserve Symposium. (U.S. Air Force photo by Roger Parsons)

Feel the heat

Air Force firefighters extinguish a simulated vehicle blaze during a live-fire demonstration at Dobbins Air Reserve Base, Ga., Sept. 22, 2026. The demonstration showcased civil engineer emergency response and airfield damage repair capabilities for international military delegates attending the International Air Reserve Symposium. (U.S. Air Force photo by Roger Parsons)

Runway readiness U.S. Air Force F-16 Fighting Falcons taxi along the flightline after landing at Kunsan Air Base, South Korea, Sept. 15, 2026. The aircraft deployed to Kunsan AB under the Fighter Squadron Reset initiative, bolstering combined combat readiness and deterrence on the Korean Peninsula. (U.S. Air Force photo by Staff Sgt. Dylan Maher)

U.S. Air Force F-16 Fighting Falcons taxi along the flightline after landing at Kunsan Air Base, South Korea, Sept. 15, 2026. The aircraft deployed to Kunsan AB under the Fighter Squadron Reset initiative, bolstering combined combat readiness and deterrence on the Korean Peninsula. (U.S. Air Force photo by Staff Sgt. Dylan Maher)

Eyes on target Senior Airman John Ausmus, a 97th Security Forces Squadron armorer, holds a prone firing position during a ground combat exercise at Altus Air Force Base, Okla., Sept. 22, 2026. During the tactical drill, defenders practiced small-unit movement techniques while maneuvering to recover a critical asset. (U.S. Air Force photo by Airman 1st Class Emma Wright)

Eyes on target

Senior Airman John Ausmus, a 97th Security Forces Squadron armorer, holds a prone firing position during a ground combat exercise at Altus Air Force Base, Okla., Sept. 22, 2026. During the tactical drill, defenders practiced small-unit movement techniques while maneuvering to recover a critical asset. (U.S. Air Force photo by Airman 1st Class Emma Wright)

Fueling the fight A U.S. Air Force F-15E Strike Eagle assigned to the 48th Fighter Wing maneuvers away from a KC-135 Stratotanker assigned to the 100th Air Refueling Wing following an aerial refueling mission over the North Sea, Sept. 17, 2026. The 100th ARW and 48th FW routinely integrate during training exercises and operational taskings across Europe and Africa. (U.S. Air Force photo by Senior Airman Cody J. A. Mott)

Fueling the fight

A U.S. Air Force F-15E Strike Eagle assigned to the 48th Fighter Wing maneuvers away from a KC-135 Stratotanker assigned to the 100th Air Refueling Wing following an aerial refueling mission over the North Sea, Sept. 17, 2026. The 100th ARW and 48th FW routinely integrate during training exercises and operational taskings across Europe and Africa. (U.S. Air Force photo by Senior Airman Cody J. A. Mott)

Lunge Force U.S. Air Force Academy Cadet Christina Watrall lunges toward South Denver Fencing Academy competitor Kimberly Haney during an épée bout in the Cadet Gymnasium at the U.S. Air Force Academy, Colo., Sept. 12, 2026. Watrall defeated Haney 4-3 and clinched first place overall in the Division I-A Women’s Épée bracket. (U.S. Air Force photo by Trevor Cokley)

U.S. Air Force Academy Cadet Christina Watrall lunges toward South Denver Fencing Academy competitor Kimberly Haney during an épée bout in the Cadet Gymnasium at the U.S. Air Force Academy, Colo., Sept. 12, 2026. Watrall defeated Haney 4-3 and clinched first place overall in the Division I-A Women’s Épée bracket. (U.S. Air Force photo by Trevor Cokley)

Dawn patrol Two UH-1N Huey helicopters assigned to the 1st Helicopter Squadron fly across the skyline as the sun rises over Washington, D.C., Sept. 18, 2026. Stationed at Joint Base Andrews, Md., the squadron provides VIP airlift, security response and contingency support throughout the National Capital Region. (U.S. Air Force photo by AJ Bleyer)

Two UH-1N Huey helicopters assigned to the 1st Helicopter Squadron fly across the skyline as the sun rises over Washington, D.C., Sept. 18, 2026. Stationed at Joint Base Andrews, Md., the squadron provides VIP airlift, security response and contingency support throughout the National Capital Region. (U.S. Air Force photo by AJ Bleyer)

items.summaryZh: 本周照片聚焦来自全球各地的空军人员，他们参与支持远征作战和保卫美国的活动。这一每周专题展示美国空军的男女官兵。

items.title: Biosecurity in the Age of AI: Q&A with Steph Guerra
items.summary: The question that drives Steph Guerra's work at RAND may be one of the most consequential for this moment in the AI era: How can we harness the full potential of AI for science and medicine—but also ensure it never helps anyone build a biological weapon?
items.body:
Steph Guerra is an expert in AI, security, and biotechnology. The question that drives her work at RAND may be one of the most consequential for this moment in the AI era: How can we harness the full potential of AI for science and medicine—but also ensure it never helps anyone build a biological weapon?

Her career began in the lab. She's a molecular biologist by training whose earliest research focused on preventing cancer. But she's been working on issues of AI safety since long before “large language model” was a household term. She now leads RAND's portfolio of research at the intersection of AI and biotechnology.

In a recent study, Guerra and a team of researchers tested so-called “open-weight” AI models. These models are made publicly available for anyone to download, run, and modify. That can make them more transparent and accessible than hosted models like Claude or ChatGPT. But it also creates concerns about how they could be misused.

What did you find in your study of open-weight models and biosecurity risks?

It's important to say, first, that these open-weight models are a central part of the AI ecosystem. They support open research; they allow organizations or people to deploy their own models without relying on third parties. But there are some potential downsides. Once they're released, their developers can no longer enforce safety controls, and the underlying model can be customized for beneficial or potentially harmful purposes.

We evaluated a few different open-weight models. We found that their capabilities are quite comparable to those of frontier models. But we also found that tampering with them to remove their safeguards was actually pretty trivial and low-cost. Obtaining a highly capable open-weight model, and then removing the safeguards that tell it to refuse certain questions, is within reach of many capable actors.

Does that mean someone could use these models to help plan a biological attack?

Just getting information out of a model is one small step on what would be a long pathway to carrying out an attack. A bad actor would still have to obtain the materials; design, build, and test the biological agent; weaponize it; and then release it. There are technical, operational, and motivational barriers along that entire pathway.

One of the real challenges we have is that it's difficult to assess how an AI model could help. Could it motivate someone to cause harm? Could it help with the technical aspects, using the appropriate tools to design and enhance an agent? We can all agree that people should not be able to use AI models to develop a bioweapon. But it's really hard to test the end-to-end risk of that. And so we rely on these snapshots that our team and others build to understand where and how a bad actor could use AI.

What are some practical steps that AI developers can take to reduce the risk?

The ideal would be to build safeguards that are tamper-resistant. There has been some work on that, but it's unclear whether we'll ever be able to get there. If you think about it, closed-weight models are not tamper-free either. We always have to assume there will be ways to circumvent any single intervention put in place.

So then what does an effective biosecurity strategy look like?

You need to create friction along the entire pathway. Our team looked at this problem and just recently developed a multi-layered strategy that would prevent a pandemic-scale biological attack.

It has four key theories of defense. One is managing access to information through things like stronger model safeguards and managed access programs. The second is preventing bad actors from getting access to the materials they would need to create a biological weapon, the DNA and RNA, such as through gene synthesis screening. The third is detecting misuse early through real-time monitoring. And the fourth is being able to rapidly respond to and attribute an attack, to deter a nefarious actor from attempting one in the first place.

Model safeguards might stop a lone actor, but by themselves, they won't slow down a sophisticated state with a bioweapons program. Early detection, early attribution—that deterrence layer—might. That's the challenge. There's never going to be a single silver-bullet solution that can stop all threats. We need all of these layers.

Model safeguards might stop a lone actor, but by themselves, they won't slow down a sophisticated state with a bioweapons program.

How do you avoid stifling legitimate research while still preventing malicious uses?

Biology is a dual-use endeavor. The same AI capabilities that might cause harm could also be incredibly useful for developing medical innovations. The goal here is managed access and not blanket prohibitions. It's to precisely define who a legitimate user is and then ensure those individuals have access to the most powerful tools and data they need.

There are some useful precedents. There are managed-access frameworks to address privacy and security concerns with human genome data, for example. It doesn't foreclose legitimate research, but it also doesn't put the data out there for anyone to misuse. Part of our philosophy at RAND is that the scientific community needs to be part of developing the solutions. AI safeguards are only going to work if they preserve meaningful utility for beneficial research.

Was there a moment in your career that put you on the path to doing what you do now?

A few years ago, I was part of a small federal team doing red-teaming experiments with AI models. I was watching these models answer questions about biological attacks, and they were providing really creative, useful information, fluently, and with a lot of confidence. And I remember it just struck me: We needed to be doing a lot more to monitor and track these risks.

I started my career as a cancer biologist. And I kept running into this reality that we pour years and resources into developing treatments, but not as much into preventing cancer in the first place. So this idea of focusing on prevention, on getting ahead of risks so we're not scrambling to respond later, has just followed me through my career.
items.titleZh: 人工智能时代的生物安全：与斯蒂芬·格拉的问答
items.summaryZh: 推动斯蒂芬·格拉在兰德公司工作的问题，可能是人工智能时代当下最具影响的问题之一：我们如何充分利用人工智能在科学与医学领域的全部潜力，同时确保它永远不会帮助任何人制造生物武器？
zhParas: 斯蒂芬·格拉是人工智能、安全和生物技术领域的专家。推动她在兰德公司工作的问题，可能是人工智能时代当下最具影响的问题之一：我们如何充分利用人工智能在科学与医学领域的全部潜力，同时确保它永远不会帮助任何人制造生物武器？
她的职业生涯始于实验室。她是一名科班出身的分子生物学家，最早的研究聚焦于预防癌症。但早在“大语言模型”成为家喻户晓的术语之前，她就一直在研究人工智能安全问题。如今，她领导兰德公司在人工智能与生物技术交叉领域的研究项目组合。
在最近一项研究中，格拉和一组研究人员测试了所谓的“开放权重”AI模型。这些模型公开提供，任何人都可以下载、运行和修改。与Claude或ChatGPT等托管模型相比，这能让它们更透明、更易于获取。但这也引发了对其可能被滥用的担忧。
你在研究开放权重模型与生物安全风险时发现了什么？
首先必须指出，这些开放权重模型是人工智能生态系统的核心部分。它们支持开放研究；使组织或个人能够部署自己的模型，而无需依赖第三方。但也存在一些潜在弊端。一旦发布，其开发者就无法再实施安全管控，而底层模型可被定制用于有益目的或潜在有害目的。
我们评估了几种不同的开放权重模型。我们发现，它们的能力与前沿模型相当。但我们也发现，篡改它们以移除其安全保障措施实际上相当简单且成本低廉。获取一个能力很强的开放权重模型，然后移除其中让它拒绝某些问题的安全保障措施，是许多有能力的行动者都能做到的。
这是否意味着有人可以利用这些模型来帮助策划生物攻击？
仅仅从模型中获取信息，只是发动袭击这条漫长道路上的小小一步。不法分子仍然必须获取材料；设计、构建和测试生物制剂；将其武器化；然后释放。整条路径上都存在技术、操作和动机方面的障碍。
我们面临的真正挑战之一是，很难评估AI模型可能如何提供帮助。它是否会促使某人造成伤害？它是否能在技术层面提供帮助，利用合适的工具来设计并增强某种生物制剂？我们都认同，人们不应能够利用AI模型开发生物武器。但要测试其中的端到端风险真的很难。因此，我们依赖我们团队及其他团队构建的这些快照，来了解恶意行为者能在何处以及如何利用AI。
人工智能开发者可以采取哪些切实可行的措施来降低风险？
理想的做法是建立防篡改的保障措施。这方面已有一些工作，但我们能否最终做到尚不清楚。仔细想想，闭权重模型也并非不会被篡改。我们必须始终假设，任何已实施的单一干预措施都存在被绕过的办法。
那么，有效的生物安全战略应该是什么样的？
你需要在整条路径上制造阻力。我们的团队研究了这个问题，并在最近刚刚制定了一项多层次策略，可防止一场大流行规模的生物攻击。
它包含四大关键防御理论。第一是通过更强大的模型防护措施和受控访问计划等方式管理信息访问。第二是防止恶意行为者获取制造生物武器所需的材料，即DNA和RNA，例如通过基因合成筛查。第三是通过实时监测及早发现滥用行为。第四是能够快速响应并对攻击进行溯源归因，从而从一开始就威慑恶意行为者，使其不敢尝试发动攻击。
模型防护措施或许能阻止独狼式行为者，但仅凭它们自身，无法拖慢一个拥有生物武器计划的成熟国家。早期发现、早期归因——这一威慑层——或许可以。这就是挑战所在。从来不存在能阻止所有威胁的单一灵丹妙药。我们需要所有这些防线。
模型安全防护措施或许能阻止独狼式行为体，但仅靠这些措施，它们无法拖慢一个拥有生物武器计划的先进国家。
你如何避免扼杀正当研究，同时仍防止恶意用途？
生物学是一项两用事业。那些可能造成伤害的AI能力，也可能对开发医学创新极其有用。这里的目标是受管控的准入，而不是一刀切的禁令。具体而言，就是精确界定谁是合法用户，然后确保这些人能够获得他们所需的最强大工具和数据。
有一些有用的先例。例如，已有受控访问框架来应对人类基因组数据的隐私和安全问题。这既不会妨碍合法研究，也不会把数据公之于众，任人滥用。兰德公司理念的一部分是，科学界需要参与制定解决方案。AI 保障措施只有为有益研究保留有意义的效用，才会奏效。
在你的职业生涯中，是否有某个时刻让你走上了如今所从事工作的道路？
几年前，我曾是一个小型联邦团队的成员，用AI模型进行红队测试实验。我看着这些模型回答有关生物攻击的问题，它们流畅且非常自信地提供了极具创造性、很有用的信息。我记得当时突然意识到：我们需要做更多工作来监测和追踪这些风险。
我的职业生涯起步于癌症生物学家。我不断遇到这样一个现实：我们投入多年时间和大量资源研发治疗方法，但在从一开始就预防癌症方面投入却没那么多。因此，这种聚焦预防、提前防范风险以免日后仓促应对的理念，一直伴随我的整个职业生涯。

items.title: German pilots prepare for CH‑47F fleet with US Army flight simulator
items.author: Cristina Stassis
items.summary: Ahead of the German Air Force receiving its CH‑47F Block II Chinook fleet, its pilots are utilizing the U.S. Army's flight-simulator complex.
items.body:
A U.S. Army flight simulator at a barracks in Germany stands as a center of critical training for NATO’s aviation community.

The U.S. Army Garrison Ansbach’s Stock Barracks in Illesheim houses the Illesheim Flight Simulator Complex, or IFSC, providing one-of-a-kind training opportunities ahead of the German Armed Forces preparing to field CH‑47F Block II Chinook helicopters next fall, according to an Army release.

The IFSC, which is operated by U.S. Army Europe and Africa, provides the necessary training needed to prepare German forces to receive 60 of the heavy-lift, tandem-rotor helicopters, the release says.

Two German Air Force pilots who will be part of the first cohort to fly the new aircraft once they arrive in fall 2027 recently trained at the IFSC.

“In the simulator you can train all the scenarios you do not want to experience while flying a real aircraft,” said Lt. Col. L, a visiting pilot whose name was withheld, as is standard in the German Air Force, or Bundeswehr Luftwaffe. “Emergency procedures, challenging landings and extreme weather operations can all be practiced safely.”

“Everything you can do in a real flight, you can also do in a simulator,” the other visiting pilot, Maj. H, said.

The fleet will be stationed at two Bundeswehr installations and is meant to boost Germany’s heavy-lift and transport abilities, per the statement.

The two German pilots also trained in the U.S. Army Aviation Center of Excellence at Fort Rucker, Alabama.

Fort Rucker is the Army’s largest helicopter training institution and trains more than 1,300 U.S. soldiers every year. Beginning in 2028, German Air Force aviators will also trek to Fort Rucker annually for initial helicopter training and complete “track training,” including the CH‑47 qualification.

The Army did not say how many German aviators are expected to train at Fort Rucker each year, but the release noted that the German Air Force plans to staff more than 200 trained pilots to operate its future fleet.

Germany has already begun sending helicopter pilots for conversion training to the CH‑47 platform, according to the release.

Since the IFSC simulator software is tailored to U.S. Army aircraft configurations and not the Bundeswehr’s, the German pilots will need additional learning to transition to their Air Force’s aircraft.

Instead of German Air Force pilots needing to travel across the Atlantic for advanced simulator training, the IFSC allows them to drive just three to five hours from their home station.

By using the existing U.S. Army facilities in Europe, NATO partners reduce costs by not needing to build their own simulator complex, the announcement says. Even though the IFSC schedule prioritizes U.S. Army soldiers, the complex routinely supports at least five NATO partners’ pilots.

“For NATO partners requiring up-to-date, quality aircraft simulation training, USAG Ansbach’s Storck Barracks continues to prove its value: a small installation delivering strategic impact through world‑class training,” the release reads.

Cristina Stassis is a reporter covering stories surrounding the defense industry, national security, military/veteran affairs and more. She previously worked as an editorial fellow for Defense News in 2024 where she assisted the newsroom in breaking news across Sightline Media Group.
items.titleZh: 德国飞行员使用美国陆军飞行模拟器为CH-47F机队做准备
items.summaryZh: 在德国空军接收其CH-47F Block II“支奴干”机队之前，德国空军飞行员正在使用美国陆军的飞行模拟器综合体。
zhParas: 位于德国一座军营内的一台美国陆军飞行模拟器，是北约航空界关键训练的中心。
美国陆军安斯巴赫驻军位于伊勒斯海姆的斯托克军营内设有伊勒斯海姆飞行模拟器综合体（IFSC）。据美国陆军发布的消息，该综合体在德国联邦国防军准备于明年秋季列装CH-47F Block II“支奴干”直升机之前，提供了独一无二的训练机会。
新闻稿称，由美国陆军欧洲和非洲司令部运营的IFSC提供必要训练，帮助德国军队为接收60架重型纵列双旋翼直升机做好准备。
两名德国空军飞行员最近在IFSC接受了训练，待新飞机于2027年秋季抵达后，他们将成为首批驾驶该机的飞行员。
在模拟器中，你可以演练所有你在驾驶真实飞机时不想经历的情形，”L中校说道。他是一名来访飞行员，按照德国空军（即德国联邦国防军空军）的惯例，其姓名未予公开。“应急程序、高难度着陆和极端天气下的操作都可以安全地练习。
在真实飞行中能做的一切，在模拟器中也能做，”另一名来访飞行员H少校说。
根据声明，该机队将驻扎在德国联邦国防军的两处设施，旨在增强德国的重型空运与运输能力。
这两名德国飞行员还曾在位于阿拉巴马州鲁克堡的美国陆军航空卓越中心接受训练。
拉克堡是美国陆军最大的直升机训练机构，每年培训超过1300名美国士兵。从2028年开始，德国空军飞行员也将每年前往拉克堡接受初始直升机训练，并完成“分轨训练”，其中包括CH-47资格认证。
美国陆军没有说明预计每年有多少德国飞行员在拉克堡接受训练，但新闻稿指出，德国空军计划为其未来机队配备200多名受过训练的飞行员。
据新闻稿称，德国已开始派遣直升机飞行员接受CH-47平台的改装训练。
由于IFSC模拟器软件是针对美国陆军飞机配置量身定制的，而非德国联邦国防军的配置，德国飞行员需要额外学习，才能换装到本国空军的飞机。
德国空军飞行员不再需要跨越大西洋进行高级模拟器训练，IFSC让他们从驻地出发只需驾车三到五小时即可。
公告称，通过使用美国陆军在欧洲的现有设施，北约伙伴无需建造自己的模拟器综合体，从而降低了成本。尽管 IFSC 的日程安排优先考虑美国陆军士兵，但该综合体通常仍支持至少五个北约伙伴国的飞行员。
对于需要最新、高质量飞机模拟训练的北约伙伴来说，美国陆军安斯巴赫驻军的斯托克兵营继续证明其价值：一个小型设施通过世界级训练产生战略影响，”新闻稿写道。
Cristina Stassis 是一名记者，报道国防工业、国家安全、军事/退伍军人事务等领域。她曾于2024年在《防务新闻》担任编辑研究员，协助新闻编辑部处理 Sightline Media Group 旗下的突发新闻。

新闻稿称，由美国陆军欧洲和非洲司令部运营的IFSC提供必要训练，帮助德国军队为接收60架重型纵列双旋翼直升机做好准备。

两名德国空军飞行员最近在IFSC接受了训练，待新飞机于2027年秋季抵达后，他们将成为首批驾驶该机的飞行员。

在模拟器中，你可以演练所有你在驾驶真实飞机时不想经历的情形，”L中校说道。他是一名来访飞行员，按照德国空军（即德国联邦国防军空军）的惯例，其姓名未予公开。“应急程序、高难度着陆和极端天气下的操作都可以安全地练习。

在真实飞行中能做的一切，在模拟器中也能做，”另一名来访飞行员H少校说。

根据声明，该机队将驻扎在德国联邦国防军的两处设施，旨在增强德国的重型空运与运输能力。

这两名德国飞行员还曾在位于阿拉巴马州鲁克堡的美国陆军航空卓越中心接受训练。

拉克堡是美国陆军最大的直升机训练机构，每年培训超过1300名美国士兵。从2028年开始，德国空军飞行员也将每年前往拉克堡接受初始直升机训练，并完成“分轨训练”，其中包括CH-47资格认证。

美国陆军没有说明预计每年有多少德国飞行员在拉克堡接受训练，但新闻稿指出，德国空军计划为其未来机队配备200多名受过训练的飞行员。

据新闻稿称，德国已开始派遣直升机飞行员接受CH-47平台的改装训练。

由于IFSC模拟器软件是针对美国陆军飞机配置量身定制的，而非德国联邦国防军的配置，德国飞行员需要额外学习，才能换装到本国空军的飞机。

德国空军飞行员不再需要跨越大西洋进行高级模拟器训练，IFSC让他们从驻地出发只需驾车三到五小时即可。

公告称，通过使用美国陆军在欧洲的现有设施，北约伙伴无需建造自己的模拟器综合体，从而降低了成本。尽管 IFSC 的日程安排优先考虑美国陆军士兵，但该综合体通常仍支持至少五个北约伙伴国的飞行员。

对于需要最新、高质量飞机模拟训练的北约伙伴来说，美国陆军安斯巴赫驻军的斯托克兵营继续证明其价值：一个小型设施通过世界级训练产生战略影响，”新闻稿写道。

Cristina Stassis 是一名记者，报道国防工业、国家安全、军事/退伍军人事务等领域。她曾于2024年在《防务新闻》担任编辑研究员，协助新闻编辑部处理 Sightline Media Group 旗下的突发新闻。

items.title: France to start training Ukrainian pilots on Rafale warplanes in November, minister says
items.author: Rudy Ruitenberg
items.summary: France will begin training Ukrainian pilots on the Rafale fighter jet next month, Armed Forces Minister Catherine Vautrin told lawmakers on Thursday.
items.body:
PARIS — France will begin training Ukrainian pilots on the Rafale fighter jet next month, Armed Forces Minister Catherine Vautrin said in a parliamentary hearing on Thursday.

“We are continuing our discussions regarding the combat aviation component, particularly regarding the Rafale,” Vautrin told French lawmakers in response to questions about aid to Ukraine during a 2027 defense-budget hearing here. “From November, we will begin the first training of Ukrainian pilots on Rafale.”

Ukrainian pilots will soon begin training on Rafale aircraft in France, a major step forward for Ukraine’s combat aviation, the country’s President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said in a Telegram post on Monday, citing a conversation with his French counterpart Emmanuel Macron.

Ukraine in July agreed on a roadmap with France that included a plan to buy 16 Rafale fighter jets together with the accompanying weapon systems. The country has previously received F-16 jets from several European countries, Mirage 2000 fighters from France, and in May agreed to buy 20 new Gripen jets, with Sweden donating 16 units of an older model.

The first Rafale jets are expected to fly in Ukrainian skies in 2028 or 2029, Macron said in July.

Both countries are continuing to work on localizing production of French missiles and aerial bombs in Ukraine, Zelenskyy said on Monday. Vautrin said in her hearing that a licensing process is currently underway for missiles.

“We are fully aware that by supporting Ukraine, we are defending Europe,” Vautrin said.

As part of the July agreement, Ukraine would also acquire an initial batch of SAMP/T NG air-defense batteries with missiles, Macron said at the time. The countries further approved licensing agreements for production in Ukraine of the AASM glide-bomb kit, the Aster 30 air-defense interceptor that arms the SAMP/T, as well as the SCALP/Storm Shadow air-launched cruise missile.

Ukraine has already operated an older version of the French-Italian SAMP/T air-defense system, which relies on the Aster family of interceptors manufactured by MBDA. The country also uses the AASM Hammer precision glide-bomb developed by Safran.

Ukraine in November last year signed a letter of intent to buy up to 100 of Rafale jets manufactured by Dassault Aviation, after a similar letter of intent a month earlier between Ukraine and Sweden for the export of up to 150 Gripen jets, produced by Saab.

The Rafale integrates MBDA’s Meteor, considered by analysts to be one of the best long-range air-to-air missiles in service with Western militaries. The aircraft also features a high-end electronic warfare suite and a radar from Thales, both of which were upgraded as part of the Rafale’s F4.1 standard, qualified in March 2023.

Rudy Ruitenberg is a Europe correspondent for Defense News. He started his career at Bloomberg News and has experience reporting on technology, commodity markets and politics.
items.titleZh: 法国部长称，法国将于11月开始在“阵风”战斗机上训练乌克兰飞行员
items.summaryZh: 法国武装部队部长卡特琳·沃特兰周四对议员表示，法国将于下月开始在“阵风”战斗机上训练乌克兰飞行员。
zhParas: 巴黎——法国武装部队部长卡特琳·沃特兰周四在议会听证会上表示，法国将于下月开始在“阵风”战斗机上训练乌克兰飞行员。
我们正在继续就作战航空部分进行讨论，特别是关于‘阵风’战机，”沃特兰在此地一场2027年国防预算听证会上回答有关援助乌克兰的问题时对法国议员说。“从11月起，我们将开始首批乌克兰飞行员在‘阵风’战机上的培训。
乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基周一在Telegram发帖称，乌克兰飞行员将很快在法国开始接受“阵风”战斗机训练，这是乌克兰作战航空的一次重大进展；他提到了与法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙的通话。
乌克兰于7月与法国商定了一份路线图，其中包括购买16架“阵风”战斗机及配套武器系统的计划。此前，该国已从多个欧洲国家接收F-16战机，从法国接收“幻影2000”战斗机，并于5月同意购买20架新型“鹰狮”战机，同时瑞典将捐赠16架较旧型号。
马克龙在7月表示，首批“阵风”战斗机预计将于2028年或2029年飞上乌克兰天空。
泽连斯基周一表示，两国正在继续推动法国导弹和航空炸弹在乌克兰的本地化生产。沃特兰在听证会上表示，目前正在就导弹进行许可审批程序。
我们充分认识到，支持乌克兰就是在保卫欧洲，”沃特兰说。
作为7月协议的一部分，马克龙当时表示，乌克兰还将获得首批配备导弹的SAMP/T NG防空连。两国还批准了许可协议，允许在乌克兰生产AASM滑翔炸弹套件、用于装备SAMP/T的Aster 30防空拦截弹，以及SCALP/“风暴阴影”空射巡航导弹。
乌克兰已经使用过法国和意大利联合研制的SAMP/T防空系统的较老型号，该系统依赖MBDA生产的“紫菀”系列拦截弹。该国还使用赛峰集团研制的AASM Hammer精确滑翔炸弹。
乌克兰去年11月签署了一份意向书，拟购买最多100架由达索航空制造的阵风战斗机；此前一个月，乌克兰与瑞典签署了一份类似意向书，涉及出口最多150架由萨博制造的鹰狮战斗机。
阵风”集成了MBDA公司的“流星”导弹，分析人士认为它是西方军队现役最好的远程空对空导弹之一。该机还配备高端电子战套件和泰雷兹雷达，这两者均在“阵风”F4.1标准升级中进行了升级，该标准于2023年3月获得认证。
鲁迪·鲁伊滕贝格是《防务新闻》的驻欧洲记者。他的职业生涯始于彭博新闻社，在技术、大宗商品市场和政治领域拥有报道经验。

items.title: National Service of Remembrance: Sunday 8 November 2026
items.summary: How you can take part in the commemorations.
items.body:
On Sunday 8 November, the National Service of Remembrance will be held at the Cenotaph on Whitehall, London.

Starting at 11am, the service will commemorate the contribution of British and Commonwealth military and civilian servicemen and women involved in the two world wars and later conflicts.

The Department for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport (DCMS) co­ordinates the event, alongside colleagues from across government, the armed forces and veterans’ organisations.

Attending in person

No tickets or passes are needed for the event and the public are welcome to watch the ceremony from the pavements along Whitehall and Parliament Street. However, entry may be limited if the area becomes full. There will be video screens north of the Cenotaph, near the Green directly in front of the statue of Field Marshal Montgomery, and in the lay-by outside Dover House (between Horse Guards and Downing Street) and close to the junction of Whitehall Place. There is also a screen south of the Cenotaph on the corner of King Charles Street.

Space will be available for wheelchair users and other spectators who might find it difficult to view from the general public areas. This area is located on the west side of Parliament Street, close to the junction with King Charles Street. Space in this enclosure will be offered on a first-come, first-serve, basis. One carer or guest per person will also be admitted and a toilet for those with accessibility needs will be available nearby.

If you are thinking of attending the service in London, see the event schedule below:

8am : Whitehall opens to the public. Space will be limited. Please allow time to clear the police security procedures

From 10:30am : All detachments form up on the Cenotaph

From 10:50am : Participants process out onto the Cenotaph

11am : National two-minute silence marked by the firing of guns from King’s Troop on Horse Guards Parade. Cenotaph Service commences

11:25am : Cenotaph Service concludes and The Royal British Legion detachments disperse past the Cenotaph

Travelling to the event

Please be aware that stations close to the service and surrounding areas will likely be busy before and after the service times.

Plan your journey using the Transport for London and National Rail Enquiries websites.

Check Transport for London status updates and National Rail Enquiries latest travel information before you travel

Find up-to-date travel information by following National Rail Enquiries on Twitter or downloading the TfL Go app .

Great George Street will be closed to the public on Remembrance Sunday. Access between Victoria Street and St James Park will be via Storey’s Gate

There is an extensive policing security operation in place on the day. Please allow plenty of time for clearance through police security checks.

Please do not bring large bags. Those with multiple or complex openings or cases will delay yours and others entry into the public viewing areas.

Please note that the unauthorised use of any drones (including quadcopters/helicopters) in this area and the roads surrounding Whitehall is strictly prohibited at all times.

Please remain vigilant and report anything that appears suspicious, unusual or out of place to a police officer or member of event staff.

Temporary public toilets will be located in Whitehall Place.

First aid facilities, provided by St John Ambulance, will be available at various locations along Whitehall.

Photography is permitted, but the Metropolitan Police have powers to remove obstacles such as camera tripods) where they obstruct public access or views. Spectators should not take photographs during the two-­minute silence when shutter noises can offend.

Watching the event from home

You can watch the event on television on the BBC, Sky and ITV.

Follow DCMS on social media for highlights from the event.

Queries about the march past should be sent to The Royal British Legion at cenotaph@britishlegion.org.uk .
items.titleZh: 国家纪念仪式：2026年11月8日星期日
items.summaryZh: 您可以如何参与纪念活动。
zhParas: 11月8日星期日，国家纪念仪式将在伦敦白厅的纪念碑举行。
上午11时开始，纪念仪式将缅怀在两次世界大战及此后冲突中参与的英国和英联邦军事及文职男女服役人员所作出的贡献。
数字、文化、媒体和体育部（DCMS）与来自政府各部门、武装部队和退伍军人组织的同仁共同协调此次活动。
亲临现场参加
此次活动无需门票或通行证，欢迎公众从白厅和议会街沿线的人行道上观看仪式。不过，如果该区域人满，可能会限制入场。和平纪念碑以北、蒙哥马利元帅雕像正前方的草坪附近，以及多佛大厦外（皇家骑兵卫队与唐宁街之间）的路侧停车带内、靠近白厅广场路口处，都将设置视频屏幕。和平纪念碑以南、国王查尔斯街拐角处也设有一块屏幕。
将为轮椅使用者以及其他可能难以从公众区域观看的人士提供空间。该区域位于议会街西侧，靠近与国王查尔斯街的交汇处。该围栏区域内的名额将按先到先得的原则提供。每人还可携一名照护者或宾客入场，附近将提供无障碍卫生间。
如果您正考虑参加在伦敦举行的纪念仪式，请查看下方的活动日程：
上午8点：白厅向公众开放。空间有限。请预留时间通过警方安检程序。
上午10:30起：所有分遣队在纪念碑前集合列队。
上午10:50起：参与者列队走向纪念碑。
上午11点：国王部队在骑兵卫队阅兵场鸣炮，标志着全国两分钟默哀开始。纪念碑仪式开始。
上午11:25：纪念碑纪念仪式结束，皇家英国退伍军人协会各分队列队经过纪念碑后解散。
前往活动现场
请注意，靠近纪念仪式现场及周边区域的车站，在仪式前后可能会非常繁忙。
请使用伦敦交通局和国家铁路查询网站规划您的行程。
出行前，请查看伦敦交通局的最新状态更新和英国国家铁路查询的最新出行信息。
关注 National Rail Enquiries 的 Twitter 账号，或下载 TfL Go 应用，即可获取最新出行信息。
阵亡将士纪念日当天，大乔治街将不对公众开放。维多利亚街与圣詹姆斯公园之间的通行将经由斯托里门。
当天将实施大规模的警务安保行动。请预留充足时间，以便通过警方安全检查。
请勿携带大包。带有多个或复杂开口或箱盒的包袋，会延误您和他人进入公共观礼区。
请注意，本区域及白厅周边道路在任何时候都严禁未经授权使用任何无人机（包括四轴飞行器/直升机）。
请保持警惕，如发现任何可疑、异常或不合时宜的情况，请向警察或活动工作人员报告。
临时公共厕所将设在白厅广场。
白厅沿线多个地点将设有由圣约翰救护机构提供的急救设施。
允许拍照，但伦敦警察厅有权移除妨碍公众通行或视线的障碍物，例如相机三脚架。观众在默哀两分钟期间不应拍照，因为快门声可能冒犯他人。
在家观看活动
你可以通过BBC、Sky和ITV在电视上观看该活动。
请在社交媒体上关注DCMS，获取活动亮点。
有关列队行进的询问应发送至英国皇家退伍军人协会：cenotaph@britishlegion.org.uk。

亲临现场参加

此次活动无需门票或通行证，欢迎公众从白厅和议会街沿线的人行道上观看仪式。不过，如果该区域人满，可能会限制入场。和平纪念碑以北、蒙哥马利元帅雕像正前方的草坪附近，以及多佛大厦外（皇家骑兵卫队与唐宁街之间）的路侧停车带内、靠近白厅广场路口处，都将设置视频屏幕。和平纪念碑以南、国王查尔斯街拐角处也设有一块屏幕。

将为轮椅使用者以及其他可能难以从公众区域观看的人士提供空间。该区域位于议会街西侧，靠近与国王查尔斯街的交汇处。该围栏区域内的名额将按先到先得的原则提供。每人还可携一名照护者或宾客入场，附近将提供无障碍卫生间。

如果您正考虑参加在伦敦举行的纪念仪式，请查看下方的活动日程：

上午8点：白厅向公众开放。空间有限。请预留时间通过警方安检程序。

上午10:30起：所有分遣队在纪念碑前集合列队。

上午10:50起：参与者列队走向纪念碑。

上午11点：国王部队在骑兵卫队阅兵场鸣炮，标志着全国两分钟默哀开始。纪念碑仪式开始。

上午11:25：纪念碑纪念仪式结束，皇家英国退伍军人协会各分队列队经过纪念碑后解散。

前往活动现场

请注意，靠近纪念仪式现场及周边区域的车站，在仪式前后可能会非常繁忙。

请使用伦敦交通局和国家铁路查询网站规划您的行程。

出行前，请查看伦敦交通局的最新状态更新和英国国家铁路查询的最新出行信息。

关注 National Rail Enquiries 的 Twitter 账号，或下载 TfL Go 应用，即可获取最新出行信息。

阵亡将士纪念日当天，大乔治街将不对公众开放。维多利亚街与圣詹姆斯公园之间的通行将经由斯托里门。

当天将实施大规模的警务安保行动。请预留充足时间，以便通过警方安全检查。

请勿携带大包。带有多个或复杂开口或箱盒的包袋，会延误您和他人进入公共观礼区。

请注意，本区域及白厅周边道路在任何时候都严禁未经授权使用任何无人机（包括四轴飞行器/直升机）。

请保持警惕，如发现任何可疑、异常或不合时宜的情况，请向警察或活动工作人员报告。

临时公共厕所将设在白厅广场。

白厅沿线多个地点将设有由圣约翰救护机构提供的急救设施。

允许拍照，但伦敦警察厅有权移除妨碍公众通行或视线的障碍物，例如相机三脚架。观众在默哀两分钟期间不应拍照，因为快门声可能冒犯他人。

在家观看活动

你可以通过BBC、Sky和ITV在电视上观看该活动。

请在社交媒体上关注DCMS，获取活动亮点。

有关列队行进的询问应发送至英国皇家退伍军人协会：cenotaph@britishlegion.org.uk。

items.title: Turkey’s foreign minister says Ankara weighing Saudi defense support, rules out offensive role
items.author: Reuters
items.summary: Turkey, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia signed the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, under which an armed attack on one member is considered an attack on all.
items.body:
ANKARA — Turkey is assessing how it can help Saudi Arabia defend against attacks by Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthi militants under a joint defense pact with Pakistan, Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said on Thursday, ruling out Turkish participation in offensive operations.

Turkey, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia signed the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement in August, under which an armed attack on one member is considered an attack on all. The three countries have since held political and military meetings in response to the Houthi attacks.

On Monday, the countries said they had agreed to move immediately to implement their collective defense commitments and ensure the “rapid deployment” of military forces and capabilities in Saudi Arabia.

Speaking at a joint press conference with his Hungarian counterpart Anita Orban in Ankara, Fidan stressed that the pact was defensive rather than offensive, saying military officials were assessing possible contributions, particularly in air defense, electronic warfare and technical support.

“Yemen’s legitimate government forces are already continuing the battle on the ground and Saudi Arabia is supporting them,” Fidan said.

“But this is a defensive agreement. When a country party to the pact comes under attack, you stand by it in its defense. This is not an offensive agreement. Turkey will not send troops to another country to carry out attacks on its territory,” he said.

Fidan said military delegations would determine Saudi Arabia’s operational defense needs and what contributions Turkey and Pakistan could make.

On Wednesday, two officials told Reuters that Turkey was sending mainly defensive and technical support to Saudi Arabia to help its fight with Houthi militants.

Turkish officials have said any support provided at this stage would largely be in a bilateral capacity, as Turkey’s parliament has not officially ratified the joint defense pact.

Fidan said on Thursday that work was largely completed for the agreement to be submitted for parliament’s approval and that they aimed to send it “as soon as possible.”

Turkey, which has NATO’s second-largest army and a robust defense industry, has condemned the Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, voiced willingness to help meet Riyadh’s technical military needs, and agreed to join a Saudi-led coalition to ensure navigational safety in the Red Sea.
items.titleZh: 土耳其外长称安卡拉正权衡对沙特的防务支持，排除进攻性角色
items.summaryZh: 土耳其、巴基斯坦和沙特阿拉伯签署了《麦加联合防务协议》，根据该协议，对任一成员国的武装攻击均被视为对所有成员国的攻击。
zhParas: 安卡拉——土耳其外交部长哈坎·菲丹周四表示，土耳其正在评估如何根据与巴基斯坦的联合防务协议，帮助沙特阿拉伯防御也门与伊朗结盟的胡塞武装分子的袭击，并排除了土耳其参与进攻性行动的可能性。
土耳其、巴基斯坦和沙特阿拉伯于8月签署了《麦加联合防务协议》，根据该协议，对一个成员国的武装攻击被视为对所有成员国的攻击。此后，三国为应对胡塞武装袭击举行了政治和军事会议。
周一，这些国家表示，它们已同意立即采取行动，履行集体防御承诺，并确保在沙特阿拉伯“快速部署”军事力量和能力。
菲丹在安卡拉与匈牙利外长阿妮塔·奥尔班举行的联合新闻发布会上强调，该协议是防御性的，而非进攻性的，并称军方官员正在评估可能的贡献，尤其是在防空、电子战和技术支持方面。
菲丹说：“也门合法政府部队已经在当地继续作战，沙特阿拉伯正在支持他们。
他说：“但这是一项防御性协议。当协议缔约国遭到攻击时，你应站在它一边进行防御。这不是一项进攻性协议。土耳其不会向另一个国家派遣军队，以在其领土上实施攻击。
费丹表示，军事代表团将确定沙特阿拉伯的作战防御需求，以及土耳其和巴基斯坦可以作出哪些贡献。
周三，两名官员告诉路透社，土耳其正向沙特阿拉伯提供以防御和技术为主的支援，以帮助其与胡塞武装分子作战。
土耳其官员表示，由于土耳其议会尚未正式批准该联合防务协议，现阶段提供的任何支持都主要将是双边性质的。
费丹周四表示，将该协议提交议会批准的工作已基本完成，他们的目标是“尽快”提交。
土耳其拥有北约规模第二大的军队和强大的国防工业，谴责胡塞武装对沙特阿拉伯的袭击，表示愿意帮助满足利雅得的技术军事需求，并同意加入沙特领导的联盟，以确保红海的航行安全。

items.body:
Tuesday 13 October

2pm – A burial service for Lance Corporal Claude Stanley Dell of 5th Battalion The Yorkshire Regiment, who was killed in action on 25 April 1915. This service will take place at Poelcapelle British Cemetery, Belgium.

Wednesday 14 October

2pm – A burial service for an unknown soldier of the West Yorkshire Regiment. This service will take place at Serre Road No. 2 Cemetery, France.

Tuesday 20 October 2026

1pm – A burial service for Private George McIntosh of 8th Battalion The Bedfordshire Regiment, who was killed in action on 19 April 1917, and an unknown soldier of The Bedfordshire Regiment. This service will take place at Loos British Cemetery Extension, France.

Wednesday 21 October 2026

11am – A burial service for Private Percy Tolliday of 11th Battalion The Middlesex Regiment, who was killed in action on 4 October 1916, and 2 unknown soldiers. This service will take place at Warlencourt British Cemetery, France.

items.title: OA-1K Skyraider II lands at Wright-Patterson AFB for hands-on acquisition review
items.author: AFLCMC, AFSOC, USSOCOM Public Affairs
items.summary: AFSOC’s newest combat aircraft, the OA-1K Skyraider II, visited Wright-Patterson AFB for a hands-on review between operators and the acquisition workforce.
items.body:
Published Oct. 8, 2026

By AFLCMC, AFSOC, USSOCOM Public Affairs

Air Force Life Cycle Management Center Public Affairs

On Sept. 10th, the Wright-Patterson Air Force Base flightline welcomed a tailwheel turboprop aircraft with a wingspan broader than that of an A-10 Thunderbolt II and equipped with twice as many radios as an F-15E Strike Eagle . Air Force Special Operations Command ’s newest combat platform, the OA-1K Skyraider II , touched down for an exclusive "Pet-the-Aircraft" event, bringing the acquisition community face-to-face with the aircrew and the combat capability they have worked for years to build. The aircraft was flown directly from Will Rogers Air National Guard Base, Oklahoma , where operators have been refining the platform’s specialized capabilities. It was commanded and piloted by an Air Force captain and supported by the weapons systems officer, another Air Force captain. For the remainder of the afternoon, the aircraft served as a centerpiece for multidisciplinary technical evaluation, workforce recognition, and family appreciation. For the engineers, program managers, logisticians, financial managers, and contracting officers of the Air Force Life Cycle Management Center 's Attack Systems Division, operating under the Intelligence, Surveillance, Reconnaissance and Special Operations Forces (ISR & SOF) Directorate , the visit transformed engineering diagrams, contract lines, and technical data packages into operational reality. The Genesis of Armed Overwatch: Meeting the Call of the Warfighter The OA-1K's arrival at Wright-Patterson AFB marks the culmination of a deliberate, rapid acquisition journey initiated in 2020 by USSOCOM. To execute special operations missions in alignment with the National Defense Strategy , USSOCOM recognized an urgent operational deficit: the need for a sustainable, cost-effective aircraft, designed to be adaptable across mission requirements, whether it be close air support, precision strike, or armed intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance. Historically, high-end fighters and strike platforms carried immense operating costs and heavy logistical tails that strained resources during long-loiter counter-violent extremist operations. USSOCOM required a rugged, crewed system that could operate from austere, unimproved dirt strips with minimal maintenance that could adapt to mission requirements. To meet this requirement without decades of costly developmental cycles, USSOCOM deployed an aggressive, three-phased acquisition framework: Phase 1: Market Research and Industry Screening : In early 2020, USSOCOM assessed over 50 initial industry white papers and conducted extensive contractor facility assessments, alongside independent RAND Corporation studies, to down-select the field to five viable flying prototypes. Phase 2: Prototype Flight Demonstrations : In early 2021, leveraging Title 10 U.S.C. § 4022 Middle Tier of Acquisition (MTA) Rapid Prototyping authority to conduct flight trials across five competitive aircraft at Eglin AFB, Florida, narrowing the selection to three finalists. Phase 3: Production Solicitation and Contract Award : From summer 2021 to summer 2022, the process transitioned from MTA to Major Capability Acquisition Milestone C . A competitive production solicitation was issued, culminating in a best-value contract award to L3Harris for the AT-802U integrated weapon system. In late 2022, the aircraft earned its official military type designation, OA-1K, and in February 2025, AFSOC formally christened it the "Skyraider II," a historic homage to the famed Douglas A-1 Skyraider that protected downed airmen and supported troops in contact during the Korean and Vietnam wars. Bridging the Gap: PMO Technical Q&A with the Aircrew A highlight of the event was an interactive, open-forum Q&A session between the Wright-Patterson Program Management Office team and the visiting pilot and WSO. This session provided an invaluable feedback loop, allowing program managers, engineers, contracting specialists, financial managers, and logisticians to hear directly from the aviators flying the aircraft daily. This direct technical exchange gave the PMO real-world user feedback to refine future system reviews, tackle engineering bottlenecks, and streamline the upcoming transition of the fleet from Block-1 to the combat-ready Block-2 standard. Built for the Austere Edge: Crop Duster to Combat Workhorse The OA-1K Skyraider II represents a masterclass in militarizing proven commercial utility designs. Manufactured initially by Air Tractor in Olney, Texas, as the AT-802 utility airframe, the platform is modified into a combat-ready weapon system.

Powerplant and Performance : Pratt and Whitney PT6A Turboprop – delivers high-torque performance, high loiter persistence, and low operating costs per flying hour.

Runway Independence : Ruggedized tailwheel fixed landing gear and Short Takeoff and Landing capability – takes off and lands on austere dirt, gravel, or grass airstrips.

Combat Payload : Missionized equipment across external hardpoints – standard loadouts feature pods for air-launched rockets, air-to-ground missiles, and precision-guide munitions.

Mission Architecture : The pilot and WSO stations have independent, full control of flight systems, sensors, and munitions.

Expeditionary Mobility : Rapid breakdown and reassembly design – can be disassembled in hours by a small crew, loaded into a single cargo aircraft, and rapidly reassembled in theater.

With the aircraft returning to its training lines in Oklahoma, the Wright-Patterson AFB acquisition team turns its focus back to contract milestones, technical reviews, and sustainment packages that will ensure the OA-1K Skyraider II stands ready when the call comes downrange. OA-1K Skyraider II Fast Facts :

Primary Mission : Close Air Support, Armed ISR, and Precision Strike

Lead Commands : Air Force Special Operations Command and U.S. Special Operations Command

Program Management : AFLCMC/WID Attack Systems Division supporting USSOCOM PEO Fixed Wing

Crew : 2 (Pilot in front seat, Weapon Systems Officer in rear seat)
items.titleZh: OA-1K“天袭者”II 飞抵赖特-帕特森空军基地进行实操采办评审
items.summaryZh: 美国空军特种作战司令部（AFSOC）最新型作战飞机 OA-1K“天袭者”II 到访赖特-帕特森空军基地，供作战人员与采办人员进行实操评审。
zhParas: 发布于2026年10月8日
由美国空军生命周期管理中心、美国空军特种作战司令部、美军特种作战司令部公共事务部门发布
空军生命周期管理中心公共事务处

9月10日，赖特-帕特森空军基地停机坪迎来了一架后三点式涡轮螺旋桨飞机，其翼展比A-10“雷电II”更宽，装备的电台数量是F-15E“攻击鹰”的两倍。美国空军特种作战司令部（AFSOC）最新战斗平台OA-1K“天袭者II”降落于此，参加一场专属的“抚摸飞机”活动，让采办界与机组人员以及他们多年努力打造的战斗能力面对面接触。该机直接从俄克拉何马州威尔·罗杰斯空军国民警卫队基地飞来，操作人员一直在那里完善该平台的专项能力。该机由一名空军上尉担任指挥和飞行员，另一名空军上尉担任武器系统官提供支持。当天下午剩余时间里，该机成为多学科技术评估、员工表彰和家属感谢活动的中心。对于空军生命周期管理中心攻击系统部——该部隶属于情报、监视、侦察与特种作战部队（ISR & SOF）局——的工程师、项目经理、后勤人员、财务经理和合同官而言，这次访问将工程图纸、合同条目和技术数据包变成了作战现实。

武装守望的起源：回应作战人员的呼唤

OA-1K抵达赖特-帕特森空军基地，标志着美军特种作战司令部（USSOCOM）于2020年启动的审慎而快速的采办历程达到高潮。为按照《国防战略》执行特种作战任务，美军特种作战司令部认识到一个紧迫的作战缺口：需要一种可持续、成本效益高、设计上能适应不同任务需求的飞机，无论是近距离空中支援、精确打击，还是武装情报、监视与侦察。从历史上看，高端战斗机和打击平台使用成本巨大，后勤负担沉重，在长时间盘旋的反暴力极端主义作战中使资源紧张。美军特种作战司令部需要一种坚固耐用、有人驾驶的系统，能够在简陋、未铺设的土跑道上以最低限度维护运行，并能适应任务需求。为在无需经历数十年昂贵发展周期的情况下满足这一需求，美军特种作战司令部采用了积极进取的三阶段采办框架：第一阶段：市场研究与工业界筛选：2020年初，美军特种作战司令部评估了50多份初始工业界白皮书，并进行了广泛的承包商设施评估，同时参考兰德公司的独立研究，将候选范围缩减至五种可行的飞行原型。第二阶段：原型飞行演示：2021年初，利用《美国法典》第10编第4022条“中间层采办”（MTA）快速原型化授权，在佛罗里达州埃格林空军基地对五种竞争机型进行飞行试验，将选择范围缩小至三个最终入围者。第三阶段：生产招标与合同授予：从2021年夏到2022年夏，该过程从MTA过渡到重大能力采办里程碑C。发布了竞争性生产招标，最终将最佳价值合同授予L3Harris，用于AT-802U集成武器系统。2022年末，该机获得正式军用型号命名OA-1K；2025年2月，AFSOC正式将其命名为“天袭者II”，这是对著名的道格拉斯A-1“天袭者”的历史致敬——该机曾在朝鲜战争和越南战争中保护被击落的飞行员，并支援与敌接触的部队。

弥合差距：项目管理办公室与机组人员的技术问答

活动的一个亮点是赖特-帕特森项目管理办公室团队与来访飞行员和武器系统官之间进行的互动式开放问答环节。该环节提供了宝贵的反馈闭环，使项目经理、工程师、合同专家、财务经理和后勤人员能够直接听取每天驾驶该机的飞行员意见。这种直接技术交流为项目管理办公室提供了真实世界用户反馈，以改进未来系统审查、解决工程瓶颈，并简化即将进行的机队从Block-1向具备作战能力的Block-2标准过渡。

为严酷边缘环境而造：从农用喷洒机到作战主力

OA-1K“天袭者II”代表了将成熟商用通用设计军事化的典范。该平台最初由得克萨斯州奥尔尼的Air Tractor公司制造，作为AT-802通用机身，后被改装为具备作战能力的武器系统。
动力装置与性能：普惠PT6A涡轮螺旋桨发动机——提供高扭矩性能、高滞空持久性以及较低的每飞行小时运营成本。
跑道独立性：加固型后三点式固定起落架与短距起降能力——可在条件简陋的土质、砾石或草地跑道上起降。
作战载荷：外挂点上的任务化装备——标准挂载配置包括用于空射火箭弹、空对地导弹和精确制导武器的吊舱。
任务架构：飞行员和武器系统官（WSO）工作站可独立、完全控制飞行系统、传感器和弹药。
远征机动性：快速拆分与重新组装设计——可由小型团队在数小时内完成分解，装入单架货运飞机，并在战区快速重新组装。
随着该机返回位于俄克拉何马州的训练线，赖特-帕特森空军基地采办团队将重点重新转向合同里程碑、技术审查和持续保障方案，以确保OA-1K“天袭者”II在接到前方召唤时保持战备。OA-1K“天袭者”II速览：
主要任务：近距离空中支援、武装情报、监视与侦察，以及精确打击
牵头司令部：空军特种作战司令部和美军特种作战司令部
项目管理：AFLCMC/WID攻击系统部，支持美军特种作战司令部固定翼项目执行办公室
机组人员：2人（前座飞行员，后座武器系统官）

items.title: German lawmakers approve funds for eight-ship fleet of sub-hunting frigates
items.author: Linus Höller
items.summary: The German ships will support NATO missions in the Baltic and North seas, the Atlantic and the High North, according to the announcement.
items.body:
VIENNA — German lawmakers on Thursday approved the acquisition of four additional MEKO A-200 DEU frigates from shipbuilder TKMS, bringing Berlin’s planned fleet to eight ships after the government abandoned its troubled F126 program.

The Bundestag budget committee had approved the first four vessels July 8, alongside an option for four more. The Defense Ministry said the decision to exercise that option will give the German Navy a single, eight-ship class intended chiefly for anti-submarine warfare.

Delivery of the first vessel is set for 2029, the agency said in a statement. The ships will support NATO missions in the Baltic and North seas, the Atlantic and the High North, according to the announcement.

Berlin selected the MEKO design after withdrawing from its contract with Damen Naval for six F126 frigates, which had initially been intended to supply the Navy’s future anti-submarine warfare capability. The ministry attributed its withdrawal to “considerable performance problems” by Damen, saying it had completed a broader assessment before terminating the arrangement.

The program change has already triggered a costly dispute. Damen is seeking €4.7 billion ($5.3 billion) in damages from the German government, arguing that Berlin’s termination was politically motivated and legally unfounded, Der Spiegel reported last week. The F126 effort had already cost Germany more than €2 billion without delivering a ship, according to public broadcaster ARD.

The initial four-ship MEKO purchase carried a reported €6.3 billion price tag, while the four-ship option was valued at €5.3 billion. Reuters reported that the second tranche, including project support and reserves, would cost roughly €5.6 billion; the projected operating costs for those four vessels through 2045 amount to another €1.55 billion.

The Defense Ministry argued that selecting one ship type should simplify training, maintenance and logistics. It also said variants of the MEKO A-200 are already in service with allied navies.

TKMS described the envisioned eight-ship production run as the company’s largest-ever surface vessel contract.

“With the four frigates already on order, the program has entered the implementation phase,” the shipbuilder said in a statement.

As part of its post-2022 buildup, the German military has put a heavy emphasis on anti-submarine warfare abilities in the Baltic, North Sea and, especially since the crisis over Greenland, in the Arctic. The F-126 was meant to be an integral part of this strategy. Other, more successful, procurements aimed at combating submarines include the Boeing P-8A Poseidon maritime-surveillance aircraft, the first of which landed in Germany almost exactly a year ago.

Linus Höller is Defense News' Europe correspondent and OSINT investigator. He reports on the arms deals, sanctions, and geopolitics shaping Europe and the world. He holds master’s degrees in WMD nonproliferation, terrorism studies, and international relations, and works in four languages: English, German, Russian, and Spanish.
items.titleZh: 德国议员批准为八艘反潜护卫舰舰队拨款
items.summaryZh: 公告称，这些德国舰艇将支持北约在波罗的海和北海、大西洋以及高北地区的任务。
zhParas: 维也纳——德国议员周四批准从造船企业TKMS增购四艘MEKO A-200 DEU护卫舰，使柏林计划中的舰队规模达到八艘。此前，政府放弃了问题缠身的F126项目。
德国联邦议院预算委员会已于7月8日批准首批四艘舰艇，并附带再购四艘的选择权。国防部表示，行使该选择权的决定将使德国海军拥有一个统一的八艘舰级，主要用于反潜战。
该机构在一份声明中表示，首艘舰艇定于2029年交付。根据公告，这些舰艇将支持北约在波罗的海和北海、大西洋以及高北地区的任务。
柏林在退出与达门海军签订的六艘F126护卫舰合同后，选择了MEKO设计；这些护卫舰最初旨在为海军提供未来的反潜战能力。国防部将其退出归因于达门存在“相当大的性能问题”，并表示在终止该安排前已完成更广泛的评估。
该项目变更已引发一场代价高昂的纠纷。据《明镜周刊》上周报道，达门正向德国政府索赔47亿欧元（53亿美元），称柏林的终止决定出于政治动机且在法律上毫无根据。据公共广播机构ARD报道，F126项目已让德国花费超过20亿欧元，却未交付任何一艘舰艇。
据报道，最初四艘MEKO舰艇的采购价格为63亿欧元，而四艘舰的选择权估值为53亿欧元。路透社报道称，包括项目支持和储备金在内的第二批采购将耗资约56亿欧元；这四艘舰艇到2045年的预计运营成本另计15.5亿欧元。
国防部认为，选择一种舰型应能简化训练、维护和后勤。它还表示，MEKO A-200 的改型已在盟国海军中服役。
TKMS 将设想中的八艘舰量产项目称为该公司有史以来最大的水面舰艇合同。
随着四艘护卫舰已经下单，该项目已进入实施阶段，”这家造船企业在一份声明中表示。
作为其2022年后扩军建设的一部分，德国军方一直高度重视在波罗的海、北海，尤其是在格陵兰危机以来的北极地区的反潜战能力。F-126 原本旨在成为这一战略不可或缺的一部分。其他更成功的反潜采购项目包括波音 P-8A“海神”海上监视飞机，其中首架几乎正好一年前抵达德国。
利努斯·赫勒是《防务新闻》的欧洲通讯员兼开源情报调查员。他报道影响欧洲和世界的军火交易、制裁和地缘政治。他拥有大规模杀伤性武器防扩散、恐怖主义研究和国际关系硕士学位，并能用四种语言工作：英语、德语、俄语和西班牙语。
