items.title: B-21 Testing, Manufacturing Ramp Up: ‘We’re Moving Fast’
items.author: Chris Gordon
items.summary: Northrop Grumman has broken ground on a major new production facility for the B-21 Raider, the company and the Air Force announced Oct. 6. The construction comes as a top service official said testing on the bomber is going well in the lead up to its planned introduction into the operational fleet in 2027. The post B-21 Testing, Manufacturing Ramp Up: ‘We’re Moving Fast’ appeared first on Air & Space Forces Magazine .
items.body:
Editor’s Note: This article was updated Oct. 8 with additional information.

Northrop Grumman has broken ground on a major new production facility for the B-21 Raider, the company and the Air Force announced Oct. 6. The construction comes as a top service official said testing on the bomber is going well in the lead up to its planned introduction into the operational fleet in 2027.

“It’s more than construction,” Secretary of the Air Force Troy Meink wrote in a social media post. “We’re moving fast to build B-21s!”

The Air Force Test Center has likewise been moving quickly to test the bomber ahead of its introduction into service next year. Brig. Gen. Mark Massaro, head of the Air Force Test Center at Edwards Air Force Base, Calif., gave an enthusiastic thumbs-up when asked about the program at an Oct. 6 event. The aircraft first flew in 2023, and two bombers are currently known to be undergoing testing at the base.

“I can’t give you many details about specifics on how it’s going, but I am very closely tied into that program and have been getting regular updates,” Massaro said during a discussion hosted by AFA’s Mitchell Institute for Aerospace Studies. “We are actively testing right now.”

Less than 30 miles away, Northrop is already building B-21s at its Air Force Plant 42 facility in Palmdale, Calif., but the new construction will add 1 million square feet of production space. Meink said it will be the “final assembly line” for new bombers.

In February, Air Force officials said they had agreed on a plan with Northrop to increase B-21 production capacity by 25 percent, using $4.5 billion from the “One Big Beautiful Bill” legislation passed in 2025. Northrop is also investing $2.5 billion of its own money in bolstering B-21 production, CEO Kathy Warden said in April.

The new groundbreaking, which occurred Sept. 29, is “a significant step toward expanding production capacity for the B-21 Raider and delivering combat capability to the Joint Force faster,” the service wrote in a photo caption provided of the groundbreaking.

“The B-21 team has established the foundation to accelerate production responsibly,” Col. Nicholas Jordan, B-21 Systems program director, Rapid Capabilities Office, said in an Oct. 8 statement. “This investment in Palmdale will provide the infrastructure, workforce, and manufacturing capacity needed to deliver the Raider to the Air Force at an increased rate.”

Increased production capacity is likely—but not confirmed—to lead to more B-21s overall. While the official program of record is for a minimum of 100 bombers, U.S. Strategic Command boss Adm. Richard Correll and U.S. Pacific Command head Adm. Samuel Paparo have advocated for a larger B-21 buy, and Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth told lawmakers in April that the Air Force will need “a lot more” than 100 B-21s in the future.

The Air Force has yet to formally commit to more than 100 bombers, but top leaders have indicated they are open to doing so.

“At some point in the future, we’ll consider additional buys,” Air Force Chief of Staff Gen. Ken Wilsbach told Air & Space Forces Magazine in July when asked about increasing the size of the future B-21 fleet. “One of the things we’re talking to Northrop about is how could we do that in a way that doesn’t stretch out.”

The U.S. military has said it wants its bombers to be delivered more quickly.

“The B-21 Raider is foundational to the Air Force’s future long-range strike capability, and this investment strengthens the industrial capacity required to field that capability faster,” Gen. Dale White, the Pentagon’s director for Critical Major Weapon Systems, said in an Oct. 8 statement.

Exactly how many the service may buy will likely come out with the Air Force’s 2028 budget request, expected in spring 2027, Air Force Deputy Chief of Staff for Plans and Programs Lt. Gen. David H. Tabor said earlier this year.

Meanwhile, at Edwards, the Air Force is pushing a novel approach to testing by having developmental test pilots fly alongside operational test pilots, the head of the Test Center said.

“One of the areas that we’re really getting into, which we have done in the past, but in a big way, we’re moving forward in programs like the B-21 … is that integrated test,” Massaro said, which is “making sure that the warfighter and our operators have earlier insight into a lot of the developmental test work to be able to get information to make comments and understanding of what things might need to change earlier in a development cycle, but then also influence and discuss how this is going to be operated best. You’re bringing that operator in earlier into the Test Center test execution phase.”

“That integrated test construct is something that we’ve been very much focused on more often in a lot more programs, and that is something on the B-21 that I would like to highlight,” he added.
items.titleZh: B-21测试、制造加速：“我们正在快速推进
items.summaryZh: 诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司已为B-21“突袭者”轰炸机的一座大型新生产设施破土动工，该公司和美国空军于10月6日宣布。此时，一位空军高级官员表示，在该轰炸机计划于2027年进入作战机队之前，其测试进展顺利。题为《B-21测试、制造加速：“我们正在快速推进”》的文章最初发表于《空军与太空军杂志》。
zhParas: 编者按：本文于10月8日更新，补充了更多信息。
诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司和美国空军10月6日宣布，诺斯罗普·格鲁曼已为B-21“突袭者”轰炸机的一座大型新生产设施破土动工。此前，空军一位高层官员表示，在该轰炸机计划于2027年加入作战机队之前，其测试进展顺利。
这不仅仅是施工，”美国空军部长特洛伊·梅因克在社交媒体帖子中写道，“我们正在快速推进B-21的建造！
美国空军测试中心同样在快速推进该轰炸机的测试，以便在其明年服役前完成相关工作。10月6日的一场活动上，当被问及该项目时，加利福尼亚州爱德华兹空军基地空军测试中心负责人马克·马萨罗准将热情地竖起大拇指。该机于2023年首飞，目前已知有两架轰炸机正在该基地接受测试。
我无法透露太多关于进展的具体细节，但我与该项目的联系非常紧密，并一直定期收到最新情况，”马萨罗在由美国空军协会米切尔航空航天研究所主办的一场讨论中说，“我们目前正在积极进行测试。
在不到30英里外，诺斯罗普已在加利福尼亚州帕姆代尔的空军第42工厂建造B-21，但新建设施将增加100万平方英尺的生产空间。梅因克表示，它将成为新轰炸机的“总装线”。
2月，空军官员表示，他们已与诺斯罗普公司达成一项计划，将B-21产能提高25%，资金来自2025年通过的“一项大而美的法案”中的45亿美元。诺斯罗普首席执行官凯西·沃登4月表示，该公司还将自筹25亿美元来提升B-21产量。
9月29日举行的新破土动工仪式是“扩大B-21‘突袭者’产能、更快向联合部队交付作战能力的重要一步”，空军在为该破土动工仪式提供的照片说明中写道。
B-21团队已为负责任地加快生产奠定了基础，”快速能力办公室B-21系统项目主管尼古拉斯·乔丹上校在10月8日的声明中说。“对帕姆代尔的这笔投资将提供以更高速度向空军交付‘突袭者’所需的基础设施、劳动力和制造能力。
产能提升可能——但尚未确认——会导致B-21总量增加。虽然正式记录在案的项目要求至少采购100架轰炸机，但美军战略司令部司令理查德·科雷尔海军上将和美军印太司令部司令塞缪尔·帕帕罗海军上将都主张扩大B-21采购量，国防部长皮特·赫格塞思4月对议员表示，空军未来将需要“远不止”100架B-21。
空军尚未正式承诺采购超过100架轰炸机，但高层领导人已表示愿意这样做。
未来某个时候，我们会考虑追加采购，”空军参谋长肯·威尔巴赫上将在7月被问及扩大未来B-21机队规模时对《空天力量杂志》表示。“我们正在与诺斯罗普讨论的一件事是，如何在不拖延的情况下做到这一点。
美国军方表示，希望其轰炸机能更快交付。
B-21‘突袭者’是空军未来远程打击能力的基础，这项投资增强了更快部署该能力所需的工业产能，”五角大楼关键重大武器系统主任戴尔·怀特将军在10月8日的一份声明中表示。
空军负责计划与项目的副参谋长戴维·H·塔博尔中将今年早些时候表示，空军可能采购多少架的确切数字，很可能随空军2028财年预算申请一并公布，而该预算申请预计于2027年春季发布。
与此同时，测试中心负责人表示，在爱德华兹空军基地，空军正在推行一种新颖的测试方式，让研制试飞员与作战试飞员一起飞行。
马萨罗说：“我们真正深入涉足的一个领域——过去也做过，但如今正以很大力度在B-21等项目上推进——就是综合测试。”这也就是“确保作战人员和我们的操作员能更早深入了解大量研制测试工作，从而获得信息，提出意见，并理解在研制周期中哪些方面可能需要更早改变，同时还能影响并讨论如何最好地操作它。你把操作员更早带入测试中心的测试执行阶段。
他补充说：“这种综合测试架构是我们已经在越来越多项目中更频繁地高度关注的方面，也是我在B-21项目上想强调的一点。

items.title: Rubio says US, Greece to jointly combat security threats
items.author: Ivana Sekularac, Angeliki Koutantou, Lefteris Papadimas, Jonathan Landay, Reuters
items.summary: The U.S. and Greece are launching a joint security program to strengthen counterterrorism information sharing between their law enforcement agencies.
items.body:
U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Wednesday that “strong and model NATO ally” Greece and the United States are launching new counterterrorism information sharing between their law enforcement agencies.

During an official visit to Athens, Rubio said Greece was particularly exposed to the threats posed by mass migration and human trafficking.

“As part of our efforts to combat these common threats to our nations, we’re proud to announce a new memorandum of understanding establishing a joint security program to strengthen the counterterrorism information sharing between our respective law enforcement agencies,” he told reporters alongside Greek Foreign Minister George Gerapetritis.

Greece has been an important NATO ally to the United States, offering key military facilities to safeguard security in the Eastern Mediterranean, and it leads an EU maritime mission to protect commercial shipping in the Red Sea.

Rubio and Gerapetritis presided over the sixth round of a U.S.-Greece strategic dialogue that began in 2018 in which the sides agreed “to deepen defense ties, bolster trade and investment, and promote cultural ties,” according to a joint statement.

Greece, it said, would receive $4 billion to support a long-term defense plan to increase interoperability between the two militaries and to “explore future opportunities for defense industrial base cooperation.”

Gerapetritis said that Greece was willing to cooperate with the United States and offer maritime aid in the Strait of Hormuz if there is a viable peace process there.

Rubio stood by U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle after U.S. senators expressed concerns over allegations that she had threatened that the U.S. could use its influence to undermine the Greek government.

Asked if her conduct was in compliance with State Department ethics, Rubio said: “Suffice it to say, our embassy here is doing a great job. Our ambassador has been a strong ambassador here.”
items.titleZh: 卢比奥称美希将携手应对安全威胁
items.summaryZh: 美国与希腊正在推出一项联合安全计划，旨在加强两国执法机构之间的反恐信息共享机制。
zhParas: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥周三表示，作为‘强大且堪称典范的北约盟友’的希腊与美国正在推动两国执法机构之间开展新的反恐信息共享机制。
在雅典的正式访问期间，卢比奥表示，希腊尤其面临大规模移民和人口贩卖所带来的安全威胁。
在与希腊外交部长乔治·格拉佩特里蒂斯一同接受记者采访时，卢比奥表示：‘为共同应对这些威胁两国安全的共同挑战，我们很高兴宣布达成一项新的谅解备忘录，旨在建立一项联合安全计划，从而加强两国执法机构在反恐信息共享方面的合作。’
作为美国重要的北约盟友，希腊不仅提供关键的军事设施以维护东地中海地区的安全，还牵头开展欧盟海上任务，旨在保护红海地区的商业航运安全。
根据双方发布的联合声明，鲁比奥与格拉佩特里蒂斯共同主持了始于2018年的第六轮美希战略对话。在会谈中，双方同意“深化防务合作，加强贸易与投资往来，并促进文化交流”。
据称，希腊将获得40亿美元资金，用于支持一项长期国防计划，旨在提升两国军队的协同作战能力，并“探索国防工业领域未来的合作机遇”。
格拉佩特里蒂斯表示，如果霍尔木兹海峡能够启动可行的和平进程，希腊愿与美国携手合作，并为该地区的安全保障提供海上援助。
在多名美国参议员对金伯利·吉尔福伊尔涉嫌威胁称美国会利用自身影响力削弱希腊政府表示担忧后，鲁比奥站出来为这位美国驻希腊大使辩护。
当被问及她的行为是否符合美国国务院的道德规范时，鲁比奥回应称：‘可以说，我们在这里的大使馆工作表现极为出色，我们的大使也是一位非常出色的驻希腊大使。’

items.title: DAF leaders, their spouses highlight families’ role in mission success
items.author: Tech. Sgt. William A. O’Brien
items.summary: During a panel at the 2026 Air, Space & Cyber Conference, senior DAF leaders and their spouses discussed grassroots quality-of-life challenges alongside key initiatives, including the Global Military Spouse Connection pilot, DoD STARBASE STEM programs, and AFPAAS roster integration.
items.body:
Published Oct. 7, 2026

By Tech. Sgt. William A. O’Brien

Secretary of the Air Force Public Affairs

Top Air Force and Space Force leaders, joined by their spouses, offered observations during a panel at the Air, Space and Cyber Conference into the lives of military families and how that dynamic contributes to readiness and defense of the nation.

Luke Air Force Base, Glendale, Arizona

Goodfellow AFB, San Angelo, Texas

Laughlin AFB, Del Rio, Texas

Mountain Home AFB. Mountain Home, Idaho

Travis AFB, Fairfield, California

Patrick Space Force Base, Satellite Beach, Florida

Ramstein AB, Ramstein-Miesenbach

RAF Croughton, United Kingdom

RAF Mildenhall, U.K.

RAF Lakenheath, U.K.

RAF Feltwell, U.K.

Kadena AB, Okinawa, Japan

The program is designed to target military spouse unemployment, which currently has rates around 20%, largely due to frequent permanent change of station moves. GMSC aims to improve career continuity by connecting qualified spouses with DAF civilian employment opportunities before they arrive at their new duty station. “It is a good start,” said CMSAF Wolfe. “With the four spouses here being involved in the [Presidential] Military Spouse Commission, we have an opportunity to make some real change to laws that currently prevent us from hiring people fast enough and putting people in positions and jobs.” STARBASE and STEM Support for Military Children Another family-oriented program mentioned during the panel was STARBASE, a Department of War STEM education program that delivers hands-on, immersive experiences primarily to fifth grade students from military-connected, at-risk and underserved communities. The program seeks to spark interest and inspire the next generation of scientists, engineers and future defense professionals. “Our kids have to live with the decisions of their parents, and I think we owe them the best we possibly can provide,” said CMSAF Wolfe. He stressed the importance of the Air Force investing in educational opportunities for military children, using Starbase as a positive example. The program exposes military youth to the technological environments and positive civilian and military roles found on active, Guard, and Reserve military bases and installations. AFPAAS Card for Spouse Roster Each spouse discussed the challenge in spouse outreach, especially during times when connecting with family is most essential such as deployments and crises. One solution mentioned was an Air Force Personnel Accountability and Assessment System Card , which provides unit leaders with instructional pocket cards and guidance for accessing current personnel and family contact information through the AFPAAS, maintaining accurate recall rosters and securely sharing appropriate roster data with key support liaisons. Improving access to timely contact information, the initiative supports faster outreach to newly arriving spouses and families of deployed Airmen and Guardians, strengthens assistance during permanent change of station moves, deployments, exercises and emergencies and closes gaps in family-support communication. Participation respects privacy, as spouses may opt out of routine contact, while enabling stronger grassroots support networks and unit resilience. Advice to the Next Generation Panelists were asked what advice they would give to young Airmen, Guardians, and their spouses who are just beginning their military journey:

Take every opportunity to grow professionally and personally

Build and nurture strong relationships

Recognize that military service is a family service to the nation

Prioritize physical fitness, financial responsibility and emotional resilience

Understand the “why” behind the mission to support one another more effectively

Never underestimate the power of simple human connection

"You have to really embrace the preciousness of time because you can't get it back,” said CMSSF Bentivegna. “We're always focusing on that next assignment, next rotation, or the next deployment. You think, 'I've got plenty of time to focus on my finances, education, family, relationships … but you can't get that time back. Make the most of it."

该项目旨在应对军人配偶失业问题，目前失业率约为20%，主要原因是频繁的永久驻地变更调动。GMSC旨在通过将合格配偶与其抵达新驻地前可获得空军部文职就业机会相对接，改善其职业连续性。“这是一个良好的开端，”空军首席军士长沃尔夫说。“有四位配偶在此参与[总统]军人配偶委员会，我们有机会推动切实的法律变革，现行法律阻碍我们足够快地雇用人员并将其安排到岗位和工作中。”STARBASE与对军人子女的STEM支持 小组讨论中提到的另一个面向家庭的节目是STARBASE，这是战争部的一个STEM教育项目，主要面向来自与军方有关联、面临风险和服务不足社区的五年级学生，提供动手实践和沉浸式体验。该项目旨在激发兴趣，并激励下一代科学家、工程师和未来国防专业人才。“我们的孩子不得不承受父母所作决定带来的后果，而我认为我们应当尽力为他们提供最好的一切，”空军首席军士长沃尔夫说。他强调空军投资于军人子女教育机会的重要性，并以STARBASE作为一个积极例子。该项目让军人青少年接触现役、国民警卫队和预备役军事基地及设施中的技术环境以及正面的文职和军职角色。面向配偶名册的AFPAAS卡 每位配偶都讨论了配偶联络工作中的挑战，尤其是在部署和危机等与家人联系最为关键的时候。提到的一个解决方案是空军人员问责与评估系统卡（AFPAAS卡），它为部队领导提供指导性口袋卡和指南，以便通过AFPAAS获取当前人员和家属联系信息、维护准确的召回名册，并与关键支持联络人安全共享适当的名册数据。该举措改善了及时获取联系信息的能力，支持更快联系新抵达的配偶以及已部署空军人员和太空军人员的家属，加强在永久驻地变更、部署、演习和紧急情况期间的援助，并弥合家庭支持沟通中的缺口。参与尊重隐私，因为配偶可以选择不接收日常联系，同时能够增强基层支持网络和部队韧性。给下一代的建议 小组成员被问及，他们会给刚刚开始军旅生涯的年轻空军人员、太空军人员及其配偶什么建议：
抓住每一个在职业和个人方面成长的机会
建立并培育牢固的人际关系
认识到军人服役是全家对国家的奉献
优先重视身体健康、财务责任和情绪韧性
理解使命背后的“为什么”，从而更有效地相互支持
绝不要低估简单人际联结的力量
你必须真正珍视时间的宝贵，因为时间一去不复返，”美国太空军首席军士长本蒂韦尼亚说，“我们总是关注下一次任务、下一次轮换或下一次部署。你会想，‘我有充足的时间去关注我的财务、教育、家庭、人际关系……但你无法把那些时间追回来。要充分利用它。’

items.title: Decades-long mystery solved as lost bomber crew identified
items.summary: The graves of four previously unknown World War 2 Airmen have finally been given names at a ceremony in the Netherlands.
items.body:
Four airmen who died when their Lancaster bomber crashed in Germany in December 1944 were finally honoured by name after an 82-year search uncovered the truth behind one of Bomber Command’s wartime mysteries.

Earlier today at the CWGC ’s Venray War Cemetery in the Netherlands a service was held for Flying Officer ( Fg Off ) Leslie Markland Hough, Royal Australian Air Force ( RAAF ); Pilot Officer ( Plt Off ) John Henry Tales, Royal Air Force Volunteer Reserve ( RAFVR ); Sergeant ( Sgt ) Henry Charles Burnside RAFVR and Sgt John Lawson RAFVR , whose remains lay in graves marked ‘unknown’ for decades following a series of post-war administrative errors.

On the morning of 8 December 1944, the Lancaster PD374 of No. 218 Squadron RAF departed RAF Methwold in Norfolk as part of a force of more than 130 tasked with attacking the Neerbeck oil plant at Homberg in Germany’s Ruhr region. From the seven man Lancaster crew; three escaped by parachute and were taken as Prisoners of War and the other four lost their lives.

JCCC Caseworker, Tracey Bowers, said:

Today we honour the British and Australian airmen who served and died together during World War 2. To have so many families present here today has made this occasion especially poignant, and seeing them interacting with members of the local community who have adopted these graves incredibly moving.

Plt Off Tales, born in Attercliffe, Sheffield, on 31 December 1917 was one of eleven children. He worked as a poster writer before enlisting in the RAF in September 1939 where he built an exemplary service record. Despite having already completed a full operational tour, he volunteered to return to frontline operations and joined No. 218 Squadron in August 1944.

John Tales, nephew of Plt Off Tales, who attended the service with other family members said:

It has been an extremely poignant occasion and we are honoured and quite overwhelmed to have been here. It has been wonderful to learn more about our Uncle John and we would like to thank all those who have made this possible

The Captain of Lancaster PD374 was Australian airman Fg Off Hough RAAF . Eyewitness accounts suggest Hough remained at the controls of the burning aircraft to give others the opportunity to escape.

The two other crew honoured were Sgts Burnside and Lawson. Burnside was known for his professionalism and immaculate appearance, while Lawson, affectionately known as “Geordie”, came from a mining family in County Durham.

Thurston Lawson, nephew of Sgt Lawson who attended the service with his cousin John Lawson said:

Fantastic day and incredibly memorable. So moving to see so many people here and everyone has been so kind and represented their organisations brilliantly.

The rededication service was conducted by Reverend (Group Captain) Ruth Hake, who said:

It is my immense privilege to conduct the ceremony for Fg Off Hough, Plt Off Tales, Sgt Burnside and Sgt Lawson today. They gave their lives in defence of our nation, and in dedicating their graves today with their names rightfully in place, we are able finally, to honour that debt that we all owe to them and their loved ones.

Today’s service, held more than eight decades after these men lost their lives, means the crew of Lancaster PD374 will finally be commemorated under their own names rather than as unknown servicemen.

Dr Daniel Seaton, Commemorations Case Officer at the CWGC , said:

I am delighted that, after so many years, the final resting place of these brave airmen has finally been identified. Their family members, of whom so many were here today, can now visit their known graves in perpetuity. The Commission is pleased to have assisted with this process and will continue to maintain their graves with the utmost care and respect.
items.titleZh: 历经数十年之谜终得破解，失事轰炸机机组人员身份得以确认
items.summaryZh: 在荷兰举行的一场仪式上，四名此前身份不明的二战飞行员终于被赋予了姓名，他们的坟墓也由此获得了正式的标识。
zhParas: 1944年12月，一架兰开斯特轰炸机在德国坠毁，导致四名飞行员丧生。经过82年的调查终于揭开了轰炸机司令部在二战期间留下的谜团真相，这四名飞行员的姓名也终于在荷兰举行的一场仪式上被正式公布，得以得到应有的纪念。
今天早些时候，在荷兰的CWGC芬雷战争公墓举行了一场纪念仪式，悼念澳大利亚皇家空军的中尉莱斯利·马克兰德·霍夫、英国皇家空军志愿预备队的飞行员约翰·亨利·泰尔斯，以及同样属于英国皇家空军志愿预备队的亨利·查尔斯·伯恩赛德中士和约翰·劳森中士。由于战后一系列行政失误，这四名军人的遗体数十年间都被标记为“身份不明”，如今终于在仪式上被正式确认身份并得到应有的纪念。
1944年12月8日上午，英国皇家空军第218中队的兰开斯特轰炸机PD374号从诺福克的梅斯沃尔德机场起飞，参与了这支由130多架飞机组成的联军行动，共同目标是袭击位于德国鲁尔区的霍姆贝格地区的尼尔贝克石油厂。在这架兰开斯特轰炸机的七名机组人员中，有三人通过跳伞逃生并成为战俘，而其余四人则不幸遇难。
JCCC案件处理员特蕾西·鲍尔斯表示：
今天，我们向在第二次世界大战期间一同服役并牺牲的英国与澳大利亚飞行员致以敬意。众多家属齐聚于此，让这一时刻更具意义；而看到他们与那些照料这些墓地的当地居民互动的场景，更是令人动容至极。
1917年12月31日，泰尔斯中尉出生于谢菲尔德的阿特克利夫，是家中的11个孩子之一。在1939年9月加入英国皇家空军之前，他一直从事海报设计工作，入伍后则展现出极为出色的服役表现。尽管已经完成了一次完整的作战任务，他仍主动请求重返前线，于1944年8月加入了第218中队。
参加仪式的其他家属中，有泰尔斯中尉的侄子约翰·泰尔斯，他说道：
这真是一个极其令人感动的时刻，能来到这里我们感到无比荣幸，同时也有些不知所措。能够进一步了解我们的约翰叔叔，实在是一件美好的事，我们想感谢所有为促成这一时刻而付出努力的人。
兰开斯特PD374飞机的机长是澳大利亚皇家空军中尉霍夫，他为了给其他机组人员争取逃生机会，始终坚守在正在燃烧的飞机操控舱内。
另一位获追授荣誉的机组人员是伯恩赛德中士和劳森中士。伯恩赛德以专业素养和一丝不苟的仪容著称，而被称为“乔迪”的劳森则出身于达勒姆郡的一个矿工家庭。
与表兄约翰·劳森一同出席仪式的劳森中士的侄子瑟斯顿·劳森表示：
真是美好又令人难以忘怀的一天。能见到这么多人在场，实在令人感动，而且每个人都十分友善，还将各自所属的机构代表得极为出色。
此次重祭仪式由鲁思·黑克牧师（集团上校军衔）主持，她在仪式上表示：
今天能够为霍夫中尉、泰尔斯少尉、伯恩赛德中士以及劳森中士主持这场纪念仪式，我深感荣幸。这四位军人为了保卫我们的国家献出了生命，而通过今日为他们的坟墓刻上姓名，我们终于能够履行对她们以及她们的亲友所欠下的那份责任，向她们致以应有的敬意。
在這些軍人牺牲八十余年之後，今天的紀念儀式終於讓蘭开斯特PD374號飛機的乘員們能夠以真實姓名被銘記，而不再只是作為身份不明的戰士被記載在歷史中。
英国战争纪念公署的纪念事务负责人丹尼尔·西顿博士表示：
我很高兴，经过这么多年的追寻，这些英勇飞行员的长眠之地终于被确定下来。今天在场的许多飞行员家属如今可以永远前往他们已找到位置的墓地祭扫了。该委员会为推动这一进程感到欣慰，并将继续以最谨慎的态度和最高的敬意维护他们的墓地。

items.title: Embraer, Lockheed Martin vie for India’s $10.5B military transport aircraft deal
items.author: Anjana Pasricha
items.summary: The Indian government wants one of its biggest military aviation contracts to deepen the country’s local aerospace industrial base.
items.body:
NEW DELHI — Global aerospace companies Embraer from Brazil and Lockheed Martin from the United States are offering to expand aircraft manufacturing facilities in India as they pursue an approximately $10.5 billion contract for 60 medium transport aircraft for the Indian Air Force.

Embraer’s C-390 Millennium is competing with Lockheed Martin’s C-130J Super Hercules as India seeks to replace its aging military transport fleet that includes the Soviet-era Antonov An-32.

The formal race for one of India’s biggest military aviation contracts set off in August when India issued a Request for Proposal to five Indian companies setting the stage for the bidding. Global aviation companies are partnering with Indian firms because New Delhi has mandated that while the initial multi role aircraft will be delivered ready to fly, the rest must be built domestically.

With India’s focus on building a local aerospace industrial base, Embraer announced on Oct. 1 that the company and its Indian partner, Mahindra Defence, have identified the central Indian city of Nagpur as a production site for the aircraft if they are awarded the contract.

“Identifying Nagpur as a potential location for an assembly facility is an important step in building a robust, long-term aerospace ecosystem in the country,” said Bosco da Costa Junior, president and CEO of Embraer Defense & Security, in a joint statement with Mahindra.

The two companies said they will progressively integrate Indian aerospace companies into the C-390 Millennium ecosystem to deliver manufacturing, training and lifecycle support.

Lockheed Martin already has a presence in India — the Indian Air Force currently operates 12 C-130J Super Hercules aircraft. The company says the aircraft it is now offering, the C-130J-30 in its Block 8.1.2 configuration, will be more advanced than the ones currently with the air force.

If it wins, Lockheed has said that 12 aircraft would be built in the U.S. and 48 in India in partnership with Tata Advanced Systems Limited, with which it has a joint venture.

The American company already has a manufacturing base in India. It makes key components, including the aircraft’s empennage or tail assembly, locally with Tata.

Winning the contract would mean establishing a bigger industrial footprint in India, Dan Tenney, Lockheed Martin’s senior vice president for global business development and strategy, recently told the Press Trust of India.

“We have a long partnership with Tata that produces components and empennages of the C-130J aircraft. It is a very robust capability that will be expanded in our current bid,” he said.

The company has also proposed upgrading the Indian Air Force’s existing fleet of 12 C-130Js.

India has set a requirement of minimum 40% domestic content for the aircraft. Because the country shares long Himalayan borders with rivals Pakistan and China, the aircraft must also be able to operate in high-altitude locations and from temporary or unpaved strips. Besides ferrying troops, vehicles and ammunition, India also uses military transport aircraft for disaster relief and humanitarian assistance.

The bids are due by early December, after which the proposals will go through technical evaluation.

Amid its two decade-long push for greater local production and technology transfer, the government wants the mega aviation contract to deepen the country’s defense manufacturing footprint.
items.titleZh: 巴西航空工业公司与洛克希德·马丁公司竞逐印度105亿美元军用运输机采购合同
items.summaryZh: 新德里——为强化本国的航空航天工业基础，印度政府希望将这笔价值约105亿美元的印度空军60架中型运输机采购合同授予巴西航空工业公司或美国洛克希德·马丁公司中的某一方，同时要求这些企业在印度扩建飞机制造设施。
zhParas: 新德里——来自巴西的巴西航空工业公司与美国洛克希德·马丁公司均在争取那份价值约105亿美元的印度空军60架中型运输机采购合同，同时提出要在印度扩建飞机制造设施。
本段译文为：印度正在寻求更换那些已经老旧的军用运输机队，其中包括苏联时代制造的安-32飞机，而巴西航空工业公司的C-390“千禧”型号正与洛克希德·马丁公司的C-130J“超级大力神”型号展开竞争，争夺这份价值约105亿美元的采购合同。
今年8月，印度向五家本土企业发出了招标请求，正式开启了争夺该国规模最大的军用航空采购合同之一的竞争。由于新德里方面规定，首批多用途军用运输机需直接交付即可投入使用，而其余机型则必须由印度国内企业自行制造，因此全球航空企业纷纷选择与印度公司展开合作。
鉴于印度致力于建立本土航空航天工业体系，巴西航空工业公司已于10月1日宣布，若能中标该合同，该公司将与印度合作伙伴马欣德拉国防公司共同选择印度中部城市那格浦尔作为该军用运输机的生产基地。
巴西航空工业公司国防与安全业务板块的总裁兼首席执行官博斯科·达科斯塔·朱尼尔在与马欣德拉公司的联合声明中表示：“将那格浦尔定为军用运输机组装厂的候选地点，是印度构建强大、可持续的航空航天产业生态体系的重要一步。
这两家公司表示，他们将逐步将印度航空航天企业纳入C-390 Millennium产品体系，为其提供制造、培训以及全生命周期支持服务。
洛克希德·马丁公司已在印度设有业务布局——印度空军目前运营着12架C-130J“超级大力神”运输机。该公司表示，其此次推出的C-130J-30型号属于8.1.2版本，其性能将优于印度空军现有的那些飞机。
若中标，洛克希德·马丁公司表示将在美国生产12架该型军用运输机，同时与旗下合资企业塔塔先进系统有限公司合作在印度生产48架。
这家美国公司已在印度建立了制造基地，其与塔塔公司合作在当地生产该军用运输机的关键部件，包括尾翼组件等。
洛克希德·马丁公司全球业务发展与战略高级副总裁丹·特尼最近向《印度新闻信托报》表示，若能赢得这笔价值105亿美元的军用运输机订单，该公司便能在印度建立更庞大的产业布局。
他与塔塔公司有着长期的合作伙伴关系，后者负责为C-130J飞机生产各类零部件及尾翼结构。他称，这一强大的生产能力将在我们此次的投标中得到进一步发挥。
该企业还提议对印度空军现有的12架C-130J运输机进行升级。
印度为该军用运输机设定了至少40%的国产部件比例要求。由于该国与竞争对手巴基斯坦和中国有着漫长的喜马拉雅山脉边界，这类飞机还必须能够在高海拔地区以及临时或未铺设跑道的简易机场起降。除了用于运送部队、车辆和弹药外，印度还会利用军用运输机执行救灾与人道主义援助任务。
投标截止日期为12月初，此后相关提案将接受技术评估。
在长达二十年的推动本土化生产与技术转移的努力背景下，印度政府希望借此巨额军用航空采购合同进一步壮大本国的国防制造业实力。
items.zhFull:
新德里——来自巴西的巴西航空工业公司与美国洛克希德·马丁公司均在争取那份价值约105亿美元的印度空军60架中型运输机采购合同，同时提出要在印度扩建飞机制造设施。

本段译文为：印度正在寻求更换那些已经老旧的军用运输机队，其中包括苏联时代制造的安-32飞机，而巴西航空工业公司的C-390“千禧”型号正与洛克希德·马丁公司的C-130J“超级大力神”型号展开竞争，争夺这份价值约105亿美元的采购合同。

今年8月，印度向五家本土企业发出了招标请求，正式开启了争夺该国规模最大的军用航空采购合同之一的竞争。由于新德里方面规定，首批多用途军用运输机需直接交付即可投入使用，而其余机型则必须由印度国内企业自行制造，因此全球航空企业纷纷选择与印度公司展开合作。

鉴于印度致力于建立本土航空航天工业体系，巴西航空工业公司已于10月1日宣布，若能中标该合同，该公司将与印度合作伙伴马欣德拉国防公司共同选择印度中部城市那格浦尔作为该军用运输机的生产基地。

巴西航空工业公司国防与安全业务板块的总裁兼首席执行官博斯科·达科斯塔·朱尼尔在与马欣德拉公司的联合声明中表示：“将那格浦尔定为军用运输机组装厂的候选地点，是印度构建强大、可持续的航空航天产业生态体系的重要一步。

这两家公司表示，他们将逐步将印度航空航天企业纳入C-390 Millennium产品体系，为其提供制造、培训以及全生命周期支持服务。

洛克希德·马丁公司已在印度设有业务布局——印度空军目前运营着12架C-130J“超级大力神”运输机。该公司表示，其此次推出的C-130J-30型号属于8.1.2版本，其性能将优于印度空军现有的那些飞机。

若中标，洛克希德·马丁公司表示将在美国生产12架该型军用运输机，同时与旗下合资企业塔塔先进系统有限公司合作在印度生产48架。

这家美国公司已在印度建立了制造基地，其与塔塔公司合作在当地生产该军用运输机的关键部件，包括尾翼组件等。

洛克希德·马丁公司全球业务发展与战略高级副总裁丹·特尼最近向《印度新闻信托报》表示，若能赢得这笔价值105亿美元的军用运输机订单，该公司便能在印度建立更庞大的产业布局。

他与塔塔公司有着长期的合作伙伴关系，后者负责为C-130J飞机生产各类零部件及尾翼结构。他称，这一强大的生产能力将在我们此次的投标中得到进一步发挥。

该企业还提议对印度空军现有的12架C-130J运输机进行升级。

印度为该军用运输机设定了至少40%的国产部件比例要求。由于该国与竞争对手巴基斯坦和中国有着漫长的喜马拉雅山脉边界，这类飞机还必须能够在高海拔地区以及临时或未铺设跑道的简易机场起降。除了用于运送部队、车辆和弹药外，印度还会利用军用运输机执行救灾与人道主义援助任务。

投标截止日期为12月初，此后相关提案将接受技术评估。

在长达二十年的推动本土化生产与技术转移的努力背景下，印度政府希望借此巨额军用航空采购合同进一步壮大本国的国防制造业实力。

items.title: Grave of Cornish soldier missing since 1945 identified in Germany
items.summary: A rededication service for Private (Pte) Sidney Allen was organised by the MOD’s ‘War Detectives’ at CWGC Reichswald Forest War Cemetery, Germany.
items.body:
The previously unnamed grave of a World War 2 soldier from Saltash, Cornwall, who served with the Hampshire Regiment been identified and rededicated in his name 81 years after his death.

The service for Pte Sidney Allen was organised by the MOD ’s ‘War Detectives’ at CWGC Reichswald Forest War Cemetery, Germany.

JCCC Caseworker, Nicola Nash, said:

It is a great privilege to be here to honour Pte Sidney Allen, who gave his life in service to his country at just 19 years of age. For more than 80 years his family did not know exactly where he lay, making this identification especially significant. Today we remember his sacrifice and ensure that his name, service and story are never forgotten.

Private Allen grew up in Saltash working in HM Dockyard alongside his father. He enlisted in the Army in February 1944 and arrived in France that August, joining the 7th Battalion, Hampshire Regiment, during the Allied advance through Normandy.

Over the following months he took part in several operations including the capture of Mont Picon and St-Denis-de-Mere, the advance across the River Seine, the liberation of Brussels, Operation Market Garden, and fighting in the Netherlands and Germany.

In February 1945, the battalion joined Operation Veritable, the offensive to clear the Reichswald Forest, where soldiers faced fierce resistance, deep mud and flooded terrain. On 15 February 1945, during heavy fighting near Cleve and the Reichswald, Sidney was killed aged 19 and officially recorded as missing.

Decades later, research submitted by a member of the public established that he had originally been buried in Materborn alongside other soldiers killed in the same action. As the only member of the battalion from that engagement still listed as missing, the grave was finally identified as belonging to Private Sidney Allen.

The headstone was replaced by Commonwealth War Graves Commission ( CWGC ).

Fergus Read, Commemorations Case Officer at the CWGC , said:

It is deeply fitting that Private Sidney Allen is now commemorated by name at his final resting place. The evidence for the grave identification was compelling, and Private Allen, who was previously commemorated on a memorial, now has a known grave, which the Commission will care for in perpetuity.
items.titleZh: 1945年以来失踪的康沃尔郡士兵墓地在德国被确认身份
items.summaryZh: 在德国的莱希斯瓦尔德森林战争公墓，英国国防部旗下的“战争侦探”团队为西德尼·艾伦二等兵举办了重新献祭仪式，以纪念这位来自康沃尔郡萨尔塔什、曾服役于汉普郡团的二战士兵。
zhParas: 在这名来自康沃尔郡萨尔塔什、曾服役于汉普郡团的二战士兵去世81年后，其此前未被标注姓名的坟墓终于被确认身份，英国国防部旗下的“战争侦探”团队在德国的莱希斯瓦尔德森林战争公墓为他举行了重新献祭仪式。
在德国的莱希斯瓦尔德森林战争公墓，英国国防部旗下的“战争侦探”团队为西德尼·艾伦二等兵举办了重新献祭仪式。
JCCC的个案处理员尼古拉·纳什表示：
能够在此缅怀19岁便为祖国献出生命的西德尼·艾伦下士，我们深感荣幸。在80多年的时间里，他的家人一直不知道他的安葬地点，因此此次找到他的墓地具有格外重要的意义。今天，我们缅怀他的牺牲，确保他的名字、他的奉献以及他的故事永远不会被遗忘。
艾伦下士在萨尔塔什长大，与父亲一起在皇家造船厂工作。1944年2月他应征入伍，同年8月抵达法国，在盟军穿越诺曼底时加入了汉普郡团的第七营。
在之后的几个月里，他参与了多场作战行动，包括夺取蒙皮康和圣德尼德梅尔、渡过塞纳河推进、解放布鲁塞尔、市场花园行动，以及在荷兰和德国的战斗。
1945年2月，该营参与了旨在清除赖希斯瓦尔德森林的“真诚行动”，在作战中士兵们遭遇了顽强的抵抗，同时还面临泥泞不堪及被水淹没的恶劣地形。1945年2月15日，在克莱夫附近及赖希斯瓦尔德森林一带的激烈战斗中，19岁的西德尼阵亡，官方记录将其列为失踪人员。
数十年后，一位民众提交的研究成果证实，西德尼·艾伦最初是与在同次作战中阵亡的其他士兵一同被安葬在马特博恩。由于他是那次战斗中该营中唯一仍被列为失踪人员的士兵，其墓地最终被确认为西德尼·艾伦下士的安葬地。
该墓碑已由英联邦战争墓地委员会更换。
位于德国的帝国森林战争墓地的英联邦战争墓地委员会纪念事务负责人弗格斯·里德表示：
如今，西德尼·艾伦列兵的最终安息之地终于有了刻有他名字的纪念标识，这实在是一件无比恰当的事。用于确认其墓地身份的证据十分确凿，此前仅以纪念牌形式被纪念的艾伦列兵如今终于有了确切的墓址，而英联邦战争墓地委员会也将永久负责维护这座墓地。

items.title: 'Unknown' Sheffield soldier named in Netherlands Ceremony
items.summary: The previously un-named grave of a World War 2 soldier has been identified and rededicated in his name in a service 81 years after his death.
items.body:
A soldier in an unmarked grave has been identified as Sheffield-born LCpl Ronald Smirthwaite who was killed in the Netherlands in 1945.

For years LCpl Smirthwaite was commemorated on the Groesbeek Memorial as one of those World War 2 dead missing with no known grave.

Now, following extensive research, MOD investigators have now confirmed that the grave in Jonkerbos War Cemetery can now be marked with his name.

A rededication service for LCpl Smirthwaite was organised by the MOD ’s Joint Casualty and Compassionate Centre’s ( JCCC ) ‘War Detectives’.

JCCC Caseworker, Tracey Bowers, said:

“Ronald Smirthwaite was a proud Yorkshireman whose life was cut short during the final months of the World War 2. This rededication service restores his identity, recognises his Yorkshire roots and ensures that future generations understand his ultimate sacrifice.”

Ronald joined the Army on 4 May 1944, initially into the General Service Corps employed as a blacksmith’s striker, an occupation described as providing the muscle to the blacksmith’s skilled work.

Padre Paul Garnell who conducted the service said:

LCpl Ronald Smirthwaite after many years of being an “unknown soldier” is now known and will forever be memorialised and remembered along with his colleagues. This has only been possible due to the hard work and dedication by many.

The investigation was examined by the MOD and The National Army Museum following submissions by an Officer of the Royal Netherlands Army and a member of the public.

Records from the Hallamshire Battalion describe a fierce engagement on 22 February 1945 after which LCpl Smirthwaite was reported missing and presumed killed in action. It later emerged that he had been captured alive but seriously wounded and was lost while attempting to escape. His body had been recovered and buried before being reburied as an unknown soldier.

His headstone was replaced by one engraved with his name by the Commonwealth War Graves Commission ( CWGC ).

Polly Brewster, Commemorations Case Officer at the CWGC , said:

We are honoured to have worked with the Royal Netherlands Army, the Ministry of Defence and the National Army Museum to identify Ronald Smirthwaite’s final resting place. Eighty-one years after he fell, and after decades of uncertainty for his family and loved ones, it feels deeply poignant to be able to commemorate him at the site of his grave with a new, named headstone. His sacrifice will not be forgotten.
items.titleZh: 荷兰举行的纪念仪式上，那名身份不明的谢菲尔德士兵终于获知其身份
items.summaryZh: 在那名二战士兵逝世81年后，人们终于确认了那座此前没有标识的坟墓的主人的身份——他便是出生于谢菲尔德的罗纳德·斯米尔思韦特下士，他于1945年在荷兰阵亡，如今人们已为这座坟墓正式命名并举行了纪念仪式。
zhParas: 那座无标识坟墓中的士兵已被确认为出生于谢菲尔德的罗纳德·斯米尔思韦特下士，他于1945年在荷兰阵亡。
多年来，斯米尔思韦特下士一直作为那些在第二次世界大战中阵亡但无确切墓地的失踪士兵之一，被安葬在赫罗斯贝克纪念碑上接受纪念。
经过深入调查，英国国防部调查人员现已确认，琼克博斯战争公墓中的那座墓碑可以刻上这名士兵的名字。
英国国防部下属的联合伤员与抚恤中心“战争侦探”小组为斯米尔思韦特下士举办了重新命名仪式。
JCCC的个案处理员特蕾西·鲍尔斯表示：
罗纳德·斯米思韦特是一位来自约克郡的骄傲的英国人，他在第二次世界大战的最后几个月里英年早逝。此次重新为他的坟墓举行仪式，不仅明确了他的身份，也彰显了他来自约克郡的根源，同时能让后代了解他为战争做出的巨大牺牲。
罗纳德于1944年5月4日加入陆军，最初被分配到总务兵团，担任铁匠帮工，这一工作被视为为铁匠的精湛技艺提供体力支撑。
主持此次仪式的保罗·加内尔神父表示：
多年来一直被列为“无名士兵”的罗纳德·斯米尔思韦特下士如今终于有了身份，他将与战友们一同被永久铭记在历史中。这一成果的取得，离不开众多人的辛勤努力与奉献。
在荷兰皇家陆军一名军官及一名普通民众的举报之后，英国国防部与国家陆军博物馆对这起事件展开了调查。
根据哈勒姆郡营的记录，1945年2月22日曾发生过一场激烈的战斗，战后有消息称斯米尔思韦特下士失踪，据推测已阵亡。后来人们发现他其实被俘虏了，虽然伤势严重，但在试图逃脱时走失。他的遗体虽曾被找回并安葬，却又作为无名士兵被重新安葬。
英联邦战争墓地委员会已用刻有其姓名的新墓碑替换了那块旧墓碑。
CWGC的纪念事务负责人波莉·布鲁斯特表示：
我们很荣幸能与荷兰皇家陆军、荷兰国防部以及国家陆军博物馆通力合作，最终找到了罗纳德·斯密思韦特的安葬地。在他牺牲81年后，也在他的家人和亲友历经数十年迷茫之后，如今能够在他的墓前立起刻有其姓名的新墓碑来纪念他，实在令人感慨万千。他的牺牲必将永被铭记。

items.title: Research Priorities for Robust Climate Assessments in the United States
items.author: Benjamin Lee Preston
items.summary: This research priorities roadmap aims to catalyze collaborations, research, and a network of climate assessments to synthesize the state of climate impacts and to provide accessible information for climate action plans and decisions in the U.S.
items.body:
Expert InsightsPosted on rand.org Oct 7, 2026Published in: Earth's Future, Volume 14, Issue 9, e2025EF007336 (September 2026). DOI: 10.1029/2025EF007336

Scientific assessments play a critical role in synthesizing evidence to support evidence-based decision-making in many sectors and topics. For climate change, large-scale assessments like the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) and the United States (U.S.) National Climate Assessment (NCA) reports help many different users—from national government to local governments, Indigenous Peoples and communities, the private sector, the social sector, and the scientific community itself—navigate the complex field of climate risks, impacts, and integrated solutions. While co-creation with users is essential to developing actionable assessments, this paper lays the groundwork for future processes by identifying many advancing and emerging areas of relevant knowledge ready for assessment or additional near-term research. Drawing on the expertise of many scholars who were formerly tasked with producing the Sixth NCA and authors of other national or sub-national climate assessment reports, this paper highlights select U.S.-relevant topics in which research advances since the 2023 Fifth NCA make new syntheses particularly valuable for future national, sub-national, and sectoral climate assessments. It also identifies critical research topics in those select areas that would be useful for future climate assessment efforts. Overall, this research priorities roadmap aims to catalyze collaborations, research, and a network of climate assessments to synthesize the state of climate impacts, risks, and responses and to provide widely accessible and foundational information for sectoral, regional, and cross-cutting climate action plans and decisions in the U.S.

items.titleZh: 美国强化气候评估的研究优先事项
items.summaryZh: 根据rand.org在2026年10月7日发布的专家观点文章，该文刊登于《地球的未来》2026年9月刊的第14卷第9期，文章编号为e2025EF007336，DOI编码为10.1029/2025EF007336。这份研究优先事项路线图旨在推动各方开展合作与研究，构建气候评估网络，从而全面了解气候变化的影响状况，为美国制定相关气候行动计划及决策提供便捷的信息支持。
zhParas: 据rand.org于2026年10月7日发布的专家观点文章显示，该文发表于《地球的未来》2026年9月刊的第14卷第9期，文章编号为e2025EF007336，DOI编码为10.1029/2025EF007336。

在诸多领域与议题中，科学评估都是为基于证据的决策提供支撑的关键手段。在气候变化领域，诸如政府间气候变化专门委员会发布的报告以及美国国家气候评估报告这类大规模评估成果，能够帮助从国家政府到地方政府、原住民群体、私营部门、社会团体乃至科学界在内的各类用户，更好地理解复杂的气候风险、影响及综合应对方案。尽管与各类用户共同参与评估制定工作至关重要，但本文通过梳理那些亟待开展评估或需要进一步短期研究的新兴研究领域，为未来的相关工作奠定基础。借助那些曾参与编写第五次美国国家气候评估报告及其他国家或次国家级气候评估报告的专家们的专业见解，本文重点指出了自2023年第五次评估报告发布以来，在某些与美国相关的领域中，研究进展为未来各层级及行业的气候评估提供了极具价值的新的分析视角，同时也明确了这些领域中对于后续气候评估工作而言至关重要的研究课题。总体而言，这份研究优先级规划旨在推动相关合作与研究工作，构建气候评估网络，从而全面梳理气候影响、风险及应对措施的状况，为美国各行业、各地区以及跨领域的气候行动规划与决策提供通俗易懂且具有基础性意义的信息。

items.title: It’s official: US Army’s improved M8 rifle to begin fielding in December
items.author: Hope Hodge Seck
items.summary: The U.S. Army will begin fielding Sig Sauer’s M8 rifle in December, replacing the M7 with a lighter, shorter carbine based on soldier feedback.
items.body:
NEWINGTON, N.H. – On the factory floor at gun maker Sig Sauer’s headquarters, giant shipping pallets of the brand-new M8 Next Generation Squad Weapon rifle sit shrink-wrapped on shelves, ready for dispatch to soldiers.

Fielding of the M8 carbine, which appears set to replace Sig Sauer’s M7 as the Army’s standard rifle less than three years after the M7’s initial fielding began, will begin in December with some units at Fort Bragg, North Carolina, company executives confirmed to Military Times Monday.

The NGSW new weapons rollout also includes Sig’s M250 machine gun, which will replace the aging M249 Squad Automatic Weapon and is expected to reach troops in the first half of next year, said Dave Buehler, the company’s vice president of manufacturing.

Both weapons share an ammunition caliber: the 6.8×51mm Common Cartridge developed by Sig Sauer with a hybrid design intended to withstand high chamber pressure.

The M7 stumbled out of the gate, generating complaints from soldiers about its unwieldy weight and length and undue wear they said the high-pressure rounds were putting on components, including barrels and suppressors.

While Sig Sauer pushed back at the time on a number of the most strident complaints, the company is now casting the transition from the M7 to the M8, also previously called the XM8, as a success story that highlights its ability to act quickly on soldier inputs.

“From our perspective [the M8 is] a far superior rifle to the M7,” Buehler said. “On the M7, our hands were kind of tied [with what] the design criteria or characteristics of the contract required – even if we didn’t like them, we had to meet them. So now, the M8 considers our feedback, the soldiers’ feedback. And we can’t wait to get it out there.”

The new rifle is more than a pound lighter than the M7 and sports a barrel that’s 3.5 inches shorter. It replaces a less-popular folding stock with a fixed stock and includes feedback-based adjustments like added rigidity for the handguard. For soldiers who previously received the M7 rifle, the M8 should be a smooth transition, said Josh Shoemaker, Sig Sauer’s product manager for defense.

“The fundamentals are all the same, really,” Shoemaker told Military Times in an interview. “If guys that have had the M7 already are pretty familiar with that, the M8 will be a well-received transition.”

The foremost design challenge, he said, was achieving weight reduction from the M7, which weighed more than eight pounds unloaded, and nearly 10 pounds with the included suppressor – a radical difference from the legacy M4A1 carbine, which weighs 6.34 pounds unloaded.

Shoemaker said Sig Sauer had reduced the weight difference between the M4 and M8 to a little less than a pound, though that doesn’t include the M8’s suppressor.

“We worked really hard to reduce weight where we could and where it matters. So there’s lots of lightening cuts around the receiver. We pulled some weight out of the barrel, but we’re very careful to do that, because a lot of times when you pull weight out of the barrel, you have risks of some performance decreasing, whether that be barrel life or cook-off,” Shoemaker said. “We’re very sensitive to that, so it’s a long process to be able to figure out where your left and right limit is and how much weight [you can] kind of pull off of that before it’s too much.”

Reducing barrel size and thus altering the weapon’s center of gravity helped in that effort, Shoemaker said.

“When you pick up that M8, the balance of it feels a lot better, with that suppressor being on a shorter weapon system,” he added.

As for the M7, budget documents released earlier this year show the Army is curtailing its procurement, with none additional requested for Fiscal Year 2027 and about 50,000 previously delivered to the force.

The Army hasn’t said what it plans to do with the M7s already in inventory, particularly if it opts to put M8s in the hands of all troops who previously got the M7.

Shoemaker said there were “tons of options” for the Army with regard to M7s, including sending the weapons to basic training units or reassigning them to Guard or Reserve units.

But there’s another option, he said: the Army could ask for conversion kits to turn all the M7s already in its inventory into M8 carbines.

“The barrel is two screws that come out, and the hand guard is two more screws … the lower-end serialized item is the same,” he said. “All in, you could probably convert [an M7 to an M8] in under five minutes.”

If that’s an option Army leaders are considering, they have yet to address it publicly.

“There’re lots of options that the Army is well aware of,” Shoemaker said, “and making decisions on what direction they’ll go with that.”
items.titleZh: 官方确认：美军改进型M8步枪将于12月开始部署部队
items.summaryZh: 新罕布什尔州纽因顿——在西格绍尔枪械公司总部的生产车间里，成摞的崭新M8下一代班组武器步枪被密封包装后整齐地摆放在货架上，随时待发至前线士兵手中。根据士兵们的反馈，美国陆军将于12月开始在部队中部署这款基于更轻便、更短枪身的设计而制成的M8步枪，以取代现有的M7步枪。
zhParas: 新罕布什尔州纽因顿——在西格绍尔枪械公司总部的生产车间里，成摞的崭新M8下一代班组武器步枪被密封包装后整齐地摆放在货架上，随时待发至前线士兵手中。
据《军事时报》周一从该公司高管处获得的消息，M8卡宾枪将于12月开始在部队中部署，它将取代西格绍尔公司的M7成为陆军的标准步枪。在M7首次投入部队使用还不到三年的时间里，这一更换工作即将在北卡罗来纳州布拉格堡的某些部队率先展开。
据该公司的制造业务副总裁戴夫·布勒透露，NGSW新武器系列的部署还包括西格绍尔公司的M250机枪，这款机枪将取代已使用多年的M249班用自动武器，预计将于明年上半年投入部队使用。
这两种武器均采用相同的弹药口径——由西格绍尔公司研发的6.8×51毫米通用弹药，该弹药采用混合设计，旨在承受较高的枪膛压力。
M7步枪从投入使用之初就问题不断，士兵们对其过重的重量和过长的长度表示不满，同时还指出高压力弹药会对枪管、消音器等部件造成过度磨损。
尽管西格绍尔公司当时对一些较为激烈的投诉予以了反驳，但现在它仍将M7步枪向M8步枪的过渡视为一个成功案例，这一过渡此前也被称作XM8型号；该公司借此彰显自己能够迅速响应士兵们的反馈意见。
布勒表示：“从我们的角度来看，M8这款步枪远比M7更出色。在研发M7时，由于合同规定的设计标准与限制，我们几乎无法做出改变——即便那些标准我们并不认同，也必须遵守。而M8则充分考虑了我们的意见，尤其是士兵们的反馈。我们已经迫不及待地希望将它部署到前线使用了。
这款新步枪的重量比M7轻了一磅多，枪管长度也短了3.5英寸。它用固定式枪托取代了原本不太受欢迎的折叠式枪托，同时还根据士兵们的反馈进行了改进，比如增强了护手部分的刚性。西格绍尔公司的国防产品经理乔什·舒梅克表示，对于那些此前使用过M7步枪的士兵来说，过渡使用M8应该会十分顺畅。
实际上，它的基本结构并没有什么变化，”舒梅克在接受《军事时报》采访时说道，“那些已经使用过M7的士兵对它已经相当熟悉，因此M8将会是种容易被他们接受的过渡性武器。
他说，最主要的设计挑战在于减轻重量——原版M7在未装配件时的重量就超过8磅，若再安装消音器则接近10磅，这一重量与已有的M4A1卡宾枪相比有着巨大差异，因为后者在未装配件时的重量仅为6.34磅。
舒梅克表示，西格绍尔公司已将M4与M8之间的重量差异缩小到不到1磅，不过这一数据尚未计入M8所配备的消音器重量。
舒梅克表示，他们竭尽全力在关键部位减轻重量，因此枪托周边进行了大量减重处理。他们也尝试从枪管上削减重量，但对此极为谨慎，因为通常削减枪管重量可能会影响其性能，比如降低使用寿命或引发射击不稳定问题。他们对这些风险十分敏感，因此需要经过漫长测试才能确定减重的极限，以及能在不损害性能的前提下削减多少重量。
舒梅克表示，通过缩小枪管尺寸从而改变武器的重心，也为实现减重目标提供了帮助。
他补充称，使用配备较短枪管的M8步枪时，其重心分布明显更加理想，再加上消音器的安装，进一步助力实现了减重目标。
根据今年早些时候公布的预算文件显示，美国陆军正在缩减M7步枪的采购规模，2027财年不再申请新增采购计划，目前该部队已接收的M7步枪数量约为5万支。
美国陆军尚未透露对于现有库存的M7步枪将如何处理，尤其没有说明是否打算将M8步枪配发给那些此前使用M7步枪的士兵。
舒梅克表示，对于现有的M7步枪，美国陆军有“众多处理方案”，包括将其送往新兵训练部队，或是重新分配给国民自卫队或预备役部队。
他同时指出还有另一种方案：美国陆军可以申请转换套件，将现有库存的所有M7步枪改装成M8卡宾枪。
枪管部分只需拧下两个螺丝，护木部分也需要拧下两个螺丝……下端的序列编号部分则保持不变，”他说道，“总的来说，把M7步枪改装成M8步枪大概用不到五分钟。
尽管军方领导层正在考虑是否采用这一方案，但目前尚未就此公开表态。
军方已经了解诸多可选方案，”舒梅克表示，“目前正在决策将采取何种方向来推进相关改进。

items.title: Pentagon names 4 directed-energy weapons for counter-drone program at US bases
items.author: Michael Scanlon
items.summary: The Pentagon named four directed energy weapons for a homeland counter-drone program, the first systems to be fielded and tested at U.S. bases.
items.body:
The Pentagon on Monday named four directed-energy weapons for a homeland counter-drone pilot, the first systems the military will field and test at U.S. bases under a program ordered by Congress.

The four systems selected are AeroVironment’s Palletized High-Energy Laser, Epirus’ Leonidas high-powered microwave, Kord’s Firefly high-energy laser and Boeing’s Compact Laser Weapon System, the Defense Department said in a release.

The pilot is run by Joint Interagency Task Force 401, or JIATF-401, the Army-led organization set up last year to coordinate counter-drone work across the military and other federal agencies.

“High-energy lasers and high-powered microwave systems are tools that can be effectively used in a layered drone defense,” Army Brig. Gen. Matt Ross, the task force director, said in the release. “This pilot program will test these capabilities in an operational environment so we can understand how best to integrate and sustain them to defend the homeland.”

The department said the pilot will gather real-time data on how the systems perform, what they cost and what it takes to operate and maintain them.

Ross said in August the pilot will run for a year, with service members operating and maintaining the weapons at the bases. The task force is coordinating the pilot with the services, U.S. Northern Command and the Federal Aviation Administration, or FAA.

In May, JIATF-401 selected five sites for the pilot: Fort Huachuca, Arizona, and Fort Bliss, Texas, both tied to the southern border mission; Naval Base Kitsap, Washington; Grand Forks Air Force Base, North Dakota; and Whiteman Air Force Base, Missouri.

Officials said at the time that deployment plans would be worked out with installation commanders over 180 days, with operations expected later this year. Monday’s release does not say which system will go to which installation, how many of each will be fielded or what the systems and the pilot as a whole will cost.

Cost is the main selling point for lasers and microwaves, and one of the things the pilot is meant to test. Firing one costs a fraction of the price of a missile or even a gun round, and neither leaves unexploded ordnance on the ground.

Ross told reporters in August he was skeptical of per-shot math alone. “If I procure that system and it costs me $6 million and I take one shot a year, you can’t tell me that that shot only costs 8 cents,” he said.

Beyond cost, lasers and microwaves address different threats. A high-energy laser dwells on one drone at a time until it burns through. A high-powered microwave can thwart a swarm of drones in a single burst by overwhelming their electronics, though its wider footprint raises concern about effects on nearby systems.

Among the lasers, AeroVironment’s system is the company’s LOCUST laser in a roll-on, roll-off configuration, meaning it is packed onto a self-contained pallet that can be moved by truck or ship and set up wherever needed.

The company said in April that a palletized LOCUST tracked and defeated target drones aboard the aircraft carrier George H.W. Bush in an October 2025 live fire with the Navy and the Army’s rapid weapons development office.

In September, the Army awarded AeroVironment a $464.8 million deal to produce its 30-kilowatt LOCUST X3 under the Enduring-High Energy Laser program, which the company called the first production contract for a U.S. directed-energy weapon. The Pentagon release does not say whether the pilot systems are drawn from that buy.

Boeing’s Compact Laser Weapon System, or CLWS, is a lower-power laser. Lower power generally means a laser must remain on a target longer to destroy it, but the system itself can be smaller and easier to move.

Boeing said in 2024 that a 5-kilowatt CLWS defeated Group 3 drones, which can weigh up to about 1,320 pounds, at the Red Sands counter-drone exercise in Saudi Arabia, using targeting data from the Army’s Forward Area Air Defense network. At the time, the company said the system had defeated nearly 500 drones in testing and demonstrations at ranges from about 200 meters to 2.5 kilometers.

Boeing also said CLWS units had returned from a multiyear overseas deployment with the Marine Corps but did not say whether they engaged hostile drones.

Kord, a KBR subsidiary, markets Firefly as a palletized, mobile laser scalable from 5 to 40 kilowatts. Company officials told reporters at an August demonstration near Guntersville Dam in north Alabama that a truck-mounted version typically needs a few seconds on target to down a small drone.

Leonidas is the only microwave counter-drone system in the pilot. Built by Epirus, it is the basis for the Army’s prototype high-power microwave for defending troops and sites against drone swarms, part of the Indirect Fire Protection Capability program.

The Army awarded the company $66.1 million in December 2022 for four prototypes and another $43.5 million in July 2025 for a second-generation version.

Epirus said in September 2025 that a Leonidas disabled all 61 target drones across five scenarios at Camp Atterbury, Indiana, including a 49-drone swarm in one burst.

The pilot follows a rough start for lasers in domestic airspace. In February, the FAA briefly closed the airspace over El Paso, Texas, after a counter-drone laser was used near Fort Bliss without coordinating with the FAA, the Associated Press reported at the time.

To address safety concerns, defense and FAA officials held a live-fire demonstration in March at White Sands Missile Range, New Mexico. AeroVironment later said the system tested was its LOCUST laser, the same family as the palletized system named in Monday’s pilot announcement.

On April 10, the FAA said a safety review found that the laser systems tested, with proper safety controls in place, “do not pose undue risk to passenger aircraft.”

The department said it will continue evaluating other directed-energy technology and will host a shoot-off in December at Dugway Proving Ground, Utah, for additional laser and microwave systems.

Ross, the task force director, said in August the shoot-off is being set up so systems that perform well “can immediately result in a purchase order that allows us to start building the production lines to get these systems into the field.”

The pilot is one piece of a greater, ongoing effort. On Sept. 29, the Army announced that JIATF-401 had awarded 10 contracts worth up to $4.15 billion combined for sensors, optical sights and gun-based systems to support Domestic Shield, the push to protect priority Defense Department sites within the United States.

Michael Scanlon is a defense journalist covering air and space warfare. A former U.S. Air Force A-10 crew chief, he has supported land and sea programs for the U.S. Army, Navy, Marine Corps and Coast Guard.
items.titleZh: 五角大楼为美国基地的反无人机项目选定四种定向能武器
items.summaryZh: 周一，五角大楼为国内反无人机试点项目指定了四种定向能武器，这些武器是军方根据国会授权开展的计划中首批将在美国基地投入部署并接受测试的系统。
zhParas: 周一，五角大楼为国内反无人机试点项目指定了四种定向能武器，这些武器是军方根据国会授权开展的计划中首批将在美国基地投入部署并接受测试的系统。
国防部在一份声明中表示，此次被选中的四款武器分别为AeroVironment公司的托盘式高能激光武器、Epirus公司的莱奥尼达斯高功率微波武器、Kord公司的萤火虫高能激光武器，以及波音公司的紧凑型激光武器系统。这些武器将是首批在美国基地投入部署并接受测试的定向能武器，用于执行国内反无人机任务。
该反无人机项目由第401联合跨部门特遣队负责实施，该特遣队是由陆军牵头、于去年成立的机构，旨在协调军方及其他联邦机构之间的反无人机行动。
据任务组负责人、陆军准将马特·罗斯在相关声明中表示，高能激光与高功率微波系统是可用于构建多层无人机防御体系的有效武器。他称：“这一试点项目将在实际作战环境中测试这些武器的技术性能，以便我们找出最佳整合与运用方式，从而有效保护祖国领土安全。
五角大楼表示，该试点项目将收集有关这些武器系统性能、成本以及运营维护所需费用的实时数据。
罗斯在8月表示，该试点项目将持续一年，由驻扎在基地的军人负责这些武器的操作与维护。该特别工作组正在协调各军种、美军北方司令部以及美国联邦航空管理局，共同推进这项试点工作。
5月，JIATF-401为该试点项目选定了5个地点：负责南部边境任务的亚利桑那州华楚卡堡和德克萨斯州布利斯堡；华盛顿州的基萨普海军基地；北达科他州的格兰德福克斯空军基地；以及密苏里州的惠特曼空军基地。
有关官员表示，部署计划将在180天内与各驻地指挥官共同制定，预计将于今年晚些时候开始投入使用。此次公布的消息并未说明具体哪种武器系统将部署在哪些驻地，每种系统的数量是多少，也未提及这些系统及整个试点项目的总成本。
激光武器与微波武器的主要优势就在于成本较低，这也是测试人员需要评估的要点之一。发射这两种武器的费用仅为导弹甚至普通子弹的一小部分，而且它们不会在地面留下未爆弹药。
罗斯在8月对记者表示，他并不认同仅通过单次发射成本来计算武器效能的做法。他说：‘如果我购买了某款成本为600万美元的武器，且每年只发射一次，那可不能告诉我这次发射的成本仅为8美分。’
除了成本因素外，激光武器与微波武器针对的威胁类型也有所不同。高能激光会一次专注攻击一架无人机，直至将其烧毁；而高功率微波则可通过一次发射就干扰大量无人机的电子系统，从而使其失效，不过其较大的作用范围引发了人们对其可能对周边设备造成影响的担忧。
在各类激光武器中，AeroVironment公司所研发的型号为LOCUST激光系统，该系统采用滚装式设计，可被装入专用托盘后通过卡车或船舶运输，再运送到所需地点进行部署。
该公司在4月表示，其研发的LOCUST激光系统已通过托盘化包装，曾在2025年10月与海军及陆军快速武器研发办公室共同进行的实弹测试中，在“乔治·H·W·布什”号航母上成功追踪并击落了目标无人机。
9月，美国陆军通过“持久高能激光”计划向AeroVironment公司下达了价值4.648亿美元的订单，要求其生产功率为30千瓦的LOCUST X3激光系统，该公司称这是美国首份针对定向能武器的量产合同。五角大楼的通报并未说明这些试验型系统是否源自该采购项目。
波音公司的紧凑型激光武器系统，即CLWS，属于低功率激光武器。由于功率较低，这类激光武器通常需要更长时间持续照射目标才能将其摧毁，但自身的体积更小，移动也更为方便。
波音公司曾在2024年表示，其功率为5千瓦的CLWS激光武器在沙特阿拉伯举行的红沙反无人机演习中，借助陆军前沿区域防空网络提供的目标数据，成功击落了重量最高可达约1320磅的3类无人机。该公司称，该系统在距离目标200米至2.5公里的范围内进行的测试与演示中，已击落了近500架无人机。
波音公司还表示，那些用于海军陆战队任务的CLWS激光武器装置已从多年的海外部署中返回，但并未透露这些武器是否曾用于击落过敌对无人机。
作为KBR子公司的Kord公司将Firefly激光武器定位为一种可模块化设计的便携式激光系统，其功率可在5千瓦至40千瓦之间调节。在8月于阿拉巴马州北部冈特斯维尔水坝附近举行的一场演示活动中，该公司官员向记者表示，安装在卡车上的该型武器通常只需几秒钟即可锁定目标并击落小型无人机。
在本次试点项目中，Leonidas是唯一的微波反无人机系统。该系统由Epirus公司研制，是美军“间接火力防护能力”计划中用于保护部队及设施免受无人机群攻击的高功率微波武器的原型基础。
2022年12月，美国陆军向该公司拨款6610万美元用于研发四款原型机，而2025年7月又追加拨款4350万美元用于第二代产品的研发工作。
2025年9月，Epirus公司称其研发的Leonidas系统在印第安纳州阿特伯里军营进行的五种不同测试场景中，均成功击落了所有61架目标无人机，其中曾在单次操作中就摧毁了49架无人机组成的蜂群。
据美联社报道，激光武器在国内领空的应用起步并不顺利。当时有消息称，由于在布利斯堡附近使用反无人机激光武器时未与联邦航空管理局协调，联邦航空管理局曾在2月暂时关闭了德克萨斯州埃尔帕索上空的飞行区域。
为解决相关安全问题，国防部官员与联邦航空管理局的人员于3月在新墨西哥州的怀特桑兹导弹靶场进行了实弹演示。AeroVironment公司随后表示，此次测试所使用的正是其LOCUST激光武器，该武器与周一公布的试点项目中所使用的那种激光系统属于同一系列。
4月10日，联邦航空管理局表示，经过安全评估后发现，只要配备适当的安全控制措施，此次测试所使用的激光系统“不会对民用飞机构成过度风险”。
五角大楼表示将继续对其他定向能技术进行评估，并将于12月在犹他州的杜格威试验场举办一场竞赛，对更多的激光及微波系统进行测试。
该特遣部队负责人罗斯在8月表示，举办此次测试竞赛的目的在于让表现优异的武器系统能够“立即获得采购订单，从而让我们着手建立生产线，将这些系统快速部署到实际作战环境中。
该武器系统仅仅是当前更大规模反无人机行动中的其中一部分。9月29日，美国陆军宣布JIATF-401机构已授予10份合同，总价值高达41.5亿美元，用于采购传感器、光学瞄准装置以及火炮类系统，以此为“国内防护计划”提供支持，该计划旨在保护美国境内的重要国防设施。
迈克尔·斯坎伦是一名专注报道空天作战领域的国防记者。他曾担任美国空军A-10战机的机组长，此后也为美国陆军、海军、海军陆战队及海岸警卫队的各类陆海作战项目提供过报道支持。
items.zhFull:
周一，五角大楼为国内反无人机试点项目指定了四种定向能武器，这些武器是军方根据国会授权开展的计划中首批将在美国基地投入部署并接受测试的系统。

国防部在一份声明中表示，此次被选中的四款武器分别为AeroVironment公司的托盘式高能激光武器、Epirus公司的莱奥尼达斯高功率微波武器、Kord公司的萤火虫高能激光武器，以及波音公司的紧凑型激光武器系统。这些武器将是首批在美国基地投入部署并接受测试的定向能武器，用于执行国内反无人机任务。

该反无人机项目由第401联合跨部门特遣队负责实施，该特遣队是由陆军牵头、于去年成立的机构，旨在协调军方及其他联邦机构之间的反无人机行动。

据任务组负责人、陆军准将马特·罗斯在相关声明中表示，高能激光与高功率微波系统是可用于构建多层无人机防御体系的有效武器。他称：“这一试点项目将在实际作战环境中测试这些武器的技术性能，以便我们找出最佳整合与运用方式，从而有效保护祖国领土安全。

五角大楼表示，该试点项目将收集有关这些武器系统性能、成本以及运营维护所需费用的实时数据。

罗斯在8月表示，该试点项目将持续一年，由驻扎在基地的军人负责这些武器的操作与维护。该特别工作组正在协调各军种、美军北方司令部以及美国联邦航空管理局，共同推进这项试点工作。

5月，JIATF-401为该试点项目选定了5个地点：负责南部边境任务的亚利桑那州华楚卡堡和德克萨斯州布利斯堡；华盛顿州的基萨普海军基地；北达科他州的格兰德福克斯空军基地；以及密苏里州的惠特曼空军基地。

有关官员表示，部署计划将在180天内与各驻地指挥官共同制定，预计将于今年晚些时候开始投入使用。此次公布的消息并未说明具体哪种武器系统将部署在哪些驻地，每种系统的数量是多少，也未提及这些系统及整个试点项目的总成本。

激光武器与微波武器的主要优势就在于成本较低，这也是测试人员需要评估的要点之一。发射这两种武器的费用仅为导弹甚至普通子弹的一小部分，而且它们不会在地面留下未爆弹药。

罗斯在8月对记者表示，他并不认同仅通过单次发射成本来计算武器效能的做法。他说：‘如果我购买了某款成本为600万美元的武器，且每年只发射一次，那可不能告诉我这次发射的成本仅为8美分。’

除了成本因素外，激光武器与微波武器针对的威胁类型也有所不同。高能激光会一次专注攻击一架无人机，直至将其烧毁；而高功率微波则可通过一次发射就干扰大量无人机的电子系统，从而使其失效，不过其较大的作用范围引发了人们对其可能对周边设备造成影响的担忧。

在各类激光武器中，AeroVironment公司所研发的型号为LOCUST激光系统，该系统采用滚装式设计，可被装入专用托盘后通过卡车或船舶运输，再运送到所需地点进行部署。

该公司在4月表示，其研发的LOCUST激光系统已通过托盘化包装，曾在2025年10月与海军及陆军快速武器研发办公室共同进行的实弹测试中，在“乔治·H·W·布什”号航母上成功追踪并击落了目标无人机。

9月，美国陆军通过“持久高能激光”计划向AeroVironment公司下达了价值4.648亿美元的订单，要求其生产功率为30千瓦的LOCUST X3激光系统，该公司称这是美国首份针对定向能武器的量产合同。五角大楼的通报并未说明这些试验型系统是否源自该采购项目。

波音公司的紧凑型激光武器系统，即CLWS，属于低功率激光武器。由于功率较低，这类激光武器通常需要更长时间持续照射目标才能将其摧毁，但自身的体积更小，移动也更为方便。

items.author: Thomas Brading
items.summary: Following initial pilot testing at Edwards Air Force Base, the train-the-trainer initiative establishes an organic capability to field and instruct small unmanned aircraft system operations command-wide.
items.body:

AFOSI Public Affairs

For the first time, the Air Force Office of Special Investigations has certified a cadre of special agents to both operate and instruct others on the Skydio X10D as part of a broader effort to expand small unmanned aircraft system operations across the agency.

items.title: France fires upgraded nuclear-capable missile from submarine for first time
items.author: Rudy Ruitenberg
items.summary: France test-fired an upgraded version of its M51 strategic ballistic missile from a submarine for the first time on Tuesday.
items.body:
PARIS — France test-fired an upgraded version of its M51 strategic ballistic missile from a submarine for the first time on Tuesday, a capability demonstration that President Emmanuel Macron called “very important” for the country’s strategic credibility and which he said would be monitored by allies and adversaries alike.

The nuclear-powered ballistic-missile submarine Le Vigilant fired an M51.3 missile in an acceptance test following the boat’s overhaul, the Ministry of the Armed Forces said in a statement. The missile, which didn’t carry a nuclear warhead, was launched off Finistère in western France and splashed down in the North Atlantic several hundred kilometers from any coastline, the ministry said.

France’s work to upgrade the M51 missile, manufactured by ArianeGroup, is part of a broader modernization of the country’s nuclear deterrence apparatus that also includes the construction of new ballistic-missile submarines and a future upgrade of the Rafale fighter jet that would carry a hypersonic nuclear cruise missile.

“This is a very important moment for our strategic credibility,” Macron told troops onboard a French Navy vessel from which he observed the launch. “Everything that has happened recently and what is happening today will be closely scrutinized by both our allies and our competitors alike, and it already is. Along the course we have set, this is a step forward.”

The modernization of France’s nuclear arsenal comes as the country works with several European allies on what Macron has called “forward deterrence,” a proposal that could involve extending the reach of French nuclear deterrence to those allies, although the details of what that would look like remain vague for now.

Every major overhaul of a French nuclear-powered ballistic missile submarine is followed by an acceptance test firing of the M51, the ministry told Defense News in an emailed response to questions.

ArianeGroup and France’s Directorate General for Armament completed a first flight test of the modernized M51 from a launch site in Biscarrosse in southwest France in 2023, and the new missile entered operational service in October last year.

The latest M51.3 variant is estimated to have a range of more than 9,500 kilometers, from more than 9,000 kilometers for the previous version, according to the Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists. The missile carries four to six multiple independently-targetable reentry vehicles, or MIRVs, according to the Bulletin.

While the official range of the missile is undisclosed, ArianeGroup says the M51 reaches an altitude of more than 2,000 kilometers before reentering the atmosphere at a speed of Mach 20.

The missile is equipped with the new TNO-2 oceanic nuclear warhead, and offers better performance in terms of range, accuracy and penetration capability, according to the ministry. The solid-propellant three-stage missile weighs more than 50 metric tons, and each of France’s four ballistic missile submarines can carry 16 of them.

“The M51.3 ensures the long-term credibility of the ocean-based component in the face of evolving adversary missile defenses,” the ministry said. “It reflects the commitment of the President of the Republic to maintaining operational credibility of the nuclear forces over the long term, at the level required by the international environment.”

The first version of the M51 was fired from the Biscarrosse launch site in 2006, with the first submarine launch from the SSBN Le Terrible in January 2010. Today’s launch was the seventh time a variant of the M51 was fired from a French submarine, and the 13th launch of the missile overall, all of them “of course, conducted without a nuclear warhead,” according to the ministry.

Rudy Ruitenberg is a Europe correspondent for Defense News. He started his career at Bloomberg News and has experience reporting on technology, commodity markets and politics.
items.titleZh: 巴黎——周二，法国首次从潜艇上试射了具备核打击能力的升级版M51战略弹道导弹。
items.summaryZh: 巴黎——周二，法国首次从潜艇上试射了升级版的M51战略弹道导弹。埃马纽埃尔·马克龙总统称这一能力展示对提升法国的战略可信度“极为重要”，并表示无论是盟友还是对手都会密切关注这一进展。
zhParas: 巴黎——周二，法国首次从潜艇上试射了升级版的M51战略弹道导弹。埃马纽埃尔·马克龙总统称这一能力展示对提升法国的战略可信度“极为重要”，并表示无论是盟友还是对手都会密切关注这一进展。
据法国国防部发布的声明，经过大修后的核动力弹道导弹潜艇“警戒号”在验收测试中发射了一枚M51.3导弹。该导弹并未装载核弹头，从法国西部的菲尼斯泰尔省海域发射后，落入了距离任何海岸线数百公里的北大西洋海域。
由阿丽亚娜集团制造的M51导弹的升级工作，是法国对其核威慑体系进行全面现代化改造的一部分。这一改造计划还包括建造新型弹道导弹潜艇，以及未来对能够搭载高超声速核巡航导弹的“阵风”战斗机进行升级。
马克龙在观看导弹发射的法国海军舰艇上对部队表示，‘这对我们的战略威慑力而言是个极为重要的时刻。’他进一步指出，‘近期发生的一切以及如今正在开展的动作，都会受到我们盟友与竞争对手的密切关注，事实上现在就已经如此。按照我们设定的路线前进，这无疑是向前迈出的一步。’
在推进法国核武库现代化的与此同时，该国正与多个欧洲盟友共同致力于马克龙所称的‘前瞻性威慑’计划，该计划旨在将法国的核威慑力覆盖范围扩展至这些盟友，不过目前具体实施细节仍不明确。
该部门在回复《国防新闻》的邮件中称，法国每对核动力弹道导弹潜艇进行重大改造后，都会通过发射升级版的M51弹道导弹来开展验收测试。
2023年，阿丽亚娜集团与法国武器装备总局在法国西南部的比斯卡罗斯发射场完成了这款升级版M51弹道导弹的首次飞行测试，而这种新型导弹已于去年10月正式投入实战使用。
据《原子科学家公报》报道，升级后的M51.3型弹道导弹的射程预计超过9,500公里，而此前版本的射程为9,000公里左右。该公报还指出，这款导弹可搭载4至6枚多目标独立重返大气层飞行器，即MIRV。
据阿丽亚娜集团透露，虽然该导弹的官方射程尚未公布，但M51型导弹在以20马赫的速度重新进入大气层之前，其飞行高度可超过2,000公里。
据法国国防部介绍，该导弹配备了新型的TNO-2海洋核弹头，在射程、精度以及穿透能力方面均表现更为优异。这款采用固体推进剂的三级弹道导弹重量超过50公吨，而法国现有的4艘弹道导弹潜艇每艘可搭载16枚此类导弹。
法国国防部表示，M51.3型号导弹能够确保法国潜艇搭载的核打击力量在面对日益先进的敌方导弹防御系统时仍具备长期的可靠性。这也体现了法国总统致力于根据国际形势的要求，长期维持核力量的作战可靠性。
M51导弹的首次发射是在2006年从比斯卡罗斯发射场进行的，而首次从潜艇上发射则是在2010年1月，发射载体为“可怕”号战略核潜艇。据法国国防部称，此次发射是第七次从法国潜艇上发射M51的改进型导弹，也是该型导弹的第13次发射；当然，所有这些发射均未搭载核弹头。
《国防新闻》的欧洲事务记者鲁迪·鲁伊滕伯格，其职业生涯始于彭博新闻社，此前曾负责报道科技、大宗商品市场及政治相关领域新闻。

据法国国防部发布的声明，经过大修后的核动力弹道导弹潜艇“警戒号”在验收测试中发射了一枚M51.3导弹。该导弹并未装载核弹头，从法国西部的菲尼斯泰尔省海域发射后，落入了距离任何海岸线数百公里的北大西洋海域。

由阿丽亚娜集团制造的M51导弹的升级工作，是法国对其核威慑体系进行全面现代化改造的一部分。这一改造计划还包括建造新型弹道导弹潜艇，以及未来对能够搭载高超声速核巡航导弹的“阵风”战斗机进行升级。

items.title: Northrop Grumman’s YFQ-48A CCA completes first fully autonomous flight
items.author: Cristina Stassis
items.summary: The successful flight came just weeks after U.S. Air Force officials announced their intention to have 500 autonomous aircraft in service by 2032.
items.body:
Northrop Grumman’s YFQ-48A Talon Blue Collaborative Combat Aircraft recently completed its first fully autonomous flight.

Talon Blue executed its first fully autonomous flight in Mojave, California, which included taxi, takeoff, in-flight maneuvers and landing, according to a recent company release.

The modular design, part of the defense company’s internally funded Project Talon portfolio, focuses on advancing manufacturing to lower cost and speed production without decreasing mission capability, per the statement.

Upgrades to manufacturing and design decreased part count and overall weight, which lowered the cost and increased the production timeline to meet the demand for autonomous systems.

“Our customers made it clear they need autonomous systems that can be fielded faster and more affordably without sacrificing mission effectiveness. We listened,” Craig Woolston, vice president and general manager of research and advanced design at Northrop Grumman, said in the release.

“Talon Blue’s first flight is one step toward a new generation of autonomous capabilities,” he continued. “Every flight and lesson strengthens our broader autonomy work and sharpens what comes next.”

The announcement came just weeks after U.S. Air Force officials announced their intention to have 500 autonomous aircraft in service by 2032.

Secretary of the Air Force Troy Meink released the names of Anduril’s FQ-44A and General Atomics’s FQ-42A to be dubbed “Fury” and “Vengeance,” respectively. Production contracts for the two companies were awarded in June, a month before Anduril completed its first-ever live-fire test. General Atomics intends to have its live-fire testing this fall.

The Air Force has not awarded Northrop Grumman a contract for CCAs yet, but the company is included in the service’s baseline contract pool for mission autonomy software production.

The service chose six vendors in June for the software’s performance-based competition for Increment 1 with the aim of selecting one by summer 2027.

Cristina Stassis is a reporter covering stories surrounding the defense industry, national security, military/veteran affairs and more. She previously worked as an editorial fellow for Defense News in 2024 where she assisted the newsroom in breaking news across Sightline Media Group.
items.titleZh: 诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司研发的YFQ-48A协同作战飞机完成首次完全自主飞行
items.summaryZh: 就在美国空军官员宣布计划于2032年前部署500架自主飞行飞机数周后，诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司研发的YFQ-48A“猎鹰蓝”协同作战飞机便完成了其首次完全自主飞行。
zhParas: 诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司研发的YFQ-48A“猎鹰蓝”协同作战飞机近日完成了其首次完全自主飞行。
据该公司最新发布的消息，YFQ-48A“猎鹰蓝”协同作战飞机在加利福尼亚州的莫哈韦沙漠完成了其首次完全自主飞行，该飞行过程涵盖了滑行、起飞、飞行中的各种操作以及着陆等环节。
据该国防企业称，这款采用模块化设计的飞机属于其自筹资金开展的“猎鹰”项目系列，其设计理念在于通过提升制造效率来降低生产成本并加快生产速度，同时确保不会削弱其执行任务的能力。
通过改进制造工艺与设计方案，该飞机减少了零部件数量及整体重量，不仅降低了生产成本，还提升了生产效率，从而能够更快地满足市场对自主飞行系统的需求。
诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司研发与高级设计部门副总裁兼总经理克雷格·伍尔斯顿在相关声明中表示：‘我们的客户明确指出，他们需要那些能够更快部署、成本更低，同时又不影响任务执行效率的自主飞行系统。我们认真听取了他们的需求。’
他进一步表示，‘Talon Blue’的首次飞行是迈向新一代自主飞行能力的重要一步。每一次飞行与测试都在为我们的整体自主化研发工作奠定基础，同时也有助于优化后续的发展方案。’
这一消息的出现，距离美国空军官员宣布计划在2032年前让500架自主飞行飞机投入服役仅数周时间。
美国空军部长特洛伊·迈因克宣布，Anduril公司研发的FQ-44A型号与General Atomics公司研发的FQ-42A型号将分别被命名为“狂怒”和“复仇”。这两家公司的生产合同已于6月签署，而就在一个月前，Anduril公司才完成了其首次实弹测试；General Atomics公司则计划在今年秋季进行实弹测试。
尽管美国空军尚未向诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司授予用于研发自主作战飞机的合同，但该公司已被纳入该部队用于生产任务自主化软件的基准合同候选名单之中。
2027年6月，美国空军为第一阶段的软件性能竞标项目选出了六家供应商，计划在2027年夏季之前选定最终供应商。
克里斯蒂娜·斯塔西斯是一名负责报道国防工业、国家安全、军事及退伍军人事务等相关新闻的记者。2024年，她曾担任《国防新闻》的编辑助理，协助该媒体集团处理各类突发新闻报道工作。

items.title: Anduril, US Navy invest $6.6 billion to boost submarine parts production
items.author: Nathan Gomes and Shivansh Tiwary, Reuters
items.summary: Anduril will invest $3.7 billion to develop a new shipyard in Maryland to build critical components for the Navy’s Virginia-class submarines.
items.body:
Defense tech firm Anduril said on Tuesday it will invest $3.7 billion to develop a new shipyard in Maryland to build critical components for the U.S. Navy’s Virginia-class submarines, as Washington seeks to bolster its maritime defense capabilities.

Subsequently, the US Navy awarded Anduril a contract worth up to $2.9 billion to manufacture submarine components, with payments tied directly to production outcomes and the company assuming most of the execution risk, the defense startup said.

The investment and associated contract, together valued at up to $6.6 billion, come amid a broader push by the United States and its allies to expand arms production following Russia’s invasion of Ukraine and conflicts in the Middle East.

The new plant, dubbed Arsenal-2, will be situated in Baltimore County and is expected to be up and running by the end of the decade, creating 3,100 direct jobs and supporting over 11,000 indirect jobs.

Asked about the $2.9 billion government contract, Christian Brose, chief strategy officer at Anduril, said, “It’s really the government buying the results of what we’re able to produce from the facility that we’ve invested in.”

Anduril is already building out a facility in California to manufacture critical Virginia-class submarine components such as torpedo tubes, helping address urgent capacity shortfalls in the U.S. industrial base, Brose said.

The company plans to expand into producing larger submarine modules and hull sections once its Baltimore shipyard becomes operational.

Virginia-class submarines, which can travel at over 25 knots, are the Navy’s latest generation of nuclear-powered attack submarines, designed for anti-submarine warfare, land-attack strikes and surveillance missions.

General Dynamics’ Electric Boat and Huntington Ingalls Industries jointly build the submarines.

Anduril, founded in 2017 by Palmer Luckey, is a defense firm that is best known for its autonomous systems, drones and software built for the U.S. military and its allies.

The startup has, however, expanded beyond drones into maritime and undersea systems and command-and-control software designed to connect military sensors, weapons and other systems.

The new plant comes after Anduril’s $1 billion Arsenal-1 facility in Ohio that began producing autonomous combat drones this year.
items.titleZh: 防务科技企业安杜里尔公司与美国海军共同投资66亿美元，用于提升潜艇零部件生产能力
items.summaryZh: 据防务科技企业安杜里尔公司周二宣布，为助力华盛顿方面提升海上防御能力，该公司将投入37亿美元在马里兰州建设一座新造船厂，用于生产美国海军弗吉尼亚级潜艇所需的关键零部件。
zhParas: 据防务科技企业安杜里尔公司周二宣布，为助力华盛顿方面提升海上防御能力，该公司将投入37亿美元在马里兰州建设一座新造船厂，用于生产美国海军弗吉尼亚级潜艇所需的关键零部件。
据这家国防初创企业透露，美国海军随后向安杜里尔公司授予了一份价值高达29亿美元的合同，用于生产潜艇零部件；合同款项的支付直接与生产成果挂钩，且该企业需承担大部分执行风险。
这笔总额高达66亿美元的投资及相关合同，是在俄罗斯入侵乌克兰以及中东地区冲突发生后，美国及其盟友为扩大武器生产而推行的更广泛举措的一部分。
这座被命名为“Arsenal-2”的新工厂将建在巴尔的摩县，预计将在本世纪末投入运营，它不仅能创造3,100个直接就业岗位，还能为超过11,000个间接就业岗位提供支撑。
对于这笔29亿美元的政府合同，Anduril公司的首席战略官克里斯蒂安·布罗斯表示：‘实际上，政府购买的是我们通过已投入建设的工厂所生产出的产品。’
布罗斯表示，Anduril公司目前正在加利福尼亚州建设一座工厂，用于生产弗吉尼亚级潜艇所需的鱼雷发射管等关键部件，以此帮助解决美国工业基地面临的严重产能短缺问题。
一旦位于巴尔的摩的造船厂投入运营，该公司计划进一步拓展业务，开始生产更大的潜艇模块及船体结构部件。
弗吉尼亚级潜艇的航行速度可超过25节，属于美国海军最新一代核动力攻击型潜艇，专为反潜作战、对陆攻击以及执行监视任务而设计。

items.title: Lithuania says it would pay the cost if US establishes military base
items.author: Andrius Sytas, Reuters
items.summary: Lithuania is ready to pay the cost to set up a permanent U.S. military base if Washington should agree to establish one there, the prime minister said.
items.body:
VILNIUS — Lithuania is ready to pay the cost to set up a permanent U.S. military base if Washington should agree to establish one there, Prime Minister Mindaugas Sinkevicius said on Tuesday.

On Monday, U.S. President Donald Trump said he would consider Lithuania’s request for a permanent base: “They are friends of mine, they are great people, so we will certainly look at it.”

Lithuania, a member of the EU and NATO, borders Russia and Moscow’s close ally Belarus. The United States has kept an armored battalion of almost 1,000 troops there since 2019, in overlapping rotations, meaning the troops arrive and leave every few months.

Sinkevicius said he proposed turning this into a permanent presence at a meeting with Trump’s envoy John Coale last month in Vilnius.

“I’m glad that this idea is being taken seriously... This is a critically important guarantee of deterrence and security,” Sinkevicius wrote on Facebook.

“Our partners only need to make the political decision to permanently station troops, and Lithuania is ready to cover the costs involved.”
items.titleZh: 立陶宛称若美军在该国设基地，愿承担相关建设费用
items.summaryZh: 立陶宛总理表示，如果华盛顿方面同意在该国设立永久性美军基地，立陶宛愿意承担相关的建设费用。
zhParas: 维尔纽斯——立陶宛总理明达乌加斯·辛克维丘斯周二表示，如果华盛顿方面同意在该国设立永久性美军基地，立陶宛愿意承担相关建设费用。
周一，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示会考虑立陶宛建立永久性美军基地的请求，他称：‘他们是我的朋友，都是很棒的人，所以我们肯定会研究这个提议。’
作为欧盟与北约成员国，立陶宛与俄罗斯及莫斯科的亲密盟友白俄罗斯接壤。自2019年起，美国一直在该国驻扎一支约1000人的装甲营，通过轮换方式驻扎，这意味着这些部队每隔数月就会更换一批。
辛凯维丘斯表示，上个月在维尔纽斯与特朗普的特使约翰·科尔会面时，他提议将美军驻留转变为永久性存在。
辛凯维丘斯在脸书上写道：‘我很高兴这一提议能得到认真对待……这是保障威慑力与安全至关重要的举措。’
只要我们的合作伙伴做出在立陶宛永久驻军的政治决定，立陶宛就愿意承担由此产生的所有费用。

items.title: Healing Moral Injury Among Veterans
items.author: Kathryn P. Derose
items.summary: Moral injury is an important concern for U.S. military veterans, and a growing number of faith-based organizations seek to address it. This report describes 17 of these organizations, their approaches, and how their work relates to veteran care.
items.body:
A Landscape Analysis of Community Organizations Providing Faith-Based Support

ResearchPublished Oct 6, 2026

This research was made possible by the Epstein Family Foundation.

Moral injury, distress arising from experiences that violate deeply held moral beliefs and expectations, is an important concern for U.S. military veterans, and a growing number of faith-based organizations seek to address it. In this report, the authors conduct a landscape analysis, examining 17 such organizations—describing their characteristics, approaches to moral injury, and links to the broader veteran-support ecosystem.

Moral injury, the distress that can arise from experiences that violate deeply held moral beliefs and expectations, is an important concern for U.S. military veterans. In this report, the authors examine the landscape of U.S. community-based organizations that provide faith‑based or spiritually informed support for moral injury among military veterans. Drawing on a systematic scan of publicly available information and qualitative interviews with 19 representatives from 17 participating faith-based organizations (FBOs), the authors describe how these organizations conceptualize moral injury, the approaches they use to support veterans, and how their work intersects with the broader veteran-support ecosystem, including the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), religious congregations, and other religious or spiritual communities.

The study is descriptive. The authors summarize the evaluation and outcome information that organizations have published or provided, including a small number of peer-reviewed pre-post studies and organizational reports on reach and participant feedback. They did not collect data from veterans, independently verify organizational data, or evaluate program effectiveness. Additionally, because the authors describe the participating organizations rather than evaluate them, the recommendations reflect implications and considerations rather than endorsements of specific programs or models.

- Participating FBOs addressed dimensions of moral injury but often did so through distinctively faith- and community-based practices. Programs targeted concerns well documented in the moral injury literature, including guilt, shame, and forgiveness. However, FBOs often placed greater emphasis than typical clinical or VA models on forgiveness from God, flexible faith-based meaning-making, and a reconnection to a specific religious or spiritual community.

- FBOs combined multiple program components that have some support in the broader veteran-services literature, but this approach remains underevaluated. Peer facilitation, communal sharing, family inclusion, and other program components align with existing evidence to varying degrees. Yet the evidence base rarely examines these components as an integrated, faith-informed model for moral injury support.

- FBOs described addressing relational and community needs that formal care might not fully meet. Organizations framed healing as a long-term process supported through social ties, opportunities for veterans to give back, and reconnection to religious, spiritual, or community life. This emphasis on sustained belonging and reintegration could be relevant for veterans who are reluctant to engage with formal systems or whose moral injury involves disconnection from their faith, family, or community.

- FBOs may extend the veteran-support ecosystem, but their role remains informal and unevenly supported. Organizations generally viewed their work as complementary and sometimes as bridges to other supports. Collaboration was often locally driven, dependent on informal relationships, and absent of consistent processes for partnering with VA, while limited evaluation capacity and administrative burdens constrained FBOs’ ability to document outcomes.

- Researchers and funders could support pragmatic evaluation designs feasible for small community-based organizations; distinguish among types of FBOs, which differ in capacity, structure, and evaluation readiness; and pair validated measures with measures of forgiveness, meaning-making, spiritual struggle, belonging, and family functioning.

- Funders and policymakers could invest in organizational infrastructure—staffing, data systems, and evaluation expertise—alongside program delivery and support technical assistance intermediaries that help FBOs build capacity without displacing local trust.

- VA could clarify how coordination with community-based faith and spiritual supports currently occurs and identify which partnership and funding requirements are fixed and which are modifiable for small organizations with limited administrative capacity.

- FBOs could maintain flexible, noncoercive approaches to faith and spirituality that remain inclusive of nonreligious and spiritually unaffiliated veterans, clarify their scope of services and how veterans are connected to clinical care when needed, and build evaluation capacity as resources permit.

- Religious congregations could partner with FBOs on practical support, aftercare, and community reintegration, and build familiarity with moral injury and military culture.

items.titleZh: 疗愈退伍军人的道德伤害
items.summaryZh: 道德伤害是美国退伍军人的一个重要关切，越来越多的基于信仰支持的社区组织寻求应对这一问题。本报告描述了其中17个组织、它们的做法，以及它们的工作与退伍军人照护之间的关系。
zhParas: 对提供基于信仰支持的社区组织的全景分析
研究发布：2026年10月6日
本研究由爱泼斯坦家族基金会资助得以完成。
道德伤害——因经历违背根深蒂固的道德信念和期望而产生的痛苦——是美国退伍军人的一项重要关切，越来越多的信仰型组织试图应对这一问题。在本报告中，作者开展了一项全景分析，考察了17个此类组织——描述其特征、应对道德伤害的方法，以及与更广泛的退伍军人支持生态系统的联系。

道德伤害，即可能因经历违背根深蒂固的道德信念和期望而产生的痛苦，是美国退伍军人的一项重要关切。在本报告中，作者考察了美国社区型组织的整体情况，这些组织为退伍军人中的道德伤害提供基于信仰或受灵性启发的支持。基于对公开可得信息的系统性扫描以及对来自17个参与研究的信仰型组织（FBO）的19名代表的定性访谈，作者描述了这些组织如何理解道德伤害、他们用于支持退伍军人的方法，以及他们的工作如何与更广泛的退伍军人支持生态系统相交，包括美国退伍军人事务部（VA）、宗教会众以及其他宗教或灵性社区。
本研究属于描述性研究。作者总结了各组织已发布或提供的评估和结果信息，包括少量经同行评审的干预前后研究和关于覆盖范围及参与者反馈的组织报告。他们未从退伍军人处收集数据，未独立核实组织数据，也未评估项目有效性。此外，由于作者是描述参与组织而非对其进行评估，相关建议反映的是影响和考量，而非对特定项目或模式的认可。
参与研究的基于信仰的组织（FBO）应对道德伤害的各个维度，但往往通过独特的信仰和社区实践来开展。项目针对道德伤害文献中充分记录的问题，包括内疚、羞耻和宽恕。然而，与典型的临床或退伍军人事务部（VA）模式相比，FBO往往更强调来自上帝的宽恕、灵活的基于信仰的意义建构，以及与特定宗教或精神社群重新建立联系。
FBO整合了多个项目组成部分，这些部分在更广泛的退伍军人服务文献中得到一定支持，但这种方法仍缺乏充分评估。同伴引导、集体分享、家庭参与及其他项目组成部分与现有证据的契合程度不一。然而，证据基础很少将这些组成部分作为一个整合的、以信仰为依据的道德伤害支持模式加以考察。
FBO表示，它们应对的是正式照护可能无法完全满足的关系和社区需求。这些组织将疗愈界定为一个长期过程，通过社会联系、退伍军人回馈社会的机会，以及与宗教、精神或社区生活的重新连接来支持。这种对持续归属感和重新融入的强调，可能适用于那些不愿接触正式体系的退伍军人，或其道德伤害涉及与信仰、家庭或社区脱节的退伍军人。
FBO可能扩展退伍军人支持生态系统，但其角色仍是非正式的，且得到的支持不均衡。这些组织通常将自己的工作视为补充性的，有时也是通往其他支持的桥梁。合作往往由地方推动，依赖非正式关系，并且缺乏与VA合作的稳定流程，而有限的评估能力和行政负担限制了FBO记录成果的能力。
研究者和资助者可以支持对小规模社区组织可行的务实评估设计；区分不同类型的FBO，因为它们在能力、结构和评估准备程度上各不相同；并将经过验证的测量工具与宽恕、意义建构、灵性挣扎、归属感和家庭功能等测量工具配合使用。
资助者和政策制定者可以在投资项目实施的同时，投资于组织基础设施——人员配备、数据系统和评估专长——并支持技术援助中介机构，帮助FBO在不取代当地信任的情况下建设能力。
退伍军人事务部（VA）可以阐明目前如何与社区信仰和精神支持服务进行协调，并确定哪些合作与资助要求是固定的，哪些对于行政能力有限的小型组织而言可以调整。
信仰类组织（FBOs）可以保持灵活、非强制性的信仰与灵性关怀方式，继续包容无宗教信仰以及未归属任何灵性/宗教群体的退伍军人，明确其服务范围以及退伍军人在需要时如何衔接至临床照护，并在资源允许时建设评估能力。
宗教会众可以与信仰类组织（FBOs）合作，在提供实际支持、后续照护和重新融入社区方面开展工作，并增进对道德创伤和军事文化的了解。
